title: Musafir Cafe
summary:
Musafir Cafe is a 2026 Netflix original Hindi-language television series written by Divya Prakash Dubey and directed by Ruchir Arun. The series stars Vikrant Massey, Vedika Pinto, Mahima Makwana, Adil Hussain, 
Sadiya Siddiqui, Rajeev Siddhartha, Anubha Fatehpuria and others.
reception:
Writing for India Today Anurag Singh Bohra gave 3.5 stars to the series and wrote that the series "brings modern romance and old-school warmth together with quiet confidence and heart." Nandini Ramnath reviewing for Scroll.in wrote "The pacing can be sluggish." Rediff.com reviewer Sukanya Verma stated "Too random to be a cliffhanger."
The Indian Express reviewer Shubhra Gupta wrote "Why does it take eight stretched episodes to tell a tale that would have been better told in half the time? Why is the serene city of Bhopal such a fleeting presence the famed lake glimpsed from a terrace cafe- even though it’s named frequently through the show? Those are also questions which this could-have-been-a-pyaari-prem kahani don’t answer well enough."
Manjusha Radhakrishnan of Gulf News opined "It ends on a cliffhanger. Without giving too much away, the final moments raise questions that linger long after the credits roll."
The Hollywood Reporter India reviewer Rahul Desai called the series "doesn’t take sides in the contest between the individualism of romance and the romance of individualism." NDTV reviewer Madhumanti Pait Chowdhury opined that "The end leaves an expectation and an uneasiness about what happened to them." Wion reviewer Shomini Sen stated that the series "ends at a point which opens up possibilities of a sequel."
A reviewer from The New Indian Express wrote "The writers come dangerously close to projecting Sudha as a Manic Pixie Dream Girl prototype." Another reviewer from News18 rated the series 3.5 stars and stated "there are contrived attempts to make the series something that it’s not. And that’s when the narrative starts sinking in bits and parts."
The Free Press Journal reviewer Ria Sharma opined "It's not a masterpiece, nor does it offer a groundbreaking story, but it succeeds in creating a warm viewing experience." Anindita Mukhopadhyay for India TV praised Ruchir Arun's direction stating "He allows moments to breathe, letting conversations and silences carry the emotions instead of relying on dramatic twists."
ABP News reviewer Amit Bhatia felt the series is "disappointing watch that ultimately feels like a waste of time." Times Now reviewer Soumyabrata Gupta stated "Like the travellers who stop by the quaint Musafir Cafe, the series sings of a story worth hearing." Sunny Singh of NewsX stated "The last episode sets the stage for emotional closure and then cuts off abruptly, leaving many loose ends in preparation for the next season." Indulge Express reviewer Bristi Dey rated the series 4 out of 5 stars.

title: Mammatiyaan Stars
summary: Mammatiyaan Stars is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language sports drama web series directed by Savir Sudhakar. It stars Vaibhav Murugesan, Lavanya Anbazhagan, Venkeda Balamurali and Jagabar Sathik, and follows a group of cricket fans from a Tamil Nadu village who travel to Chennai hoping to watch a star player's final match. Produced by S. Singaravelan under the SS Group banner, the six-episode series premiered on ZEE5 on 26 June 2026.
plot: The series follows Chinna and his friends Shakil and Siva, three college students in a small Tamil Nadu village whose shared interest is cricket and a player they have followed since childhood. Learning that the player is nearing retirement, the group enters local cricket tournaments to raise money for a trip to see him play in Chennai before his final match. Joined by a fourth friend, Charu, they travel toward the city, and their plan is complicated when they discover the match tickets they bought are counterfeit.
reception:
Rakesh Tara of ABP Live gave the series a generally positive review, noting that "Overall, Mammatiyaan Stars is not a thriller with big twists and turns. But it can be seen as a light-hearted feel-good web series that tells the story of friendship, cricket craze and youthful dreams in a simple way. This series will not disappoint cricket fans and those who like stories centered around friends."
Deepa of BroadCast Media provided a more critical assessment, She remarked that "Cricket fans may connect with the characters’ passion for the game, but others may feel like they are watching a match that is still waiting for its first six. The series has a simple concept, but it misses the chance to turn that idea into a memorable innings."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: Mammatiyaan Stars was directed by Savir Sudhakar, who also co-wrote the series with Naveen Rajkumar, Kalai Selvan and Vinu Karthikeyan. Cinematography was by PM Rajkumar, with editing by Pavithran and art direction by Tamilselvan.

title: Made In India: A Titan Story
wikiTitle: Made In India: A Titan Story
summary:
Made in India: A Titan Story is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language biographical drama streaming television series directed by Robbie Grewal. Based on Vinay Kamath's book Titan: Inside India's Most Successful Consumer Brand, the series chronicles the rise of Titan Company and the individuals who transformed it into one of India's most successful consumer brands. The series stars Jim Sarbh, Naseeruddin Shah  alongside Vaibhav Tatwawadi, Namita Dubey, and Lakshvir Saran in supporting roles.
It premiered on Amazon MX Player on 3 June 2026 and received positive reviews for its performances, writing, and portrayal of India's corporate history.
plot: Set in 1978 Bombay, Made in India: A Titan Story chronicles the rise of Titan through the vision of Xerxes Desai and Akash Dikshit, who sought to challenge India's smuggler-dominated watch market by building a world-class Indian brand. Facing bureaucratic obstacles, financial crisis, and repeated setbacks, the team transforms an ambitious idea into a national success. However, a risky overseas expansion pushes Titan to the brink of collapse, forcing its founders to stake everything on one final innovation that could either save the company or end their dream forever.
reception:
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India called it "The feel-good watch of the year" and writes that "there’s something about A Titan Story. It may be privileged and blessed with plenty, but it’s also undeniably talented and entertaining." Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave 3 stars out of 5 and writes that "Yes, it’s bygone, but the qualities it endorses are timeless: the Titan story, a branding and marketing triumph, is inspiring, and the show remains watchable despite those quibbles, bookended by wonderful performances from Shah and Sarbh."
Sukanya Verma of Rediff.com observed that "Where Made in India's docudrama scores is its feel-good sincerity." Anurag Singh Bohra of India Today gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and said that "If you grew up seeing Titan ads and believing in “Made in India” before it became a slogan, this one will hit differently. Warm, human, and quietly inspiring." Abhishek Srivastava of The Times of India rated it 4/5 stars and writes that "Made in India - A Titan Story leaves an impression as it pays equal attention to its smaller moments as much as its larger achievements."
Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost also gave 4 stars out of 5 and writes that "It may be an imperfect show, but something that also happens to be a crucial and fun ‘watch.’ No pun intended here!" Bollywood Hungama rated 4/5 stars and said that "MADE IN INDIA: A TITAN STORY is a brilliantly made show that tells a fascinating story not many are aware of. The performances by Jim Sarbh, Naseeruddin Shah and the rest of the cast are the icing on the cake."
Rachit Gupta writing for Filmfare also gave 4 stars out of 5 and praise the performance of the cast and writes that "Made In India: A Titan Story is at its best a warm, well-intentioned love letter to the spirit of Indian enterprise, to the men and women who believed, in the face of Swiss scepticism and domestic bureaucracy, that India could put a world-class watch on the world's wrist." Agnivo Niyogi writing for The Telegraph stated that "In theory, this show doesn't have the ingredients of a traditional underdog story. Yet, much to its credit, Made in India: A Titan Story turns out to be far more engaging than expected."

episodesList.title: The Watch Project
episodesList.summary: Year 1978. A Sidelined Tata executive Xerxes Desai is tasked with reviving a dying division of Tata's Tata Press, only to stumble upon a bold idea that could redefine Indian industry. Challenged by global humiliation, he sets out to build India's first world-class watch against all odds.

episodesList.title: Demonstration
episodesList.summary: As the team comes together amid personal sacrifices, Xerxes pushes the dream of an Indian Quartz watch through boardroom battles and bureaucratic rejection. Just when hope resurfaces with a government partnership and the birth of "Titan," financial doors slam shut, threatening the vision once again.

episodesList.title: Flying Saucer
episodesList.summary: When the team falters, Xerxes's unwavering belief, bolstered by family support, keeps Titan alive, leading to funding, a factory, and the birth of India's first Quartz watch. But just as the dream takes physical form, a public humiliation by a foreign rival threatens to shatter everything they've built.

episodesList.title: The Real Value
episodesList.summary: Reigniting the team's spirit, Xerxes turns failure into innovation, fixing the flaw and reshaping Titan through global learning and bold design. Though the launch struggles and sales falter, a startling clue in Chor Bazaar hints that Titan's impact is far greater than anyone realizes.

episodesList.title: Universal Language
episodesList.summary: Xerxes cracks Titan's pricing puzzle and stabilizes the business, even as personal and professional shifts test the team's confidence. A bold branding leap, powered by Mozart's stirring symphony, transforms Titan into a cultural symbol and ignites explosive growth.

episodesList.title: Twenty Two
episodesList.summary: At the peak of success, Xerxes's ambition costs him his closest ally and nearly destroys Titan's future. But one last act of belief leads to a historic innovation, turning humiliation into victory and sealing Titan's place on the world stage.

title: Memu Copulam
summary: Memu Copulam (stylized as Memu COP'ulam; transl. We are Cops) is an Indian Telugu-language comedy-mystery streaming television series scheduled to premiere on 22 May 2026. The series is directed by Pradeep Maddali, written by Shoban Chittuprolu, and produced by B. V. S. Ravi and Kaumudi K. Nemani under the RAW Entertainments production banner. The series features Nagendra Babu, Getup Srinu, and Ravi Teja Nannimala in the principal roles.
plot:
Set against a rural backdrop in the Godavari districts during the Sankranti festival, the narrative focuses on Mahadevapatnam, a village noted for its competitive cockfighting culture. Gajapathi Raju (Nagendra Babu), a prominent local chief, owns a highly prized fighting rooster named "Salaar Raju". Shortly before a major tournament, the rooster disappears under mysterious circumstances.
The investigation is assigned to Ravi Sotari (Ravi Teja Nannimala) and Mohan Sotari (Getup Srinu), two inexperienced and bumbling police constables. While pursuing eccentric clues and mismanaging the investigation, the officers inadvertently uncover a broader underlying conspiracy that impacts the village community.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Following the release of the series Vikkatakavi, director Pradeep Maddali collaborated with production banner RAW Entertainments for an investigative comedy series titled Memu Copulam. The script was developed by Shoban Chittuprolu, focusing on regional rural satire and situational comedy.

articleSections.title: Title controversy and marketing
articleSections.text:
In early May 2026, the producers initiated a marketing campaign involving a staged conflict. A video clip emerged online showing actor Getup Srinu and television journalist Jaffar engaged in a heated argument during a mock interview. In the footage, Jaffar criticized the project's title, misinterpreting it as "Memu Kapulam" (), and questioned the integration of caste-based identities in regional cinema. Getup Srinu simulated walking out of the interview, which led to widespread discussion and polarization among social media users.
The production team subsequently clarified that the altercation was a planned promotional stunt. They revealed that the actual title was stylized as Memu COP'ulam, a pun substituting the Telugu word Kapulam (guardians/caste reference) with the English word Cop (police officers) to reflect the protagonists' occupations. The official trailer for the series was launched on 14 May 2026 by Telugu actor Brahmanandam.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Memu Copulam is scheduled to stream on the digital platform ZEE5 beginning 22 May 2026.

plotHtml:
Set against a rural backdrop in the Godavari districts during the Sankranti festival, the narrative focuses on Mahadevapatnam, a village noted for its competitive cockfighting culture. Gajapathi Raju (Nagendra Babu), a prominent local chief, owns a highly prized fighting rooster named "Salaar Raju". Shortly before a major tournament, the rooster disappears under mysterious circumstances.
The investigation is assigned to Ravi Sotari (Ravi Teja Nannimala) and Mohan Sotari (Getup Srinu), two inexperienced and bumbling police constables. While pursuing eccentric clues and mismanaging the investigation, the officers inadvertently uncover a broader underlying conspiracy that impacts the village community.
tagline: In a village obsessed with cockfighting, two bumbling constables stumble upon a conspiracy after a prized rooster goes missing during the Sankranti festival.

title: Must Date the Playboy
summary:
Must Date the Playboy  is a 2026 Singaporean Tamil-language Coming-of-age romantic drama television series directed by T. Suriavelan, starring Chandini Nagadurga and Muzammil Elias in the lead, with Ganga Kannan, Mazhaimegan and Pragadesh s/o Prakash in other pivotal roles. Based on the Philippines novel of the same name written by Imma Delos Santos, the story follows Tara, who enters a fake relationship with the college's notorious heartbreaker, Zayn, in a desperate bid to protect her best friend, from his pursuit. However, her strategic plan backfires as real feelings begin to blur the lines of their game, forcing both Tara and Zayn into a vulnerable emotional battlefield where they risk genuinely falling for each other.
The show was produced by Satesh Kumaran and Priya Ramesh under the 360 Entertainment Productions banner. It premiered on Mediacorp Vasantham on 22 April 2026, and airs from Monday to Thursday at 22:00 and streams digitally on mewatch.
plot:
The story begins in the sprawling, bustling campus of a prestigious college, where Vaishnavi Tara Priyadharshan "Tara" is known as the ultimate nerd—brilliant, focused, and intensely private. Despite coming from an incredibly wealthy background, she completely shuns the flashy, high-profile lifestyle her family's money could afford, choosing instead to bury herself in her studies, oversized sweaters, and thick textbooks. Tara’s safe haven in this chaotic university environment is her tight-knit friendship with Kaushika and Nithin. The three of them are inseparable, sharing a bond built on mutual support, quiet study sessions, and a shared desire to navigate their degrees without unnecessary drama. Tara relies heavily on Kaushika’s protective nature and Nithin’s grounded, steady presence to keep her anchored, unaware that the ghosts of her friends' pasts are about to collide violently with her peaceful academic life.
Unbeknownst to Tara, a complex web of history already connects her friends to the college’s most notorious social circle. Years ago, during their school days, Kaushika, Nithin, Zayn, and Jegan were all part of the same classmate circle. However, as time passed, a sharp rift formed. Zayn Ishaan Aravindhan, blessed with lethal charm and a wealthy background of his own, evolved into a ruthless, smooth-talking playboy, while Jegan became his loyal, enabling right-hand man, always ready to fuel Zayn's ego and join in on his reckless lifestyle. Disgusted by Zayn’s toxic behavior, his trail of broken hearts, and Jegan's blind loyalty, Kaushika and Nithin actively chose to walk away from them. By the time they reached college, Kaushika and Nithin had completely distanced themselves from their old schoolmates, establishing a strict, unspoken boundary to keep Zayn’s chaotic energy far away from their new lives—and especially away from the innocent, sheltered Tara.
The fragile peace shatters when Zayn, always looking for a new conquest to cure his boredom, sets his sights on Kaushika. Driven by a mix of nostalgia and his relentless playboy instinct, Zayn begins aggressively pursuing her, completely ignoring the clear boundaries she and Nithin have set. Witnessing her best friend's growing distress and knowing Zayn's destructive track record, Tara's fierce loyalty overrides her naturally timid, nerdy persona. She realizes that standard warnings won't stop a predator like Zayn, so she devises a daring, high-stakes plan: she will throw herself into his orbit to shield Kaushika. Stepping out from the shadows of the library, the wealthy but unassuming nerd deliberately crosses paths with the campus kingpin, boldly proposing a game of her own to catch his attention. Tara's ultimate goal is to make Zayn fall for her instead, intentionally entering a dangerous web of fake dating and psychological chess to distract him, tame his ego, and permanently protect the friends who mean the world to her.
Tara and Zayn is a dangerous game of love where the biggest mistake they can make is falling for each other.

title: Matka King
summary:
Matka King is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language period crime drama television series created by Nagraj Popatrao Manjule and Abhay Koranne based on the story concept by Ashish Aryan for Amazon Prime Video. It stars Vijay Varma, Sai Tamhankar, Bhupendra Jadawat, Kritika Kamra, Gulshan Grover and Siddharth Jadhav in lead roles. Set in the 1960s Mumbai, the series traces the transformation of a humble, enterprising cotton trader into a powerful gambling don as he starts a new game called Matka, that takes the city by storm and democratizes a terrain previously reserved for the rich and elite.
The series is renewed for a second season by Amazon Prime Video which is in development.
plot:
Matka King is a gripping crime drama set in the 1960s Mumbai. The series builds its world around a modest cotton trader, Brij Bhatti, who, starts an illegal "Matka" betting game, showing how a small, almost harmless gambling idea gradually evolves into a massive underground empire that is controlled by money, politics, and fear.
At its core, the show is less about gambling and more about ambition. It explores how greed reshapes a man's morals as he climbs from poverty to power, and how that power slowly begins to destroy everything around him. Vijay Varma delivers a strong and controlled performance, carrying the emotional weight of a man who is both intelligent and deeply flawed.
reception:
Anuj Kumar for The Hindu wrote "‘Matka King’ turns out to be a familiar but gripping crime drama that is worth betting on."
Shubhra Gupta for The Indian Express rated the series 2/5 stars and stated "the matka-addicted mill-workers and their unions whose movement kept Bombay's greedy sharks at bay, remain a scratchy backdrop."
Rahul Desai for The Hollywood Reporter India wrote "Along the way, there are glimpses of the intellect buried within the algorithm."
Deepansh Duggal for The Quint stated "Instead of unfolding organically, the plot feels like it is delivered in bursts, with too much information packed into too little time." Nandini Ramnath for Scroll.in felt that "The eight-episode show suffers from a bit of bloat and threadbare production values." Sana Farzeen of India Today rated the series 3/5 stars and stated "At eight episodes, it feels indulgent."
Tatsam Mukherjee of The Wire expressed "No man-woman pair in the show can do so without falling in love, which I found too escapist and dated." Hardika Gupta from NDTV rated the series 2 out of 5 stars and stated "The result is a story that moves, but rarely surprises; that speaks, but rarely resonates." A reviewer from Amar Ujala rated the series 2.5/5.

episodesList.title: Taqdeer, Tadbeer, Tarkeeb!
episodesList.summary: Brij Bhatti is a cotton exchange worker drowning in debt with a pregnant wife and a directionless brother. With ruthless loan sharks at his door and hope as the only currency, Brij faces a life-changing choice: accept his crushing fate or revolutionise the gambling system, a move with ripple effects unknown to Brij himself.

episodesList.title: Umeed Ka Karkhana
episodesList.summary: Integrity is tested when Matka brings Brij both fortune and a target on his back. With a newborn as his lucky charm, Brij reinvents the game, spreading Matka through Bombay's bustling textile mills. While a journalist begins to investigate the rise of Matka, the enigmatic Gulrukh is drawn to the game's allure. Laljibhai orchestrates a plan to dismantle the rising empire, nearly succeeding.

episodesList.title: Izzat Half, Sangam Full
episodesList.summary: Brij enters Mumbai's elite world through Gulrukh's circles but struggles to find his place among the city's old money. As Matka explodes nationwide, reporter T.P. rallies officials against the "Matka King," while Inspector Eknath begins clandestine surveillance. With Minister Bapat plotting a state-level intervention, greed and ambition begin to corrupt Brij's empire from within.

episodesList.title: Tera Pyaar Triple Paana, Mera Pyaar Kabootar Daana
episodesList.summary: Survival requires innovation as the government launches a rival scheme to dismantle Brij's influence. Forced to think outside the box, Brij expands his reach across India, but success demands a heavy sacrifice. Trust fractures within the inner circle, and an enemy strikes where it hurts most when unbridled greed determines to ruin everything.

episodesList.title: Safed Kapde, Kaale Dil
episodesList.summary: Brij adopts a stark new public persona, turning appearance into strategy. While new alliances form, old foundations reveal deep cracks. The game's toll on his home life forces Brij into taking a heartbreaking decision. As Minister Bapat attempts to corner him, Brij proves he is at his most dangerous when his back is against the wall.

episodesList.title: Lights, Camera, Jodi
episodesList.summary: As media attention reaches a fever pitch, Barkha feels the heavy weight of her husband's notoriety. Amidst grand celebrations, Dagdu suffers a profound personal loss, and Gulrukh seeks independence for her own business. Inspector Eknath begins to question his faith in the system as Matka spills into the homes, careers, and consciences of every citizen in Bombay.

episodesList.title: Do Ikke, Ek Gulaam
episodesList.summary: A wedding celebration leaves Brij's world more fractured than ever. Lacchu pursues dangerous new alliances with outside forces, attempting to pull Brij into a darker game. As the pillars of the Matka world begin to crumble and the inner circle splinters, Brij stands his ground even as the true cost of ambition surfaces in unexpected, violent ways.

episodesList.title: Open Aur Close
episodesList.summary: As mill workers go on an indefinite strike, Brij is faced with a decision that will affect the city and the country. Lacchu joins Darab's war for power, while Dagdu's fight for Sulabha fractures the circle. Barkha reclaims her identity, and TP weighs the effect of Matka's involvement in the whole system. As everything that was built stands unprotected, the Matka King must play one last hand.

It explores how greed reshapes a man's morals as he climbs from poverty to power, and how that power slowly begins to destroy everything around him. Vijay Varma delivers a strong and controlled performance, carrying the emotional weight of a man who is both intelligent and deeply flawed.
tagline: In 1960s Mumbai, a humble trader's ambition spirals into a ruthless gambling empire, challenging morality and power in a world of corruption.

title: Maa Ka Sum
summary: Maa Ka Sum is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language drama television series written by Ravinder Randhawa and Sumrit Shahi, directed by Nicholas Kharkongor. Produced under Eunoia Films, the series stars Mona Singh, Mihir Ahuja and Angira Dhar.
reception:
Sukanya Verma of Rediff rated the series two star out of five stars, writing, "Despite a promising premise, the eight-part series is overly enamoured with the protagonist's 'geekdom' and failing to deliver a believable mother-son slice-of-life story." Shubhra Gupta from The Indian Express gave the series out of 5 stars. Riya Sharma of Hindustan Times awarded the series 3/5 stars.
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India commeneted that "The numbers just don’t add up." Udita Jhunjhunwala writing for the Scroll.in observed that "Maa Ka Sum begins as a cutesy, almost saccharine dramedy before veering into darker territory touching on issues such as mental health and abandonment. These shifts feel abrupt and underdeveloped, as though the series is trying to mount seriousness on an already shaky foundation."
Kartik Bhardwaj of Cinema Express rated it 2/5 stars and said that "The Prime Video show is a mere assemblage of elements lacking the x factor". Sana Farzeen of India Today also gave 2 stars out of 5 and said that "What begins as a clever, promising concept slowly turns into an overextended equation, one that keeps working itself out without arriving at a meaningful answer. And in the process, it does something unexpected. It makes math feel exhausting all over again."

episodesList.title: The Blueprint
episodesList.summary: Agastya, a math prodigy, prevents a fellow student from jumping off a building using maths. He shares a bittersweet dinner with his mother, Vinita, marking his father's abandonment. As Vinita explores dating, Agastya navigates his own breakup. A bookstore encounter with a woman, where his math skills fail him, leaves him baffled. The next day, a new math professor inspires an idea to help Vinita.

episodesList.title: Work-In-Progress
episodesList.summary: Agastya hacks a dating app for Vinita, but his algorithm picks terrible dates. To get into his professor's class, he must find her a home, but his data-driven approach fails. His professor teaches him to temper genius with real-world observation, inspiring him to create a new and improved dating algorithm. Meanwhile, Annie hides a secret.

episodesList.title: Progress
episodesList.summary: Agastya refines Vinita's dating profile with verified data, finally leading to successful dates for her. Ira allows him to attend her class. Vinita's real estate deal collapses due to Abhimanyu. Annie ends up in hospital due to the pills, leading to a fight with Agastya. Agastya shares his algorithm with Ira. Vinita encounters Abhimanyu again, who apologizes to her.

episodesList.title: Off Track
episodesList.summary: Vinita and Abhimanyu connect, but Agastya forbids her to date him, fearing it will disrupt his algorithm. At Ira's party, Agastya meets Heartset's founder and discovers that Ira worked on that algorithm. Ira suggests that she and Agastya create a new algorithm. Annie confesses her feelings for Agastya. Agastya discovers that Vinita is still seeing Abhimanyu.

episodesList.title: The Tipping Point
episodesList.summary: Agastya confronts Vinita. As he remembers his father's abandonment, he suffers a panic attack at college and is helped by Annie. Ira challenges his bias against Abhimanyu. Agastya asks Spidey to hack Abhimanyu's social media. At a concert, Agastya and Ira both feel unwell from a spiked drink.

episodesList.title: The Unravelling
episodesList.summary: Agastya schemes to end Vinita's relationship. Ira suspects Agastya spiked her drink. Annie reveals her past trauma to Agastya, resolving their past and inspiring a memorial for her brother. Vinita receives incriminating photos of Abhimanyu. Agastya is late for the memorial, causing a rift with his friends. Agastya and Ira share a tender moment. Agastya faces a stark realization.

episodesList.title: The Final Piece
episodesList.summary: Agastya confesses his feelings to Ira. Abhimanyu reveals some jolting news about Agastya, shocking Vinita. Agastya has a meltdown when confronted. As his graffiti wall is destroyed, he has a breakthrough in his algorithm. Ira is pushed to make a tough decision. Overwhelmed with everything, Agastya gets into trouble.

When Agastya goes missing and lands in jail after a fight, his friends bail him out. As he navigates his mother's hurt because of his actions and receives an enlightening letter from Ira, he is forced to confront the limits of logic and maths in matters of the heart and human connection. He learns that some things-like love-can't be calculated.

title: Muthu Engira Kaattaan
summary: Muthu Engira Kaattaan (transl. Muthu alias Kaattaan) is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language television series written and directed by M. Manikandan, B. Ajithkumar and La. Rajkumar for JioHotstar. The primary cast includes Vijay Sethupathi, Milind Soman and others. The show produced by Vijay Sethupathi under the banner of Vijay Sethupathi Productions. It premiered in JioHotstar on 27 March 2026.
reception:
Abhinav Subramanian of The Times of India gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and said that "The season's central mystery also leaves you with more loose ends than you'd like. It's an imperfect season, but one that leaves you wanting a second. Vishal Menon writing for The Hollywood Reporter India noted that "A mysterious character study loses its way and The mood is that of a dark comedy and the characters layered, but the series loses its way and transforms into an elaborate backstory.
Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in writes in her review that "The 10 episodes are devoted as much to detailing as to detection. The series is decisively not in a neo-noir mould, with rustic settings, rooted characters and a refreshing absence of cynicism." Bhuvanesh Chandar of The Hindu observed that "Manikandan makes an impressive series debut with ‘Kaattaan,’ which takes viewers on a thrilling, slow-burn journey through the fragmented life of an one-of-a-kind, mysterious dead man."
Akshay Kumar of The New Indian Express rated it 3/5 stars and said that "Muthu Engira Kaattaan slumps when it dissociates itself from its engrossing human tale to a done-to-death gangster story." Latha Srinivasan of NDTV gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "Muthu Alias Kaattaan is not a web series that tries to impress you immediately, it takes time and grows on you, episode by episode, as Muthu's life unfolds piece by piece on screen."

title: Mr. and Mrs. Parshuram
summary: Mr. and Mrs. Parshuram is an Indian Hindi-language crime thriller drama television series premiered on 3 February to 18 August 2026 on StarPlus and streams digitally on JioHotstar. It is an official Hindi remake of Star Jalsha's Bengali TV series Parshuram – Ajker Nayok. Produced under Blues Productions, the series stars Shambhavi Singh and Neil Bhatt.
plot: Shiv Prasad Deshmukh is a seemingly ordinary middle-class family man in Maharashtra who lives with his courageous wife Shalini, son Harshit "Chintu" and daughter Riddhi "Pihu". Shalini is revealed to be actually the younger daughter of Malhar Dixit and Deepali Dixit from the elite Dixit family, but she had cut contacts with them, eloped with Shiv and married him against their wishes. While Shalini, Shiv and their kids live happily together, the Dixit family plans to marry off Malhar's younger brother Manish Dixit's daughter, Aradhya Dixit, to Kabir Kulkarni, a rich rogue from the Kulkarni family. Though the Dixits are aware of the fact that Kabir is a criminal, they still want to go ahead with the marriage to improve business relations with Kabir's father, and Aradhya also loves him dearly. Meanwhile, Shalini goes for an outing to a restaurant with Shiv and the kids when some of Kabir's goons try to molest her. She slaps them and berates Shiv for not standing up for her and merely apologizing to them instead. Shiv asks her and the kids to wait outside and thrashes the goons in the restaurant himself, revealing himself to be SPD Parshuram, a special task officer who is actually working undercover as an insurance agent, along with his dialogue, "Vishnu ke chhathe avatar Parshuram ka hathiyar tha farsa aur Kaliyug ke common man Parshuram ka hathiyar hai Prahar aur yeh chhah chamber wali revolver, (Vishnu's sixth incarnation Parashurama's weapon was an axe, and the common-man Parshuram's weapon is a six-chambered revolver.)" While he attacks, Sheetal, an important leader of the mafia criminal underworld who has had a crush on Shiv from college days, is watching him from behind the scenes. She realizes that Shiv is Parshuram, who had posed a great threat to the underworld for a long time, and resolves to capture and destroy him. She says, "Sheetal and smoking, both are injurious to health." and makes contact with Babbar, a bald-headed gangster and an ally of Kabir, who had also tried to bully Shalini before, to help her destroy both Shiv and Shalini. Babbar's goons kidnap Pihu and Chintu, who are saved by Shiv. As he beats up the goons with his usual 'Parshuram' dialogue, Chintu catches him with his revolver and finds out that his dad is Parshuram. Shiv then requests Chintu not to reveal his identity to anyone, including his mother and sister, though the latter had always come close to accidentally revealing Parshuram's identity, only to be signaled by Shiv himself to keep quiet. A worried Shalini files a kidnapping case against Kabir and slaps him. Understanding her feelings, Parshuram secretly catches Babbar, only to find that the latter had escaped with the help of one of his own colleagues. He catches one of Kabir's goons trying to follow Shalini, Pihu and Chintu in their car for evil intentions and thrashes him. Simultaneously, the Dixits are shocked to find out about Shalini's molestation in the restaurant, the Deshmukh kids' kidnapping and the case against Kabir, their future son-in-law. Malhar, Manish, Omkar and Sankalp Dixit set out to resolve the case with the help of CCTV footage from the same restaurant. They are secretly followed by Agent Balram, Parshuram's teammate and college best friend, at the latter's instructions. Meanwhile, Shalini's mother Deepali and elder sister Adv. Nandini suggest they call of the marriage of Kabir and Aradhya in support of Shiv and Shalini but the rest of the family, including Aradhya herself, refuses. Nandini proposes to be Shalini's lawyer against Kabir. Meanwhile, both Shiv and Shalini face threats by many gangsters, including Sheetal, that they will destroy them and their kids. Others threaten them to withdraw the case against Kabir. Chintu is kidnapped again but is saved by Parshuram. Sankalp Dixit finds out about Parshuram from Chintu but is caught and thrashed by Balram and other colleagues of Parshuram. Sheetal makes an assassination attempt on Shiv during Shalini's dance performance but fails. Babbar also tries to assassinate Shiv but the latter escapes. Meanwhile, Manish and his wife Namrata plan to invite Shalini and Shiv to Aradhya and Kabir's wedding to make Shalini confess about the kidnappings. The proposal is initially rejected by Shalini and Shiv but later, the former is manipulated by Aradhya to come. Shalini becomes increasingly worried for her family's safety and tells Nandini that she quits the case but Nandini encourages her to go forward, saying that the law is with her. Meanwhile, Kabir's father, Karan Kulkarni, enters the picture and warns Shalini to withdraw the case against his son, otherwise she and her family will be burnt alive. On the other hand, Parshuram and Balram discover that Sheetal's actual name is Shikha Talwar, a girl from their college days. During Kabir and Aradhya's wedding, Shalini and the kids arrive. Shiv initially departs from there after dropping them, but later returns. Kabir and Aradhya are happily wed, and Shalini and Shiv are still threatened by Karan to withdraw Kabir's case throughout. After the wedding, Kabir's court case is scheduled. Despite the threats, with Nandini's help, Shalini bravely gives the statement against Kabir, who is then sent to prison for 14 days, until the next court session. In revenge, Karan refuses to let Aradhya inside the house and does not consider her his daughter-in-law. He threatens Malhar that he will destroy the Dixit family. The Dixits, including Aradhya herself, blame Shalini for Aradhya's misfortunes and lash out at her supporters, Deepali, Nandini and Shalini's cousin Bhoomika for encouraging her to jail Kabir. Concerned for Aradhya, Shalini takes Shiv to take Aradhya to her in-laws' house. When they reach, Karan forbids them from entering. Shiv Prasad fights Karan's goons (without Shalini or Aradhya's knowledge) and Shalini sends Aradhya inside after defying Karan. With constant encouragement from Advocate Anjali Awasthi, she defends a girl from a man abusing her in a bus.
reception: In its debut week, The show ranked at tenth spot with a TRP of 1.6 in week 5 of February. In the following week, it got 1.5 TRP. In April 2026, it recorded a rating of 1.4 TRP.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The team shot some action sequences in Manali hills in June 2026. Also, they choreographed a romantic dance scene there. Prior to this, Neil Bhatt performed a 'Shantabai' dance sequence on his own as Shivprasad, which filmed in a single take. The final shooting of the series wrapped up on 30 July 2026.

articleSections.title: Cancellation
articleSections.text: After a time slot change from 8.30 p.m.to early evening 7.00 p.m. slot, due to the low viewership and declining TRPs, the channel pulled the plug on 18 August 2026.

articleSections.title: Crossovers
articleSections.text:
On 12 April 2026, Mr and Mrs Parshuram aired a mahasangam episode called, Action Ka Blockbuster, the episode features Anjali LLB from Advocate Anjali Awasthi defending Kabir before a courtroom confrontation that unveils hidden details and she switches support to Shalini.
On 23 March 2026, Udne Ki Aasha aired a one-hour special episode called, Deshmukh Vs Deshmukh Mahasangam, wherein Sachin from Udne Ki Aasha got to know about Shiv's dual identity as Parshuram and they both keep it hidden from Sailee and Shalini.

plotHtml: Shiv Prasad Deshmukh is a seemingly ordinary middle-class family man in Maharashtra who lives with his courageous wife Shalini, son Harshit "Chintu" and daughter Riddhi "Pihu". Shalini is revealed to be actually the younger daughter of Malhar Dixit and Deepali Dixit from the elite Dixit family, but she had cut contacts with them, eloped with Shiv and married him against their wishes. While Shalini, Shiv and their kids live happily together, the Dixit family plans to marry off Malhar's younger brother Manish Dixit's daughter, Aradhya Dixit, to Kabir Kulkarni, a rich rogue from the Kulkarni family. Though the Dixits are aware of the fact that Kabir is a criminal, they still want to go ahead with the marriage to improve business relations with Kabir's father, and Aradhya also loves him dearly. Meanwhile, Shalini goes for an outing to a restaurant with Shiv and the kids when some of Kabir's goons try to molest her. She slaps them and berates Shiv for not standing up for her and merely apologizing to them instead. Shiv asks her and the kids to wait outside and thrashes the goons in the restaurant himself, revealing himself to be SPD Parshuram, a special task officer who is actually working undercover as an insurance agent, along with his dialogue, "Vishnu ke chhathe avatar Parshuram ka hathiyar tha farsa aur Kaliyug ke common man Parshuram ka hathiyar hai Prahar aur yeh chhah chamber wali revolver, (Vishnu's sixth incarnation Parashurama's weapon was an axe, and the common-man Parshuram's weapon is a six-chambered revolver.)" While he attacks, Sheetal, an important leader of the mafia criminal underworld who has had a crush on Shiv from college days, is watching him from behind the scenes. She realizes that Shiv is Parshuram, who had posed a great threat to the underworld for a long time, and resolves to capture and destroy him. She says, "Sheetal and smoking, both are injurious to health." and makes contact with Babbar, a bald-headed gangster and an ally of Kabir, who had also tried to bully Shalini before, to help her destroy both Shiv and Shalini. Babbar's goons kidnap Pihu and Chintu, who are saved by Shiv. As he beats up the goons with his usual 'Parshuram' dialogue, Chintu catches him with his revolver and finds out that his dad is Parshuram. Shiv then requests Chintu not to reveal his identity to anyone, including his mother and sister, though the latter had always come close to accidentally revealing Parshuram's identity, only to be signaled by Shiv himself to keep quiet. A worried Shalini files a kidnapping case against Kabir and slaps him. Understanding her feelings, Parshuram secretly catches Babbar, only to find that the latter had escaped with the help of one of his own colleagues. He catches one of Kabir's goons trying to follow Shalini, Pihu and Chintu in their car for evil intentions and thrashes him. Simultaneously, the Dixits are shocked to find out about Shalini's molestation in the restaurant, the Deshmukh kids' kidnapping and the case against Kabir, their future son-in-law. Malhar, Manish, Omkar and Sankalp Dixit set out to resolve the case with the help of CCTV footage from the same restaurant. They are secretly followed by Agent Balram, Parshuram's teammate and college best friend, at the latter's instructions. Meanwhile, Shalini's mother Deepali and elder sister Adv. Nandini suggest they call of the marriage of Kabir and Aradhya in support of Shiv and Shalini but the rest of the family, including Aradhya herself, refuses. Nandini proposes to be Shalini's lawyer against Kabir. Meanwhile, both Shiv and Shalini face threats by many gangsters, including Sheetal, that they will destroy them and their kids. Others threaten them to withdraw the case against Kabir. Chintu is kidnapped again but is saved by Parshuram. Sankalp Dixit finds out about Parshuram from Chintu but is caught and thrashed by Balram and other colleagues of Parshuram. Sheetal makes an assassination attempt on Shiv during Shalini's dance performance but fails. Babbar also tries to assassinate Shiv but the latter escapes. Meanwhile, Manish and his wife Namrata plan to invite Shalini and Shiv to Aradhya and Kabir's wedding to make Shalini confess about the kidnappings. The proposal is initially rejected by Shalini and Shiv but later, the former is manipulated by Aradhya to come. Shalini becomes increasingly worried for her family's safety and tells Nandini that she quits the case but Nandini encourages her to go forward, saying that the law is with her. Meanwhile, Kabir's father, Karan Kulkarni, enters the picture and warns Shalini to withdraw the case against his son, otherwise she and her family will be burnt alive. On the other hand, Parshuram and Balram discover that Sheetal's actual name is Shikha Talwar, a girl from their college days. During Kabir and Aradhya's wedding, Shalini and the kids arrive. Shiv initially departs from there after dropping them, but later returns. Kabir and Aradhya are happily wed, and Shalini and Shiv are still threatened by Karan to withdraw Kabir's case throughout. After the wedding, Kabir's court case is scheduled. Despite the threats, with Nandini's help, Shalini bravely gives the statement against Kabir, who is then sent to prison for 14 days, until the next court session. In revenge, Karan refuses to let Aradhya inside the house and does not consider her his daughter-in-law. He threatens Malhar that he will destroy the Dixit family. The Dixits, including Aradhya herself, blame Shalini for Aradhya's misfortunes and lash out at her supporters, Deepali, Nandini and Shalini's cousin Bhoomika for encouraging her to jail Kabir. Concerned for Aradhya, Shalini takes Shiv to take Aradhya to her in-laws' house. When they reach, Karan forbids them from entering. Shiv Prasad fights Karan's goons (without Shalini or Aradhya's knowledge) and Shalini sends Aradhya inside after defying Karan. With constant encouragement from Advocate Anjali Awasthi, she defends a girl from a man abusing her in a bus.
tagline: Shiv Prasad Deshmukh, a humble family man, reveals his secret life as a fierce undercover officer to protect his loved ones from a dangerous alliance.

title: Manam
summary:
Manam (transl. Mind) is a 2026 Malaysian Tamil-language Melodrama television series screenplay, written and produced by Seelan Manoheran, directed by SD Puvanendran, starring Jayshree, Surrya Prakash, Subashini, Seelan Manoheran, Mathialagan and Ashwini Nambiar in the lead roles. The show is an official remake of Astro Ria's Malay series Layang-Layang Perkahwinan.
It tells a story of a married couple whose unravels when betrayal, lies, and hidden crimes surface betrayal of one another leads to a whirlwind of revenge, grief, motherhood, survival, forgiveness and healing. It aired on Astro Vinmeen HD on Monday to Thursday at 21:30 (MST) from 2 February to 30 March 2026, and ended with 34 episodes, and is also available on the digital platforms Astro GO and Sooka.
plot:
The story follows Sheena, who is the perfect wife to Varun, who supports her husband Varun’s ascent to top leadership within the company. While juggling her roles as a caring mother, loving wife and responsible daughter-in-law, Sheena keeps the household running seamlessly, even as she manages the pressures of her own career. However, Sheena doesn't realize that she has been cheated on by Varun.
Confronted by Varun’s infidelity, Sheena finds the courage to stand up for herself, even in the face of severe consequences from her influential in-law family. Sheena fights for her dignity, freedom and decides to divorce and meticulously plans her revenge.

And also Astro’s second consecutive Malay to Tamil adaptation after Aadhira series.

articleSections.text:
Actor Surrya Prakash was cast as the male lead Varun, who cheats on his wife and for his notable performance in Dejavu 375, Yaar Avan and Iraivi Thirumagal Kaadu.
Actress Jayshree plays the lead role as Leena in the series. Subashini was played as Sumi, who is an aiffiar with Varun and trun to his second wife. Actor Seelan Manoheran, who produced and wrote the series, also plays the role of Amar, as Leena's well-wisher. Actor Mathialagan and Ashwini Nambiar portrayed Selvanayagam and Leela, the parents of Varun.

title: Mahadev & Sons
summary: Mahadev & Sons is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that aired on 5 January 2026 on Colors TV and digitally available on JioHotstar. Produced by Saurabh Tewari under Parin Multimedia, it stars Shakti Anand, Sneha Wagh and Manasi Salvi. The series is an official adaptation of Star Vijay's Tamil series Pandian Stores 2.
plot:
Mahadev, an orphan, works as a servant in the house of the Bajpai family, the owners of Bajpai Brick Kiln. Their elder daughter, Bhanu is deeply attached to her younger sister, Vidya.
10 years later, he elopes with Vidya. After some time, Bhanu's wedding is fixed to a man named Madhav, who angers her by talking about Vidya and Mahadev. Later, she swears that she will never get married until she sees Mahadev's funeral. Due to this, their father, Omprakash Bajpai goes in a dilemma and dies.
25 years later, Vidya and Mahadev live in a wealthy family, and have 5 children: Ashish, Kamakshi, Ketan, Dheeraj, and Priya. Bhanu prays for Mahadev's demise wih her brother Yash, while their youngest son, Dheeraj, wants his family to celebrate their 25th anniversary, and brings a poster along with his uncle, Satya. Seeing this, Mahadev gets angered and throws the poster, which lands at Bhanu's house and destroys her cake. Because of this, they both fight outside their houses, and Mahadev decides to celebrate their 25th anniversary. Bhanu tells the people coming to their anniversary to eat her birthday cake first. Mahadev is heartbroken when no one comes to his celebration.
Later, Ketan secretly steals money from Mahadev's rice mill to get a gift for his girlfriend, Narmada, which Dheeraj is blamed for. Ashish is also heartbroken after he sees his girlfriend Madhu married to someone else, which makes Ashish get himself drunk. Mahadev is shocked to see this, and he soon asks a priest to find brides for their 3 sons. Dheeraj later ensures Ketan that he will be married to Narmada. Ashish comes home drunk once more, which makes his dad angry, and as a result of this Ashish is beaten up. Dheeraj goes to Narmada's house, and talks to her father, Ramesh Saini. He later tells Mahadev about Ketan, who also gets beaten up. Mahadev later tells that no one in the house will have a love marriage. Due to this, Ketan tells Narmada to move on and forget him, which shatters her. Later, Narmada comes to their house, and they later plan to elope and marry. Dheeraj assures his brother's marriage.
The next day, they both go to the temple to marry each other, which Bhanu and her foster daughter Rajji see, who call Mahadev asking for help with rice bags. Mahadev and Vidya come and are shocked to see their marriage. Bhanu provokes Mahadev, while Dheeraj tells Ketan to stay strong. After they find out Dheeraj was behind the marriage, Mahadev ruthlessly kicks Dheeraj out of the house. He later spends the night alone on a bench.
Narmada later tells Rajji to help her in finding Dheeraj. Bhanu later lies to Mahadev that Vidya is secretly betraying him, who asks her to choose between him or Dheeraj. Yash and Ramesh secretly plot against Dheeraj, and send goons to stab Dheeraj.Their plan succeeds and Dheeraj is sent to the hospital.Vidya warns Mahadev that she would never forgive him if something happens to Dheeraj and Mahadev eventually realises his mistakes. He asks Dheeraj for forgiveness and the family reunites. Mahadev, being certain that Yash and Bhanu had some hand in Dheeraj's planned attack, files FIR against them. Bhanu proves Yash and herself innocent while proving Ramesh responsible for the entire attack leading to his arrest. This causes friction between Narmada and the family with Vidya saying she would never become a family member odlf their house, while Dheeraj promises he would give Narmada her rightful place in the family.
Elsewhere, Rajji is in love with Kalyan, a fraudster and criminal who is playing love game with her with the evil intention of selling her to some goons. Even after warnings from Dheeraj, she keeps believing in Kalyan. One day Dheeraj overheard Kalyan promising the goons to deliver Rajji to them by the college fest. He tries to tell Rajji the truth but she misunderstands that he is intentionally trying to create friction between the two. Helpless Dheeraj tells about Rajji's love affair to his grandmother and Bhanu warning them about Kalyan's plan to sell Rajji

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: In November 2025, Colors TV unveiled a teaser introducing the new show titled Mahadev & Sons.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Shakti Anand was selected to portray Mahadev. Sneha Wagh was cast as Vidya. In May 2026, Salvi who played Bhanu quit the series, due to internal conflict with the makers.

episodesList.title: The Journey of Mahadev, Vidya
episodesList.summary: Once inseparable sisters, Bhanu and Vidya are torn apart when Vidya marries Mahadev. Will Vidya and Mahadev stay united and overcome the challenges ahead?

episodesList.title: Bhanu Draws the Battle Line
episodesList.summary: Twenty-five years later, Bhanu performs a pooja, praying for Mahadev's downfall. Later, she openly challenges Mahadev to see whose celebration draws a bigger crowd.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj's Grand Announcement
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj openly mocks the challenge and announces a lavish anniversary celebration. Later Mahadev and Bhanu's families unexpectedly come face to face at the same temple.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Empty Celebration
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and Bhanu's families pray together before exchanging taunts about future separations. Later, Mahadev emotionally reveals he's an orphan as no guests attend his anniversary.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Fears Family Divide
episodesList.summary: Mahadev lashes out at Bhanu for serving meat and alcohol at her home. Later, Mahadev shares his fear with Vidya about a daughter-in-law breaking the family apart.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Blamed For Ketan's Crime
episodesList.summary: Ketan secretly steals money from Mahadev to buy a gift for Narmada. Later, Mahadev wrongly accuses Dheeraj of theft, leaving him devastated as he chooses to hide Ketan's truth.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Confronts Mahadev's Family
episodesList.summary: Mahadev explains to Vidya why he is strict with his sons to make them strong. Later, Bhanu enters Mahadev's house aggressively with her family and Rajji, reopening old tensions.

episodesList.title: Rajji's Misunderstood Truth
episodesList.summary: Mahadev beats Dheeraj after Rajji reveals the truth of the letter, Dheeraj vows to marry per his wishes. Later, Bhanu confronts Rajji while Radha predicts romance ahead.

episodesList.title: Satya Confronts Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Satya questions Mahadev why he didn't let their sons marry by choice despite his love marriage with Vidya. Later, Bhanu asks Rajji why she stayed calm when Ashish teased her.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Defends Priya
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj urges Ketan to tell Mahadev about his relationship with Narmada, while Radha reminisces about her childhood with Vidya. Later, Bhanu fights off the goons harassing Priya.

episodesList.title: Narmada Faces Alliance Trouble
episodesList.summary: Narmada grows anxious as her parents discuss her marriage alliance. Later, Ketan boldly proposes a clever plan to help Narmada send the prospective suitors away.

episodesList.title: Ashish Endures Heartbreak
episodesList.summary: Narmada firmly instructs Ketan to discuss their marriage with Mahadev. Meanwhile, Ashish feels heartbroken seeing Madhu married and gets drunk, while Bhanu spies on him.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Plots Her Revenge
episodesList.summary: Tension heightens at home when Mahadev and Vidya find Ashish drunk. Later, Mahadev winces in pain as he recalls Bhanu's words, while she plots to destroy his sons.

episodesList.title: Vidya Learns Ashish's Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Rajji firmly confirms to Dheeraj that she hasn't shared Ashish's video with anyone but him. Later, Dheeraj reveals to Vidya that Ashish sacrificed his love for Mahadev's respect.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Move Stuns His Sons
episodesList.summary: Ketan, Dheeraj and Ashish are stunned when Mahadev asks Panditji to find brides for them. Later, Dheeraj promises Narmada he will ensure her wedding with Ketan happens.

episodesList.title: Ashish Faces Mahadev's Wrath
episodesList.summary: As Mahadev slaps Ashish for returning home drunk yet again, Dheeraj spins a false story to cover it up. Elsewhere, Bhanu urges Rajji to keep a close watch on Dheeraj secretly.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Blocks The Alliance
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj tells Mr. Saini about Narmada and Ketan's love and urges him to speak to Mahadev about them. Later, Bhanu warns Mr Saini against arranging Narmada's alliance with Ketan.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Firm Guidance
episodesList.summary: Mr. Saini insults Mahadev, claiming Ketan trapped Narmada. Later, Mahadev urges his children to follow his guidance, while Vidya asks Ketan to forget Narmada.

episodesList.title: Ketan's Words Break Narmada
episodesList.summary: At night, Mahadev helps Rajji when her scooty breaks down on the road. Meanwhile, Ketan gently asks Narmada to move on and forget him, leaving her shattered.

episodesList.title: Narmada, Ketan's Secret Plan
episodesList.summary: Ketan and Narmada plan to elope and marry. Later, as Ketan and Dheeraj attempt to flee to meet Narmada, Mahadev intervenes.

episodesList.title: Bhanu's Shocking Discovery
episodesList.summary: Bhanu arrives at the temple to find Dheeraj helping Ketan and Narmada marry. Later, Rajji calls Mahadev to the temple by asking for help with rice bags to expose the truth.

episodesList.title: Ketan and Narmada's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Narmada feels remorse for betraying her parents and marrying without their consent. Later, Ketan completes the ritual as Mahadev and Vidya are shocked to witness the marriage.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Stands By Ketan
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj urges Ketan to stay strong and face Mahadev, reminding him of Narmada's support. Later, Bhanu's family grandly welcomes Ketan and Narmada, provoking Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Ruthless Authority
episodesList.summary: Mahadev forcefully throws Dheeraj out after a bitter clash and disowns him. Watching this, Bhanu foresees the inevitable downfall of Mahadev's entire family.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj's Night Of Despair
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj spends the night alone on a bench, hoping Mahadev will call him home. Meanwhile, Bhanu secretly plots to disturb Mahadev's family peace.

episodesList.title: Narmada Seeks Shelter
episodesList.summary: Narmada hopes for acceptance as Mahadev gives her refuge. Later, he protects her from Ramesh's rage, deepening the family conflict.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Support For Narmada
episodesList.summary: Mahadev stands up for Narmada when Kamakshi tries to humiliate her. Later, Vidya is lost in thoughts about Dheeraj as the family gathers for the morning Aarti.

episodesList.title: Narmada Turns to Rajji For Help
episodesList.summary: Narmada seeks Rajji's help in finding Dheeraj and bringing him back home. Later, Bhanu watches Narmada's efforts for the family and vows to tear them apart.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Ultimatum to Vidya
episodesList.summary: Bhanu provokes Mahadev's anger by claiming that Vidya is betraying him. Later, Mahadev confronts Vidya and gives her an ultimatum to choose between him and Dheeraj.

episodesList.title: Yash, Ramesh's Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Yash and Ramesh plot against Dheeraj by sending goons who attack and stab him. Tensions rise as Mahadev and the family learn of the attack and rush to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Seeks Dheeraj's Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Mahadev saves Dheeraj with his blood and apologises as he recovers. Later, Dheeraj reminds him of his expulsion, while Mahadev moves to track down the attackers.

episodesList.title: Ketan and Vishwa's Heated Clash
episodesList.summary: Ketan and Vishwa fight over Narmada crossing the line, while Bhanu urges Vishwa to apologise. Later, Dheeraj tells Narmada about Mahadev's struggles after marrying Vidya.

episodesList.title: Narmada Assists Vidya
episodesList.summary: Narmada feels grateful to Vidya and Mahadev for being gracious in-laws. Later, Narmada helps Vidya in convincing Mahadev to perform the Rudra Abhishek Puja.

episodesList.title: Rajji Stands Against Mahadev
episodesList.summary: The police arrest Bhanu and Yash over Mahadev's complaint for attacking Dheeraj. Later, Bhanu provokes Rajji, who confronts Mahadev over the allegations against Bhanu.

episodesList.title: Mahadev, Vidya's Valentine Vibes
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and Vidya join the family to dance and celebrate Valentine's Day with joy and fun. Later, Vidya consoles an upset Narmada as her parents ignore her calls.

episodesList.title: Saini's Dark Secret
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and the family celebrate Maha Shivratri. Later, they are shocked as the police bring Mr. Saini, revealing that he was behind the attack on Dheeraj.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj's Promise to Narmada
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj vows to restore Narmada's rightful respect and reunite her with the family. Later, Narmada strives to win back her family's acceptance.

episodesList.title: Kalyan's Evil Plot Against Rajji
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj overhears Kalyan plotting to traffic Rajji. Later, Narmada's mother arrives at Mahadev's house seeking help for Mr. Saini, but suddenly suffers from seizures.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj's Brave Confession
episodesList.summary: Kamakshi accuses and insults Narmada's mother of robbery. Later, following Narmada's advice, Dheeraj confides in Radha about Kalyan's plot against Rajji.

episodesList.title: Rajji in Danger?
episodesList.summary: Ketan insists Narmada seek Mahadev's permission before rejoining the job. Later, at the party, Kalyan tampers with Rajji's drink and tries to abduct her, but Dheeraj follows him.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Rescues Rajji
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj saves Rajji from Kalyan's abduction attempt. Later, Vidya calls Bhanu to assure her that Rajji is safe and will stay with her for the night.

episodesList.title: Rajji Faces Bhanu's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj struggles to manage an intoxicated Rajji. Later, a furious Bhanu lashes out at Rajji over her bond with Kalyan and prevents her from attending college.

episodesList.title: Rajji Faces Alliance Trouble
episodesList.summary: As an alliance suitor arrives to see Rajji, Kalyan boldly confesses his love for Rajji before everyone. Meanwhile, Narmada seeks permission from Mahadev to take a job.

episodesList.title: Holi Happiness at Mahadev's Home
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and Vidya feel happy seeing Ketan play Holi after years. As the festivities begin, a lively Antakshari competition kicks off between Mahadev and Bhanu's families.

episodesList.title: Rajji's Accusation Causes a Rift
episodesList.summary: Rajji falsely accuses Dheeraj of forcefully applying colour on her, sparking a clash. Later, Bhanu feels happy when Rajji elopes with Kalyan, making her plan succeed.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Walks Into a Trap
episodesList.summary: Bhanu alerts the police about illegal activity at a hotel as Dheeraj and Vidya search for Rajji. Later, a raid finds Dheeraj with a disoriented Rajji, sparking a misunderstanding.

episodesList.title: Rajji, Dheeraj Get Married
episodesList.summary: At Vidya's request, Dheeraj and Rajji tie the knot at a temple. Later, Dheeraj insists on keeping Vidya's role in his marriage with Rajji a secret from Mahadev.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and the family are left stunned to learn that Dheeraj and Rajji are married. Later, Vidya decides to tell Mahadev the truth, but Narmada reminds her of the vow to Dheeraj.

episodesList.title: Vidya's Inner Conflict
episodesList.summary: Vidya scolds Ketan and Kamakshi for eavesdropping on Dheeraj and Rajji. Later, she expresses her guilt to Dheeraj for hiding the truth and letting him take the blame.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Questions Vidya's Parenting
episodesList.summary: Mahadev fumes at Vidya for siding with Dheeraj, who repeatedly risks the family's honour. Later, Dheeraj confronts Vidya for forcing him to marry Rajji to protect Bhanu's respect.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Manipulates Rajji
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj confronts Rajji for trying to slip out of the house secretly. Bhanu then emotionally blackmails Rajji to stay at Mahadev's house and take revenge on him.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Suspects Rajji's Intents
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj shares his suspicions with Vidya about Rajji's intentions after meeting Bhanu. Soon after, he feels nervous about his wedding night with Rajji.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Regrets Dheeraj's Actions
episodesList.summary: Rajji tells Mahadev her marriage to Dheeraj was her own wish, while Mahadev regrets Dheeraj's disobedience. Rajji recalls memories with Bhanu as Vidya selects a saree for her.

episodesList.title: Vidya Stands Up for Dheeraj
episodesList.summary: Rajji takes the money Mahadev entrusted to Vidya, sparking suspicion. As Mahadev accuses Dheeraj of stealing from the mill locker, Vidya firmly defends him.

episodesList.title: Vishwa's Deadly Plot
episodesList.summary: Narmada confronts Ketan for buying gifts with stolen money and later comforts Rajji with festival memories. Meanwhile, Vishwa secretly schemes to kill Dheeraj.

episodesList.title: Vidya's Belief in Rajji
episodesList.summary: Mahadev announces the names for puja blessings, deliberately omitting Dheeraj and Rajji. Vidya expresses faith that Rajji will bring happiness to their family.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Eases Ashish's Pain
episodesList.summary: A game of tug of war turns emotional as Vidya and Bhanu relive their treasured memories. Elsewhere, Dheeraj consoles Ashish as he breaks down after seeing Madhu.

episodesList.title: Bhanu's Outburst at Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and his sons win the Best Parivaar award, but before the ceremony, Bhanu humiliates Mahadev and Rajji. Vidya comforts Rajji, who is upset by Bhanu's words.

episodesList.title: Rajji Stands Fearless for Dheeraj
episodesList.summary: Rajji bravely stops Vishwa from stabbing Dheeraj, but Vishwa shoots him instead. While Vidya worries about Dheeraj, Rajji rushes a wounded Dheeraj to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Vidya Fumes at Vishwa
episodesList.summary: Ketan reveals to Vidya that Vishwa tried to kill Dheeraj and shot him. Vishwa faces Vidya's wrath, and Bhanu confides in Vidya that she was unaware of Vishwa's attack on Dheeraj.

episodesList.title: Vidya Seeks Dheeraj's Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Mahadev's cold detachment after Dheeraj's betrayal makes him distant from the family. Vidya tearfully apologises to Dheeraj, blaming herself for his forced marriage to Rajji.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Silent Care for Dheeraj
episodesList.summary: Rajji watches Mahadev, secretly showing deep concern for Dheeraj. Then, Mahadev angrily confronts Vishwa for attacking Dheeraj and sternly warns Yash to control Vishwa.

episodesList.title: Narmada's Matchmaking Plan
episodesList.summary: Bhanu reveals the truth about Ashish and his girlfriend to Mahadev. Narmada and Vidya try to unite Dheeraj and Rajji, but Dheeraj calls out Rajji for faking concern.

episodesList.title: Kalyan Breaks Rajji's Heart
episodesList.summary: Rajji is heartbroken after discovering Kalyan used her for money. Dheeraj comforts her as she struggles to cope with the pain of Kalyan's betrayal.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Sparks Family Tension
episodesList.summary: Vidya is stunned to see Rajji and Dheeraj together and explains the significance of the Mangalsutra. Bhanu exposes and insults Mahadev, warning Arpita's father about the relation.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Accuses Dheeraj of Theft
episodesList.summary: Mahadev holds Dheeraj and Ketan responsible for Ashish's broken alliance. Rajji informs Bhanu of Kalyan's jewellery theft, but Bhanu plots to frame Dheeraj for stealing it.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Bhanu accuses Dheeraj of stealing jewellery from her house, and he accepts his crime, hiding the truth from Mahadev. Later, Bhanu gets Mahadev arrested from his mill.

episodesList.title: Rajji's Plea to Bhanu
episodesList.summary: Mahadev accepts the accusations and feels guilty for not raising Dheeraj well. Bhanu refuses Rajji's request to withdraw the false complaint against Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Bhanu's Bold Ultimatum to Rajji
episodesList.summary: Rajji urges Bhanu to revoke the FIR against Mahadev. Bhanu stuns everyone by demanding that she will retract it only if Rajji and Dheeraj break their marriage.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Faces Tough Questions
episodesList.summary: Mahadev feels heartbroken by the humiliation and holds Dheeraj and Rajji responsible for it. Dheeraj struggles to answer as Ketan and Ashish press him about the missing jewellery.

episodesList.title: Rajji Confesses Her Guilt to Vidya
episodesList.summary: Rajji expresses guilt and regret to Vidya, revealing that she went out to search for Kalyan. Soon, Mahadev shares with Vidya about taking Ashish to the Swayamvar.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Caught in Kalyan's Scheme
episodesList.summary: Mogra and her mother spring into action when goons tease her. With no other option, Rajji strikes Dheeraj on the head, rendering him unconscious as part of Kalyan's plan.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj, Rajji Shield Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Mogra and Ashish's alliance is finalised. The police arrive to arrest Mahadev for failing to produce Bhanu's jewellery, but Dheeraj and Rajji arrive in time and save him.

episodesList.title: Rajji Wins Vidya's Heart
episodesList.summary: Seeing the family happy, Vidya thanks Rajji for protecting Mahadev's reputation. Soon after, Rajji joins Narmada to uncover the truth about Mogra's family.

episodesList.title: Lajwanti's Trap Seals Ashish's Fate
episodesList.summary: Lajwanti manipulates every move, pushing Mahadev to fix Ashish's wedding with Mogra. While the family celebrates, Rajji and Narmada secretly decide to uncover the truth.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj's Apology to Narmada
episodesList.summary: Mogra and her family grow fearful seeing Sikander at their house. Rajji makes Dheeraj realise his mistake, and he apologises to Narmada for hurting her feelings.

episodesList.title: Sikander Kidnaps Narmada
episodesList.summary: Narmada's search for answers takes a dark turn when she encounters Sikander at Mogra's house and is kidnapped. Yash and Kiran are exposed when Mahadev recognises them.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Faces Shocking Kidnap Call
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise in the family as Mahadev accuses Bhanu of kidnapping Narmada. Mahadev receives a call from Sikander, who blackmails him and demands ten lakhs for Narmada's release.

episodesList.title: Narmada's Brave Act
episodesList.summary: Mahadev fails to rescue Narmada as the kidnappers escape. Narmada fights the kidnappers fiercely as Dheeraj and Rajji overpower them, freeing her.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Faces a Harsh Reality
episodesList.summary: Narmada returns home, unaware that Mogra and Sikander are plotting something dangerous. Trying to take responsibility, Dheeraj faces a crushing setback when he doesn't get a job.

episodesList.title: Rajji's Job Sparks Chaos
episodesList.summary: Lajwanti trains Mogra on how to talk with Ashish and keep him under control. Tensions rise as Bhanu storms into Mahadev's house, accusing him of making Rajji work as a waiter.

episodesList.title: Maddy Enters the House
episodesList.summary: Mahadev supports Narmada's wish to work, leaving her emotional. Meanwhile, Radha urges Bhanu to treat Maddy with warmth as a valued guest.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Plots to Ruin the Wedding
episodesList.summary: Narmada grows suspicious of Mogra as Mahadev fixes the wedding and pushes for shared expenses. Meanwhile, Bhanu tries to sabotage the alliance.

episodesList.title: Rajji Confronts Bhanu
episodesList.summary: Mahadev apologises to Ashish for breaking his promise about the alliance with Mogra. Rajji confronts Bhanu, demanding the reason for her revenge against Mahadev's family.

episodesList.title: Ashish's Arrest Halts the Wedding
episodesList.summary: Rajji is shattered by Dheeraj's cold behaviour as Mahadev tries to fix Ashish's wedding. However, the wedding gets called off when Ashish is arrested for hitting Vishwa.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Severs Ties With Rajji
episodesList.summary: Bhanu withdraws her FIR against Ashish and breaks all ties with Rajji, leaving her heartbroken. Mogra and Lajwanti visit Mahadev's home to arrange her alliance with Ashish.

episodesList.title: Rajji Stands Up for Dheeraj
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise at Ashish and Mogra's engagement as Narmada grows suspicious over a ring. Shock spreads when Dheeraj is seen in a humiliating situation, but Rajji defends him.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Gets Mahadev's Approval
episodesList.summary: Bhanu disrupts Ashish and Mogra's engagement by assaulting Maddy and causing chaos. Later, Mahadev allows Dheeraj to attend the wedding, warning him not to break his trust.
