episodesList.summary: Vikrant asks Mannat to prepare food for his parents at their welcome party, saying it's her one chance to showcase her talent and secure a job at his restaurant.

episodesList.title: Mannat Faces a Disaster
episodesList.summary: As Mannat and her team prepare a feast for Vikrant's parents, Mallika enters the kitchen to shoot videos and accidentally ruins the cake. How will Mannat fix the situation?

episodesList.title: Mannat Impresses Everyone
episodesList.summary: Mannat quickly crafts a new dessert for dinner, impressing Vikrant's parents and Aish with her skill. However, Aish is surprised to learn that Mannat prepared the food.

episodesList.title: Aish Brings Mannat Onboard
episodesList.summary: Shruti is stunned to discover that Aish is Sonia. Aish seethes with rage as Mallika's request forces her to hire Mannat. Will Shruti let Mannat work under Aish?

episodesList.title: Shruti Warns Mannat!
episodesList.summary: While Shruti holds back from telling Mannat that Aish is her mother, she cautions her against accepting Aish's job offer. Will Mannat heed her warning?

episodesList.title: Mannat Feels Optimistic
episodesList.summary: Mannat is thrilled and hopeful as she prepares for her first day at work, while Puneet schemes to cause trouble for her upon her arrival. Will he succeed in his evil aim?

episodesList.title: Aish to Ruin Mannat's Dreams
episodesList.summary: While Puneet troubles Mannat at work, she remains determined to fulfil her duties. Noticing Mannat's ambition, Aish grows furious and vows to shatter her dreams.

episodesList.title: Aish's Sinister Plan
episodesList.summary: While Vikrant prepares to welcome the food inspector, Aish secretly spikes Mannat's coffee to create trouble. As the inspection progresses, Mannat begins to behave strangely.

episodesList.title: Mannat Causes a Scene
episodesList.summary: Aish's plan succeeds as an intoxicated Mannat causes a scene before Mrs Barman. Vikrant is ashamed of Mannat's behaviour and ejects her from Mezbaani.

episodesList.title: Puneet Suspects Aishwarya's Actions
episodesList.summary: Puneet suspects Aishwarya after noticing her behaviour following the shocking incident at Mezbaani. Mallika advises Mannat to apologise to Vikrant for her mistakes.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Takes The Heat!
episodesList.summary: Vikrant faces Puneet's wrath for the chaos Mannat created. Meanwhile, Mannat sets out to find the proof she needs to clear her name. Will she succeed in uncovering the truth?

episodesList.title: Mannat Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Mannat finds a discarded bottle of cheap liquor and traces it to the shop where it was bought. She discovers Aish purchased it but chooses to keep it from Mallika.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Desperate Attempt
episodesList.summary: Mannat eagerly visits Mrs Barman's office and waits to convince her to approve. Later, Aish emotionally manipulates Vikrant into agreeing to open the restaurant in Singapore.

episodesList.title: Mannat to Impress Mrs Barman
episodesList.summary: Aishwarya informs the media about the chaos at Saluja's restaurant and the cancellation of its food license. Wanting to impress Mrs. Barman, Mannat prepares a French dish.

episodesList.title: Mannat Secures Second Chance!
episodesList.summary: Thanks to Mannat's persistence, Mrs. Burman agrees to a second inspection rather than cancelling Vikrant's restaurant. How will Vikrant react to this news?

episodesList.title: Aish Questions Mannat
episodesList.summary: Furious to see Mannat back in the restaurant kitchen, Aish tries to force her out. But Mannat stands her ground, revealing she knows who tried to frame her.

episodesList.title: Mannat Gives a Brilliant Idea!
episodesList.summary: For Mrs Burman's inspection, Mannat presents a Valentine's Day-themed menu. Vikrant, impressed by the idea, gives his approval. Will they leave a lasting impression on Mrs Burman?

episodesList.title: Mannat Gets Punished
episodesList.summary: Puneet is furious at Mannat for using her phone at work and punishes her with extra tasks. Later, she and Vikrant share a lighthearted moment in the kitchen.

episodesList.title: Mannat Faces a Tragedy
episodesList.summary: Mannat rushes an unconscious Shruti to the hospital, where the doctor warns her that she must find a donor for Shruti immediately. Can Mannat save Shruti?

episodesList.title: Mannat Searches For Sonia
episodesList.summary: Mannat learns that Shruti is desperately searching for her sister, Sonia, and decides to help. However, she is unaware that Sonia has changed her name to Aishwarya.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Rejects Mallika
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Mallika are shocked when Aishwarya unexpectedly announces their engagement to the media. However, Vikrant dismisses the press and firmly refuses to marry Mallika.

episodesList.title: Mallika Rebukes Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat helps Vikrant realise his mistake in lashing out at Mallika, but Mallika misinterprets their closeness. Later, she accuses Mannat of trying to woo Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Aish's Ruthless Attack
episodesList.summary: Vikrant confronts Aish, insisting that he has no feelings for Mallika. Aish viciously attacks Mannat and traps her inside the cold storage. What fate awaits Mannat?

episodesList.title: Race Against Time
episodesList.summary: On Shivratri, Mannat regains consciousness but struggles to open the freezer. Vikrant reaches the godown, while a tense Aish fears being caught.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Rescues Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant rescues Mannat and takes her home, leaving Aish anxious about being exposed. Meanwhile, Shruti arrives at the Saluja house in disguise and comes face to face with Aish.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Hits Puneet
episodesList.summary: Mannat tells Vikrant that Puneet called her early in the morning. Enraged, Vikrant confronts Puneet and hits him for trying to harm her.

episodesList.title: A Photo Unveils The Truth
episodesList.summary: Mannat apologizes to Puneet for missing his message. Later, she finds a photo of the fake mother planted by Shruti and realizes the woman has passed away.

episodesList.title: Aish Faces Her Past
episodesList.summary: On Women's Day, Aish discovers that the daughter she abandoned 23 years ago is alive.

episodesList.title: Shruti Threatens Aish
episodesList.summary: Shruti warns Aish to stay away from her family or she will reveal her secret. Meanwhile, Mannat refuses to attend the Holi party.

episodesList.title: Vikrant is Smitten By Mannat
episodesList.summary: Everyone arrives at the Holi celebration venue, where a romantic moment unfolds between Mannat and Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Holika Dahan Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Holika Dahan celebrations begin as Mannat stuns everyone in Aish's saree. Meanwhile, Aish reaches Shruti's chawl and is about to set her house on fire.

episodesList.title: Aish Sets Shruti's House On Fire
episodesList.summary: Aish sets Shruti's house on fire. Vikrant gets glimpses of his past and feels disturbed. Mannat rushes to help.

episodesList.title: Aish Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Shruti gets burnt, and Mannat rushes to save her. Aish discovers that Mannat is the daughter she had abandoned.

episodesList.title: Mannat is Left Homeless
episodesList.summary: Shruti fights for her life in the ICU, while Mannat gets ousted from her chawl. Vikrant steps in to support her.

episodesList.title: Aish Fails, Mannat Fights
episodesList.summary: Aish tries to kill Shruti but fails as Vikrant arrives. Mannat returns to work, needing money for Shruti’s treatment.

episodesList.title: Goons Attack Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat is attacked by goons, but Vikrant arrives just in time to save her. Will this incident bring them closer or create new complications?

episodesList.title: Mannat Enters The Lioness's Den
episodesList.summary: Vikrant brings Mannat to the Saluja residence, but Aish, furious, forces her to stay as staff in the outhouse. Will Mannat tolerate this humiliation or fight back?

episodesList.title: Mannat Discovers The Truth
episodesList.summary: Mannat discovers that Shruti deceived her by introducing a fake mother to stop her from finding her real one.

episodesList.title: Aish is Scared
episodesList.summary: Mannat requests leave to investigate Sonia Khanna, leaving Aish shocked because she is Sonia Khanna.

episodesList.title: Aish Traps Mannat
episodesList.summary: Aish traps Mannat in the plane's washroom to reach Ambala School before Mannat and Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Aish Misleads Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat discovers helper Sunita is actually Sonia Khanna, a deception planned by Aish.

episodesList.title: Mannat Faces The Truth
episodesList.summary: Sunita deceives Mannat by claiming to be Sonia Khanna, while Aish feels relieved.

episodesList.title: Mannat is Framed
episodesList.summary: Neetu and Raveena falsely accuse Mannat of stealing Raveena's diamond bangle, putting her in a tough spot. Will Mannat be able to prove her innocence?

episodesList.title: Mannat Proves Her Innocence
episodesList.summary: Mannat proves her innocence and decides to leave the Saluja house.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Doesn't Let Mannat Leave
episodesList.summary: Vikrant demands Mannat clear her debts before leaving, while Bobby sets his sights on her.

episodesList.title: Shalini is Assaulted
episodesList.summary: Shalini is assaulted by Bobby. Mannat rescues her and takes her to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Mannat Confronts Aish
episodesList.summary: Mannat tells Aish she will not stay silent and will fight for Shalini's justice.

episodesList.title: Mannat is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Vikrant stands by Mannat in her fight for Shalini’s justice but when Shalini refuses to speak up, Mannat is left heartbroken.

episodesList.title: Mannat Speaks The Truth
episodesList.summary: When confronted by the press, Mannat reveals that Shalini was molested at Mezbaani, leaving Aish furious.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Snaps At Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant, shattered by Mezbaani’s scandal, blames Mannat for involving the press, while she fights to prove her innocence.

episodesList.title: Mannat is Shattered
episodesList.summary: Mannat is upset as Sunita’s liver doesn’t match Shruti’s. Aish gets Derrick arrested for assaulting Shalini.

episodesList.title: Shalini's Fear Raises Doubts
episodesList.summary: Shalini panics after seeing Bobby on TV, and Mannat notices. She tells Vikrant that Derrick might not be the real culprit.

episodesList.title: Mannat Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Mannat realises Bobby molested Shalini and secretly steals his passport to stop him from fleeing the country.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Lashes Out At Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat reveals Bobby is the culprit but the Salujas don’t believe her. Vikrant loses his cool and lashes out at her.

episodesList.title: Mannat Loses Her Job
episodesList.summary: Mannat resigns to fight for Shalini's justice. Aish demands Mannat repay the 20K she owes before leaving.

episodesList.title: Mannat Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Aish gets Mannat arrested for slandering the Saluja name by circulating a video to the media accusing Bobby of being the culprit.

episodesList.title: Mannat is Determined
episodesList.summary: Bobby kidnaps Shalini's brother, and Mannat vows to rescue him.

episodesList.title: Will Mannat Succeed?
episodesList.summary: Mannat rushes to save Aditya but ends up getting captured by Bobby. Will she find a way to escape and rescue Aditya in time?

episodesList.title: Mannat Rescues Adi
episodesList.summary: Mannat saves Adi, but Shalini refuses to testify against Bobby. Meanwhile, Aish announces Shalini's engagement to Puneet. How will Shalini handle this situation?

episodesList.title: Mannat is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Mannat warns Vikrant he’ll be ashamed once truth is out. She secretly sends the blood-stained gold chain for lab testing.

episodesList.title: Mannat is Humiliated
episodesList.summary: On Aish's orders, protestors smear black ink on Mannat's face. Mannat wipes it off with Aish's saree, boldly declaring she's not afraid of her.

episodesList.title: Mannat and Bobby Face to Face
episodesList.summary: Bobby messages Mannat from Shalini's phone, urging her to meet him. When they finally come face to face, tensions rise. What will happen next between them?

episodesList.title: Vikrant Supports Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat records Bobby's confession. Vikrant intervenes, saving Mannat from Bobby and reveals to everyone that Bobby is the culprit.

episodesList.title: Bobby Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Vikrant has Shalini slap Bobby before he's arrested, then apologizes to Mannat for not believing her all this time.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Stays Adamant
episodesList.summary: Vikrant convinces Mannat to stay in the outhouse and clashes with Neetu. Meanwhile, Neetu secretly continues giving Vikrant memory loss medication.

episodesList.title: Proof is Being Stolen
episodesList.summary: Aish and Malla steal the evidence against Bobby. Later Vikrant falls ill and recalls a bloody childhood memory. Mannat gently comforts him through the pain.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Misses Court
episodesList.summary: Mannat gives Vikrant the evidence copy. Neetu slits her wrist after Raveena threatens her. Vikrant fails to reach court on time and Mannat grows anxious.

episodesList.title: Goons Attack Mannat
episodesList.summary: Goons sent by Aish attack Mannat and destroy the evidence. Mannat fights back and later confronts Aish in anger.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Victory
episodesList.summary: Mannat blackmails Aish to testify against Bobby. Bobby is jailed, and Mannat wins justice for Shalini.

episodesList.title: Mannat is Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Mannat gets her job back. Gagan reveals Aish’s secret, saying she paid Sunita to cover it up.

episodesList.title: Aish is Stressed
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Vikrant arrive at Sunita's village, leaving Aish anxious after learning about it from Sunita.

episodesList.title: Mannat-sunita Come Face to Face
episodesList.summary: When Vikrant falls unwell, Mannat and the family tend to him. Amid wedding preparations, Mannat comes across Sunita! Will the truth be out?

episodesList.title: Aish Runs Over Vikrant!
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Mannat chase Sunita while Aish ploys to ruin their attempt. Desperate, Aish tries to run Mannat down with her speeding car, but accidentally hits Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Neetu Slaps Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat gets help from an Ayurveda doctor to treat Vikrant and helps him recover. Later, Neetu slaps Mannat and blames her for everything.

episodesList.title: Malla is Jealous
episodesList.summary: As Vikrant recovers, Malla burns with jealousy seeing Mannat by his side. Neetu warns Vikrant to stay away from gold diggers like Mannat.

episodesList.title: Sunita Threatens Aish
episodesList.summary: Mannat catches Sunita red handed as she tries to blackmail Aish. With evidence in hand, Mannat confronts Sunita. Will Aish be cleared, or will Sunita manage to turn the tables?

episodesList.title: Aish Burns Sunita
episodesList.summary: Mannat helps Anu and Nikhil reconcile. Aish confesses she is Sonia Khanna and sets Sunita on fire to stop her from revealing the truth.

episodesList.title: Mannat Saves Sunita
episodesList.summary: Mannat rescues Sunita and brings her to stay at the Saluja outhouse, leaving Aish deeply unsettled and worried about the consequences.

episodesList.title: Vikrant to Confess His Love to Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant plans to propose to Mannat. Meanwhile, Aish attempts to kill Sunita, but Harneet arrives in time to save her.

episodesList.title: Malla Spoils Mannat's Cake
episodesList.summary: Anu's engagement begins. Malla poisons Mannat's cake to make Vikrant angry at her and ruin the event.

episodesList.title: Vikrant’s Proposal Takes an Unexpected Turn
episodesList.summary: Aish fails to kill Sunita, but Vikrant accidentally eats the poisoned cake meant for her. While proposing to Mannat, he collapses, leaving everyone in shock.

episodesList.title: Who is Drugging Vikrant?
episodesList.summary: Mannat overhears a doctor discussing how Vikrant is being drugged, causing his condition to worsen. Alarmed, she begins her search to uncover the person behind the plot.

episodesList.title: Mannat On a Mission
episodesList.summary: Mannat stops Aish from attacking Sunita and takes her place to contact the doctor who knows Vikrant was drugged. She secretly arranges a meeting to uncover the truth.

episodesList.title: Mannat Questions Neetu
episodesList.summary: Mannat discovers Neetu has been drugging Vikrant and confronts her in shock. She demands to know why a mother would harm her own son. Neetu is left speechless.

episodesList.title: Vikrant is Stunned
episodesList.summary: Keerat exposes Neetu for drugging Vikrant. Vikrant confronts her but Neetu denies it. Mannat lashes out asking how a mother could lie to her own son.

episodesList.title: Mannat Walks Out On Lies
episodesList.summary: Neetu emotionally manipulates Vikrant into asking Mannat to apologise. Mannat refuses and decides to leave, unwilling to live in a house built on lies.

episodesList.title: Aish Blackmails Neetu
episodesList.summary: Malika tries to stop Mannat, but she leaves determined. Neetu reveals Vikrant’s secret to Aish, who then blackmails Neetu into arranging Malika's marriage to Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mannat-sunita In Danger!
episodesList.summary: Malika tries to incite Vikrant against Mannat. The ambulance carrying Mannat and Sunita loses its brakes!

episodesList.title: A New Revelation Shocks Mannat!
episodesList.summary: Sunita dies after revealing that Aish knows the identity of Mannat’s real mother. Shocked and heartbroken, Mannat struggles to come to terms with the truth.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Refuses to Marry Malika
episodesList.summary: Vikrant refuses Neetu’s demand for Malika's marriage. Meanwhile, Mannat vows to expose Aishwarya’s truth.

episodesList.title: Mannat is Stunned
episodesList.summary: Vikrant expresses his desire to be with someone, seemingly proposing to Mannat but leaves her stunned when he addresses Malika instead. Aish and Neetu celebrate with delight.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Proposes to Malika
episodesList.summary: Vikrant proposes to Malika and later confronts Mannat about her indifference. He insists that she must help with the wedding preparations.

episodesList.title: Will Mannat Confess Her Love?
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Malika forge a new plan to make Mannat confront her feelings. On Vikrant’s request, Mannat feeds him food and stops him from consuming the juice laced by Neetu.

episodesList.title: Mannat Plays Her First Card
episodesList.summary: Mannat’s confession surprises Vikrant, who grows closer to her. Meanwhile, Shalini supports Mannat’s feelings, but Aish senses the brewing romance and plans to intervene.

episodesList.title: Malla Asks Mannat For a Promise
episodesList.summary: Vikrant wants Mannat to admit her love but their rift deepens. Malla emotionally manipulates Mannat into promising she will never come between them.

episodesList.title: Mannat Outwits Neetu
episodesList.summary: Mannat confronts Vikrant for losing her trust. As Neetu brings juice, Mannat suspects foul play and spoils it to stop Vikrant from unknowingly taking medication.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Stands By Mannat
episodesList.summary: Malla’s plan works as Neetu ousts Mannat, but Vikrant stands firm, refusing to marry Malla unless Mannat is allowed to stay in the house.

episodesList.title: Mannat and Vikrant's Divine Moment
episodesList.summary: Through divine intervention, Mannat and Vikrant’s chunari chadhana ritual is completed. Meanwhile, Gayatri gives Aishwarya a clever plan to expose Mannat.

episodesList.title: Aish Traps Mannat
episodesList.summary: Aish uses fluorescent powder to expose Mannat at the cocktail party, while Vik plans to reveal his wedding with Malla is fake. Will both truths come out?

episodesList.title: Mannat Outsmarts Aish
episodesList.summary: Mannat tricks Aish by handing the second threat letter. Aish fails to spot prints and doubts Mannat.

episodesList.title: Will Aish Fall For Mannat’s Trap?
episodesList.summary: Mannat smartly lures Aish to the chawl and sets a trap to scare her. Later, Aish confesses the truth.

episodesList.title: Aish Discovers Mannat's Scheme
episodesList.summary: Mannat locks Aish in a photo studio, concealing her face with a sack. Though Aish is eventually rescued, she grows suspicious that Mannat is behind the trap.

episodesList.title: Mannat Fights to Save Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Mannat discovers Vikrant’s memory lapses and secretly swaps Neetu’s medicines. Meanwhile, Malla plots a plan during her act to separate Vikrant and Mannat.

episodesList.title: Mannat and Gagan Join Hands
episodesList.summary: Mannat learns Gagan has been helping her expose Aish, and they unite. During the Mehendi ceremony, Malla lures Mannat to the stage, plotting to burn her alive.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Saves Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant rescues Mannat from a blast she plotted herself. Aish takes Rs 1 crore and goes to meet a blackmailer, unaware of Gagan following her. Later, Vikrant confronts Mannat.

episodesList.title: Mannat Comes to Gagan’s Rescue
episodesList.summary: Aish brings the money but Ravindra’s men catch the blackmailer. Mannat helps Gagan flee with the cash. Malla admits to the blast, but Aish insists the wedding must take off.

episodesList.title: Vikrant-mannat’s Kaleera Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Mannat helps the Chawl people with Aish’s money. Neetu plots against Mannat. Later, Vikrant and Mannat’s divine Kaleera ceremony takes place.

episodesList.title: Mannat to Expose Aish!
episodesList.summary: Mannat learns Shruti has 24 hours for a liver transplant. She joins Gagan to expose Aish and uncover her real mother. Later, Aish receives a chilling threat during Jagrata.

episodesList.title: Mannat Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Terrified of dying, Aish confesses to Mannat that she is her biological mother who abandoned her at birth. Mannat demands she donate her liver to save Shruti or be exposed.

episodesList.title: Mannat Compels Aish to Donate
episodesList.summary: Mannat threatens Aish to donate her liver to save Shruti or be exposed as Sonia Khanna. Aish agrees, but only if Mannat breaks Vikrant's heart so he marries Malla.

episodesList.title: Mannat Breaks Vikrant's Heart
episodesList.summary: To save Shruti, Aish demands Mannat break Vikrant's heart in exchange for her liver. Mannat complies, leaving Vikrant shattered as she asks for a stake in Mezbani.

episodesList.title: Mannat Sacrifices Her Love
episodesList.summary: Mannat breaks Vikrant’s heart to get Aish’s consent. Guilt consumes her, while a shattered Vikrant decides to confess everything to Ronny.

episodesList.title: Mannat Saves Shruti
episodesList.summary: Mannat feels guilty for hurting Vikrant but is relieved that Shruti's surgery went well. Malla lies about spending the night with Vikrant to trap him into marriage.

episodesList.title: Mannat Charts a New Path
episodesList.summary: Mannat plans a fresh start with Shruti, warning Aish to stay away. Aish plots revenge, while Ronny pressures Vikrant to marry Malla after their night together.

episodesList.title: Mannat Refuses Shruti’s Support
episodesList.summary: Shruti wants to return to Saluja Mansion seeing Mannat hurt, but Mannat refuses. Aish is thrilled as Mannat’s story ends and Vikrant prepares to marry Malla.

episodesList.title: Mannat’s Bold Griha Pravesh
episodesList.summary: Ravindra aims to shoot Mannat, but she boldly performs her grah pravesh. Aish reveals that Mannat owns Mezbani shares. Mannat declares she will live there with dignity.

episodesList.title: Mannat Faces False Accusations
episodesList.summary: Vikrant tells Mannat to leave, accusing her of cheating and stealing the property. Mannat stands confident, ready to reveal the truth about Aishwarya.

episodesList.title: Mannat and Vikrant’s Intense Clash
episodesList.summary: Mannat learns that Vikrant spent the night with Malla. Tension erupts between them in an intense confrontation, where Vikrant lashes out, accusing Mannat of objectifying him and treating him like a commodity.

episodesList.title: Malla Gets Furious At Mannat!
episodesList.summary: At Vikrant and Malla’s reception, their moments are replaced by clips of Vikrant and Mannat. Neetu blames Mannat, and Malla dares her to prove her innocence or face public humiliation.

episodesList.title: Mannat Proves Her Innocence
episodesList.summary: Mannat proves her innocence and Vikrant apologizes after learning Neetu staged the AV drama. Malla shocks Neetu by shifting all the blame onto her.

episodesList.title: Malla Spikes Mannat
episodesList.summary: Malla spikes Mannat’s brownie, leaving her intoxicated. At the press conference, a disoriented Mannat creates a scene, shocking everyone and angering Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mannat Nearly Reveals Aish's Secret
episodesList.summary: Vikrant rescues Mannat from a wardrobe mishap at the press conference. Just as Mannat is about to reveal Aish's condition for the liver donation, Aish intervenes in time.

episodesList.title: Mannat Discovers The Truth
episodesList.summary: Mannat learns Malla faked sleeping with Vikrant to emotionally trap him into marriage. Determined, Mannat decides to win Vikrant back.

episodesList.title: Mannat Saves Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Malla plans to drug Vikrant at the farmhouse, but Mannat outsmarts her. Later, she vows to protect Vikrant and won’t let any harm come to him.

episodesList.title: Malla’s Scheme to Bring Vikrant Home
episodesList.summary: Malla misbehaves with Vikrant, but Mannat stands up for him. Later, Malla electrocutes Neetu to lure Vikrant home and separate him from Mannat.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Challenge to Malla
episodesList.summary: Mannat challenges Malla that she will attend the Hariyali Teej Puja, and Vikrant will be the one to break her fast. What will Malla do?

episodesList.title: Vikrant Breaks Mannat's Fast
episodesList.summary: During Hariyali Teej, Vikrant breaks Mannat's fast in a divine moment, marking her Teej a success. Meanwhile, Malla learns Aish had donated her liver to Shruti.

episodesList.title: Malla Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Malla is shocked to learn that Mannat is Aish’s biological daughter and Aish is actually Sonia Khanna.

episodesList.title: Mannat and Malla's Face Off
episodesList.summary: Malla attacks Mannat and orders her to leave the mansion after learning they are half-sisters. However, Mannat vows to stay and win Vikrant back, at any cost.

episodesList.title: Mannat and Vikrant In Trouble!
episodesList.summary: Mezbani hosts a charity event where Mannat and Vikrant serve food happily. Malla secretly poisons the flour, making the kids sick and leaving everyone in shock.

episodesList.title: Mannat is Arrested
episodesList.summary: Following Malla and Puneet’s plan, police and a food officer raid Mezbani. Mannat is taken into custody after poisoned flour is found.

episodesList.title: Malla, Aish Warn Mannat
episodesList.summary: Malla and Aish threaten Mannat to sign the papers and return everything to Aish. They warn her that they will kill Shruti.

episodesList.title: Aniruddh Helps Mannat Expose Malla
episodesList.summary: Aniruddh proves Mannat’s innocence by exposing Malla’s act. Mannat reveals the truth to Vikrant and the family, clearing her name.

episodesList.title: Malla’s Suicide Shocks The Family
episodesList.summary: Malla's family turns against her. To gain sympathy and stop Vikrant from leaving, she attempts suicide.

episodesList.title: Mannat Doubts Malla’s Actions
episodesList.summary: The audience learns Malla faked taking sleeping pills with Aish's help. Mannat grows suspicious and begins plotting to gather proof and expose the truth.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Mission to Expose Malla
episodesList.summary: Mannat finds Malla’s sleeping pills untouched in the pipe and realises the truth. She’s now determined to expose Malla’s lie to Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Demands a Divorce
episodesList.summary: Mannat exposes Malla for never taking the pills. Shocked by the betrayal, Vikrant is devastated and demands a divorce.

episodesList.title: Is Mannat In Danger?
episodesList.summary: Malla plots a deadly attack on Mannat at Mezbani. Meanwhile, Aish meets Anirudh, and their actual connection to Mannat is revealed!

episodesList.title: Aish Saves Mannat
episodesList.summary: Aish learns of Malla’s plan to ruin Mannat and arrives at Mezbani just in time to save her from the attack.

episodesList.title: Malla’s Shocking Reveal
episodesList.summary: Malla reveals to the family that Mannat is caring for Aish, who once saved her because Mannat is actually Aish's illegitimate daughter, leaving all in shock.

episodesList.title: Aish Reveals Mannat’s Truth
episodesList.summary: In front of the family, Aish reveals the painful truth that Mannat was born from a sexual assault by Anirudh Saxena during her college years.

episodesList.title: Mannat’s Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Mannat learns the man who proved her innocence is her real father. Aish calls him a criminal, and Anirudh is shattered seeing Mannat’s disgust for him.

episodesList.title: Mannat’s Bold Stand Against Anirudh
episodesList.summary: Mannat calls Anirudh a criminal and throws him out. Feeling guilty over Aish’s troubles, she’s comforted and supported firmly by Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mannat is Determined to Get Justice
episodesList.summary: Mannat is resolute about filing a police complaint against Anirudh, but Aish declines, expressing that she does not want to revisit those painful memories.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Gift For Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant gifts Mannat a pendant, urging her to wear it during the Janmashtami Puja as a commitment. Malla resolves to stop Vikrant from going through with the divorce.

episodesList.title: Vikrant, Mannat Celebrate Janmashtami
episodesList.summary: Malla’s attempt to win Vikrant’s love by lip-syncing a Bhajan backfires. Mannat takes control of the situation and completes the Janmashtami Pooja with Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Aish is Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Amidst the Janmashtami Aarti, Anirudh abducts Aish and plans to kill her in Mezbani. Vikrant and Mannat race against time to rescue her.

episodesList.title: Aish's Truth is Out
episodesList.summary: Aish tells Anirudh that she lied to everyone that he forced himself on her. Unaware of the truth, Mannat and Vikrant try to reach Aish to save her from Anirudh.

episodesList.title: Anirudh is Arrested
episodesList.summary: Aish is about to kill Anirudh, but Mannat and Vikrant reach Mezbani. Anirudh gets arrested but he tries to tell Mannat that he is innocent.

episodesList.title: Mannat Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Mannat decides to file a case against Anirudh, to hold him accountable for his crimes. While Aish signs the legal documents, she secretly ploys to kill Anirudh.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Supports Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant proudly supports Mannat’s fight for justice. Later, he jokes about jumping after winning Dahi-Handi if she won’t wear his necklace, but Malla overhears and plots to kill him.

episodesList.title: Malla’s Deadly Dahi-handi Plot
episodesList.summary: Amidst the Dahi-Handi celebrations, Malla removes all the wires and hinges from the crane to kill Vikrant. This creates a serious threat to Vikrant’s life.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Life In Danger
episodesList.summary: Vikrant beams with joy as Mannat wears the necklace. Malla has sabotaged the crane, turning the vibrant Dahi-Handi celebration into a life-threatening spectacle.

episodesList.title: Mannat Fears For Vikrant’s Safety
episodesList.summary: Aish attacks Anirudh, but he escapes to protect Mannat and Vikrant. Malla warns about the safety harness as Vikrant climbs the crane, while Mannat prays in fear.

episodesList.title: Anirudh Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Anirudh saves Mannat and Vikrant during Dahi-Handi but is arrested after Vikrant suspects him. He warns Mannat that Aish is lying and they’re in danger.

episodesList.title: Mannat Suspects Aish's Secrets
episodesList.summary: Mannat begins to suspect that Anirudh may be innocent. She also starts to believe that Aish is hiding the truth about her very existence.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Stands Firm For Mannat
episodesList.summary: Neetu blames Mannat and her biological father for the Dahi-Handi incident and tells her to leave the house and stay away from Vikrant. But Vikrant firmly declares that if Mannat leaves, he will leave too.

episodesList.title: Mannat Gets a Clue
episodesList.summary: Mannat reviews the Dahi-Handi CCTV footage and discovers it was a fair-skinned woman, not Anirudh, who tampered with the hinges.

episodesList.title: Mannat Meets Anirudh
episodesList.summary: Mannat meets Anirudh in jail and learns the truth about his past with Aishwarya.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Resolution
episodesList.summary: Mannat, influenced by Anirudh’s words, seeks Aish’s truth. She moves closer to Vikrant, certain Aish will react if he distances himself from Malla.

episodesList.title: Mannat Traps Aish
episodesList.summary: Amid Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations, Aish enters the prison to kill Anirudh but instead falls into Mannat’s trap, revealing Aish’s true intentions.

episodesList.title: Mannat Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: As Aish tries to harm Anirudh, Mannat rushes to jail, rescues him, and learns the truth—Aish fabricated the assault story and she was not born out of rape.

episodesList.title: Mannat Exposes Aish
episodesList.summary: Mannat exposes Aish’s lies before Vikrant and the entire family, leaving everyone completely shocked.

episodesList.title: Mannat Exposes Aish’s Manipulation
episodesList.summary: Aish claims the video is fake and says she acted only to save Malla from Anirudh’s kidnapping, but Mannat insists she is manipulating everyone and stands her ground.

episodesList.title: Mannat Stands Her Ground
episodesList.summary: Mannat stands firm, accusing Aish of plotting Malla’s kidnapping, while Aish rejoices as the family trusts her lies and Malla’s divorce faces delay.

episodesList.title: A Rift Between Vikrant and Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat seeks Varun’s help to reach Malla, causing a rift with Vikrant. Meanwhile, Aish celebrates as her plan works and the Vikrant–Malla divorce is put on hold.

episodesList.title: Mannat Gets a Clue
episodesList.summary: Mannat finds Malla’s abduction site and records a video exposing Aish’s plot to kidnap Malla and frame Anirudh.

episodesList.title: Mannat In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Malla traps Mannat in a locked room with goons, but Aish scolds her for risking the staged kidnapping. Aish then spots Rajinder, who has uncovered the truth.

episodesList.title: Mannat Plots Daring Escape
episodesList.summary: Locked up, Mannat spots Rajinder and realises he knows Aish’s truth. She tries to escape through the window before Aish can manipulate him further.

episodesList.title: Aish Kills Rajinder
episodesList.summary: Aish kills Rajinder, but before Mannat can tell Vikrant, Malla twists the story, claiming Varun killed Rajinder while he and Aish were rescuing her.

episodesList.title: Mannat Determined to Expose Aish
episodesList.summary: Mannat tries to convince the family that Aish killed Rajinder, but they are deceived. Doubted yet determined, she vows to do whatever it takes for justice.

episodesList.title: Mannat Stands By Anirudh
episodesList.summary: Anirudh is ready to plead guilty, but Mannat urges him to fight. Aish retaliates by attacking Mannat publicly, only for Vikrant to save her.

episodesList.title: Mannat Activates Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Malla informs Mannat that she lacks evidence to prove Anirudh's innocence. Mannat then plans to get Malla to confess the truth for court.

episodesList.title: Mannat Tricks Malla
episodesList.summary: Mannat fakes ghostly events to make Malla confess to Rajinder’s death. Aish warns Malla of the trap and secretly plots revenge by planning an attack on Shruti.

episodesList.title: Malla Confesses The Truth
episodesList.summary: Mannat triumphs as Malla publicly admits that she and Aish were responsible for Rajinder’s death.

episodesList.title: Aish Uses Manipulation
episodesList.summary: Aish manipulates events, leading Vikrant to demand that Mannat apologise to Malla. She refuses, and later Vikrant overhears Malla and Aish, uncovering the full truth.

episodesList.title: Mannat, Vikrant Join Hands
episodesList.summary: Vikrant tells Mannat that he overheard Aish and Malla’s conversation and knows the full truth. He vows to support her and fight for justice for Anirudh.

episodesList.title: Mannat’s Trap For Aish
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Vikrant set a trap to make Aish confess, unaware that Aish is secretly plotting to kill Mannat. Danger lurks as their plan unfolds.

episodesList.title: Dhairya Saves Mannat In Time
episodesList.summary: Mannat faces Aish’s goons alone, but DCP Dhairya rescues her just in time. Vikrant arrives late and apologises for failing to protect her.

episodesList.title: Dcp Dhairya Supports Mannat
episodesList.summary: DCP Dhairya supports Mannat in court and secures more time to investigate. He plans to move Anirudh to safety as Aish plots his murder.

episodesList.title: Mannat Thwarts Malla’s Attack
episodesList.summary: During Ganesh Visarjan, Mannat discovers Malla’s plan to attack Anirudh. With Vikrant’s help, she saves him at the police station just in time.

episodesList.title: Mannat Tells Vikrant The Truth
episodesList.summary: Vikrant discovers from Mannat that Malla lied about their physical relationship to manipulate him. She orchestrated events to force a marriage and secure her place in his life.

episodesList.title: Mannat Activates Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Vikrant vow to expose Aish’s misdeeds during Navratri. They plan to gather secret evidence and confront her publicly to reveal the truth to everyone.

episodesList.title: Mannat, Vikrant Celebrate Navratri
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Vikrant celebrate Navratri while secretly working on their plan. As Anirudh enters in disguise, their mission to make Aish confess her crimes progresses.

episodesList.title: Aish is Trapped By Mannat
episodesList.summary: Following Mannat's plan, Anirudh forces Aish into a secluded spot to confess her crimes at gunpoint. Meanwhile, Mannat panics, noticing the cameras are off and Vikrant's delay.

episodesList.title: Aish's Truth is Out In The Open
episodesList.summary: Mannat’s plan succeeds as Vikrant links the cameras to the projector, shocking the family with Aish’s truth and proving Mannat was right all along.

episodesList.title: Aish is Arrested
episodesList.summary: Dhairya arrests Aish for her crimes, and Gagan apologises to Mannat. Meanwhile, Neetu warns Ronny that Aish will reveal Vikrant’s past if he separates from Malla.

episodesList.title: Aish Blackmails Ronny
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Mannat oppose Ronny for bailing out Malla, but it’s revealed Aish blackmailed him, threatening to expose Vikrant’s childhood past.

episodesList.title: Malla Signs The Divorce Papers
episodesList.summary: Vikrant allows Malla to stay in Saluja Mansion only if she signs the divorce papers, leaving her with no choice but to comply.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Proposal For Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant proposes to Mannat and she agrees, but Neetu opposes it. Vikrant stands firm and tries to convince her of his decision.

episodesList.title: Vikrant, Mannat's Roka Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Vikrant convinces Neetu for the Roka, but her disapproval is clear. Mannat vows to win her over, while Malla schemes to ruin the relationship claiming her place as Vikrant’s wife.

episodesList.title: Dhairya Uncovers Vikrant is Aman
episodesList.summary: During Vikrant and Mannat's Roka ceremony, Dhairya meets Neetu and discovers that Vikrant is actually his long-lost younger brother, Aman.

episodesList.title: Threat to Vikrant and Mannat!
episodesList.summary: Vikrant asks Mannat on a date, but she teases him. Meanwhile, Malla plots against them, and Dhairya plans to teach Neetu and Ronny a lesson to reunite Vikrant with his family.

episodesList.title: Mannat, Vikrant’s Romantic Date
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Vikrant enjoy their date, unaware that Malla has set an oven blast to ruin their evening and snatch everything from Mannat. What will happen to Mannat and Vikrant?

episodesList.title: Vikrant Saves Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat brings a cake for Vikrant when the oven explodes, injuring him. Neetu calls Mannat a bad omen, but Vikrant stands by her. How will Mannat react?

episodesList.title: Dhairya’s Plan to Enter Mansion
episodesList.summary: Dhairya fakes saving Neetu and injures himself. Neetu takes him home for treatment, and at Vikrant’s request he stays, revealing his plan to enter Saluja mansion.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Surprise For Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Mannat plans Vikrant’s birthday surprise, But Dhairya’s voice note mentioning Aman triggers Vikrant’s panic attack, making Dhairya realise he holds memories of Aman.

episodesList.title: Threat On Vikrant
episodesList.summary: On Vikrant’s birthday, Neetu arranges a pooja, but during the hawan, the fire flares up, and the pandit deems their bond inauspicious. Malla orchestrates this and plans Vikrant's accident.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Apologises to Mannat
episodesList.summary: Neetu insults Mannat and cancels her wedding with Vikrant, ignoring his defense. Later, Vikrant sincerely apologises to Mannat and comforts her.

episodesList.title: Vishakha Feeds Kheer to Vikrant
episodesList.summary: During Vikrant’s birthday celebration, Vishakha disguised as a cleaner makes him eat the Kheer she prepared. Neetu spots her, gets terrified, and suffers a panic attack.

episodesList.title: Mannat Finds Vishakha
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Vikrant seek Dhairya’s help to find Vishakha, who fed Vikrant the Kheer. Though he finds no clues, Mannat later discovers CCTV footage revealing Vishakha.

episodesList.title: Mannat, Vikrant to Meet Vishakha
episodesList.summary: Mannat tells Vikrant about the mysterious Vishakha, and together they plan to meet her to safeguard their family.

episodesList.title: Vishakha Reveals She is Vikrant’s Mother
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Vikrant meet Vishakha, where she shocks them by revealing that she is Vikrant’s biological mother.

episodesList.title: Vishakha Manipulates Vikrant and Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vishakha tricks Vikrant and Mannat by faking a terminal illness and posing as Vikrant’s surrogate. Her arrival at their engagement shocks Neetu and Ronny.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Vikrant learns from Ronny that Vishakha is his mother and lets her stay at the Saluja Mansion. But Mannat grows suspicious, sensing Vishakha is hiding a deeper secret.

episodesList.title: Mannat Doubts Vishakha’s Motives
episodesList.summary: Mannat suspects Vishakha’s motives after meeting her, while it’s revealed she once sold her own son Aman to Ronny for ₹50 lakhs, showing her greed and manipulation.

episodesList.title: Mannat Questions Vishakha
episodesList.summary: Gagan supports Mannat as she questions Vishakha about her whereabouts. Meanwhile, when Neetu suffers a panic attack, Vikrant firmly tells Vishakha nothing comes before his mother.

episodesList.title: Mannat Stands Firm Against Vishakha
episodesList.summary: Mannat overhears Vishakha turning Vikrant against Neetu and warns she’ll protect him and the family. Seeing her as a threat, Vishakha plots to separate them forever.

episodesList.title: Mannat and Vikrant Face a Rift
episodesList.summary: Vishakha turns Vikrant against Shruti, causing a rift with Mannat. Eventually, Vikrant realizes his mistake and reconciles with both Shruti and Mannat.

episodesList.title: Fallout Between Vikrant and Mannat
episodesList.summary: During Karwachauth, Neetu slaps Shruti, sparking a fight between Vikrant and Mannat. As tensions rise and they defend their mothers, Vikrant calls off the wedding in anger.

episodesList.title: Vikrant and Mannat's Divine Wedding
episodesList.summary: Vikrant learns from Ronny that Neetu slapped Shruti. Realizing the truth, he apologizes to Mannat, and in a divine turn of events, they get married.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Teases Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant teases Mannat by calling her Mrs. Vikrant Saluja, while Aish blackmails Dhairya, forcing him to help her escape so she can seek revenge on Mannat.

episodesList.title: Mannat Confronts Dhairya
episodesList.summary: Mannat confronts Dhairya for transferring Aish to the hospital. Dhairya reveals Aish knows a secret from his past. Mannat and Vikrant team up to uncover Aish’s leverage over him.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Returns Necklace to Neetu
episodesList.summary: Mannat secretly adds itching powder to the necklace Vishakha snatched from Neetu. At the Sangeet, Vishakha throws it away and Vikrant returns it, defending his mother’s honor.

episodesList.title: Neetu Accepts Mannat
episodesList.summary: Neetu warmly accepts Mannat as her daughter-in-law, leaving Vikrant and Mannat emotional. Malla secretly records Dhairya and Vishakha, with plans to reveal Vikrant’s parentage.

episodesList.title: Mannat Learns About Malla's Plan
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Vikrant uncover Aish and Malla’s plan to expose a secret that could shatter the Salujas. However, they are unaware that the Vikrant is Vishakha’s biological son.

episodesList.title: Vikrant’s Secret is Revealed
episodesList.summary: Mannat discovers that Vikrant is actually Vishakha’s biological son. She also learns from Dhairya how Neetu and Ronny took him away, leaving her shocked by this long-hidden secret.

episodesList.title: Mannat Stops Dhairya
episodesList.summary: Mannat asks Dhairya to delay telling Vikrant about his real identity. She also confronts Ronny and Neetu, urging them to reveal the truth to him.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Request to Ronny
episodesList.summary: Mannat urges Ronny and Neetu to confess to Vikrant before it's too late. Ronny agrees and seeks Vishakha's permission for time to reveal the truth.

episodesList.title: Vishakha's Demand
episodesList.summary: Vishakha demands the entire Saluja property in exchange for giving Ronny time to confess the truth to Vikrant. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Vikrant Stands By Neetu
episodesList.summary: Vishakha accuses Neetu of harming her, but Mannat cleverly proves Neetu’s innocence, earning Vikrant’s unwavering support and restoring peace.

episodesList.title: Malla and Vishakha’s Plan
episodesList.summary: Malla and Vishakha plan a skit to help revive Vikrant’s memories. Meanwhile, Vishakha’s apology to Neetu raises suspicion, as Mannat senses her hidden motive.

episodesList.title: Mannat Wins Ronny’s Trust
episodesList.summary: Mannat stops Ronny from transferring the property to Vishakha, earning his praise. Meanwhile, Vishakha and Malla plan a skit to trigger Vikrant’s childhood memories.

episodesList.title: Mannat Trapped By Malla
episodesList.summary: As Malla and Vishakha prepare for the skit, Mannat learns of their plan and vows to stop them. Malla attacks her and orders goons to lock her inside a box.

episodesList.title: Will Vikrant Recall His Past?
episodesList.summary: Malla and Vishakha’s skit triggers Vikrant’s hazy childhood memories, leading to a panic attack hinting at his past. Meanwhile, trapped Mannat struggles to escape the box.

episodesList.title: Mannat Faces Malla and Vishakha
episodesList.summary: Mannat confronts Malla and Vishakha over the skit plans. She urges Ronny and Neetu to confess to Vikrant, warning that any delay will allow Vishakha to manipulate him further.

episodesList.title: Neetu Threatens Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat wants to reveal the truth about Vikrant’s childhood and Vishakha. Neetu threatens to take her own life if Mannat dares to speak.

episodesList.title: Mannat Decides to Tell The Truth
episodesList.summary: Mannat plans to reveal Vikrant’s birth truth after Lakshmi Pooja, but Malla learns he recalls his past and urges Vishakha to expose it before Mannat gets the chance.

episodesList.title: Mannat Saves Dhairya’s Dadi
episodesList.summary: Mannat rescues an elderly woman at the old age home, unaware she’s Dhairya’s Dadi, while Vishakha tricks Neetu into confessing her sins as Malla records everything.

episodesList.title: Dadi Reveals Vishakha's Truth
episodesList.summary: Dadi exposes Vishakha’s secret that she sold Aman to Ronny, leaving Mannat and Dhairya utterly shocked and heartbroken by the revelation.

episodesList.title: Will Vishakha Confess Her Sins?
episodesList.summary: Dhairya is shattered after learning Vishakha’s truth, while Mannat plans a way to make Vishakha confess her sins and reveal everything.

episodesList.title: Mannat’s Ultimatum to Vishaka
episodesList.summary: Mannat gives Vishakha two choices: go to jail or leave Saluja Mansion forever without revealing anything to Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mannat’s Moment Of Victory
episodesList.summary: Mannat wins as Vishakha accepts her condition and leaves Saluja Mansion for good. Later, Ronny, Neetu, and Mannat share an emotional heartfelt moment together.

episodesList.title: Aish’s Plot For Revenge
episodesList.summary: With Aish’s help, Vishakha manipulates Dhairya into staying at Saluja Mansion till Mannat and Vikrant’s wedding. Meanwhile, Aish plots revenge and plans her escape from jail.

episodesList.title: Aish's Plan to Escape
episodesList.summary: Dhairya tells Mannat and Vikrant that Aish has escaped from the hospital. As they search for her, Mannat finally comes face to face with Aish in the children's ward.

episodesList.title: Aish is Pronounced Dead
episodesList.summary: Aish attacks Mannat. To protect Mannat, Dhairya shoots Aish. Later, the doctor arrives and declares Aish dead.

episodesList.title: Aish Comes Back to Life!
episodesList.summary: Mannat feels guilty about Aish’s death. However, she is stunned when Malla and Vishakha revive Aish and reveal that the tragedy was a planned one.

episodesList.title: Aish Enters Saluja Mansion
episodesList.summary: Aish returns to the Saluja Mansion disguised as a maid named Asma. She plans to create trouble for Mannat and the Saluja family.

episodesList.title: Malla Secretly Follows Mannat
episodesList.summary: Aish hurts Vishakha to cause a rift between Neetu and Vikrant. Meanwhile, Mannat goes to give lunch to Dadi and is secretly followed by Malla.

episodesList.title: Aish's Next Move
episodesList.summary: With Mannat’s help, Aish secures her job at Saluja Mansion. Later, she plans her next move to expose Neetu for drugging Vikrant during the Haldi celebrations.

episodesList.title: Mannat, Vikrant's Haldi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: During Mannat and Vikrant’s Haldi, Aish and Malla plant the Neetu–Ronny confession video in Vikrant’s room and slip the memory-suppressing pills into Neetu’s purse.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Confronts Mannat In Anger
episodesList.summary: Antidepressants fall from Neetu’s purse and she lies that they were for her, hiding that she gave them to Vikrant. Vikrant learns Mannat knew about this and angrily confronts her.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Seeks Forgiveness From Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant apologizes to Mannat for his mistake, while Aish, Malla, and Vishakha plan to reach Dadi through Dhairya during Mannat’s Choodha ceremony.

episodesList.title: Mannat Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Mannat realizes that Vishakha has tricked Dhairya into meeting Dadi and she saves the day by stopping him before the plan unfolds, leaving Vishakha frustrated and exposed.

episodesList.title: Dhairya Bids Adieu to Mannat
episodesList.summary: Dhairya blesses Mannat before her wedding. Meanwhile, Vik finds the envelope, and Aish celebrates, knowing Vik’s true identity will soon be revealed.

episodesList.title: Mannat Halts Rituals and Love Begins
episodesList.summary: Mannat locks Vishakha in the washroom and stops Dhairya from the wedding. As the chaos settles, Mannat and Vikrant share a tender moment, ready to begin their new life together.

episodesList.title: The Wedding Begins
episodesList.summary: As Mannat and Vikrant’s wedding rituals begin, Aish makes sure the projector and envelope reach Vikrant at the Mandap, setting up the moment that will reveal he is Vishakha’s son.

episodesList.title: Keerat Reveals The Truth
episodesList.summary: Amidst the Pheras, Keerat switches on the projector and Vikrant is stunned as he learns he is not Ronny and Neetu's son, shattering everything he believed.

episodesList.title: Vishakha’s Hidden Scheme
episodesList.summary: Vikrant doesn’t believe Vishakha at first. Later, she tricks him, creating tension with Mannat as her manipulation twists the truth and sows doubt in him.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Demands Proof
episodesList.summary: Vishakha turns Vikrant against Mannat, but Mannat accuses her of lying. Vikrant demands proof, pushing Mannat to leave and bring Dadi as evidence.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Race For Proof
episodesList.summary: Ronny urges Vikrant not to trust Vishakha. Elsewhere, Mannat goes to bring Dadi to prove she is not lying, but Aishwarya captures Dadi before Mannat reaches.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Disbelieves Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat brings Dadi's lifeless body, shocking the Saluja family. Later, Dhairya exposes Vishakha's manipulation, but Vikrant steps back, asking for time before marrying Mannat.

episodesList.title: Mannat Finds a Witness
episodesList.summary: Mannat sees Matron as the key to exposing Vishakha to Vikrant. Meanwhile, Vikrant regrets his outburst at Mannat and decides to hear her side of the story.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Faith In Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant stands by Mannat despite Vishakha's manipulation, while Mannat and Dhairya gather proof of her crimes. Later, Aish deliberately hits Vishakha with a car to frame Neetu.

episodesList.title: Neetu's Desperate Attempt
episodesList.summary: Vikrant tells Dhairya that Neetu caused Vishaka's accident, while Neetu attempts suicide. Later, Vikrant apologises to Vishaka for not trusting her, unaware of her fake emotions.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Suspects Neetu
episodesList.summary: Vishakha manipulates Vikrant about Mannat, leading him to confront Dhairya as Mannat tries to calm things. Later, Vikrant claims Neetu planned to kill Vishakha.

episodesList.title: Mannat, Vikrant's Heated Clash
episodesList.summary: The conflict rises between Vikrant and Mannat as they fight about Vishaka and Neetu. Later, seeing their fight, Neetu breaks down and agrees to his accusations.

episodesList.title: Vishakha Fumes At Ronny
episodesList.summary: Vishakha engages in a heated argument with Ronny and Neetu. Later, Dhairya apologises to Vikrant for choosing the difficult truth over an easy lie.

episodesList.title: Neetu's Shocking Arrest
episodesList.summary: Devastated by Vikrant's accusations, Neetu urges Dhairya to sign the arrest warrant. Later, Vishakha and Aish feel happy as their plan succeeds and Neetu gets arrested

episodesList.title: Vikrant Doubts Mannat's Love
episodesList.summary: Vikrant confronts Mannat for valuing Dhairya above him. Later, Neetu regrets hiding the truth from Vikrant, and Ronny reassures her that he will always stand by her side.

episodesList.title: Ronny's Plea to Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Ronny falls at Vikrant's feet, pleading with him to withdraw the case against Neetu. Later, he agrees to Vikrant's condition to sign over his property, sparking chaos.

episodesList.title: Gagan's Advice to Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Gagan tries to explain to Vikrant the importance of Neetu and Ronny in his life. Later, Ronny and Mannat sign the property papers in Vikrant's name.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Breaks Ties With Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat tells Vikrant he will bear the lifelong burden of throwing Ronny and Neetu out of the house. She bitterly congratulates Vikrant for breaking their relationship.

episodesList.title: Is Mannat Pregnant?
episodesList.summary: Vikrant checks on Neetu as Mannat feels distressed thinking of Vikrant. Later, tension arises when the doctor tells Mannat she may be pregnant and advises a medical check-up.

episodesList.title: Dhairya Gives Mannat Hope
episodesList.summary: Dhairya assures Mannat that the news of her pregnancy will help mend things with Vikrant. Later, Malla learns of Mannat's pregnancy and informs Aish and Vishakha.

episodesList.title: Mannat Slaps Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Mannat hits Vikrant when he accuses her of having an affair with Dhairya, leading to a heated clash. Later, Vishakha, Aish, and Malla celebrate Mannat and Vikrant's conflict.

episodesList.title: Shruti's Escape From Sonia
episodesList.summary: Shruti confronts Sonia for faking her death and pretending to be Aish, while Mannat breaks down over Vikrant's harsh words. Later, Shruti tries to escape from Vishakha and Sonia.

episodesList.title: Aish's Assault On Shruti
episodesList.summary: Aish and Vishakha attack Shruti as she tries to escape, leaving her severely injured. Later, Mannat feels devastated, recalling memories of Vikrant and sharing them with Dhairya.

episodesList.title: Aish's Goodbye to Shruti
episodesList.summary: Mannat feels remorse over Vikrant's behaviour as Dhairya consoles her. Later, Shruti writhes in pain, recalling Mannat in her final moments, while Aish coldly bids her farewell.

episodesList.title: Shruti's Accident Shakes Everyone
episodesList.summary: Dhairya stops the car after finding Shruti unconscious after an accident. Later, Ronny overhears the police talking about Shruti's accident and is left shocked.

episodesList.title: Mannat Breaks Down Over Shruti
episodesList.summary: Mannat cries, hugging Shruti's body and singing her favourite song, refusing to accept her death. Elsewhere, Vikrant learns about Shruti's demise from one of his employees.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Farewell to Shruti
episodesList.summary: Vishakha is stunned when Vikrant reveals that he and Mannat are married. Meanwhile, Mannat gets ready for Shruti's final ceremonies and bids her a loving farewell.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Tries to Console Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat gets hurt by the divorce papers Vikrant sends during Shruti's funeral. Later, Vikrant tries to reach out, but she remains angry over his actions.

episodesList.title: Dhairya, Vikrant's Heated Clash
episodesList.summary: Vishakha injures herself to mislead Vikrant, sparking a fight between him and Dhairya. Later, Mannat plans to leave the city after bidding farewell to Shruti's ashes.

episodesList.title: Mannat Stands Strong
episodesList.summary: Mannat feels remorse as memories of Vikrant haunt her, yet she gathers strength to stay firm. Later, Ronny tells Neetu that Dua's habits closely resemble Vikrant's.

episodesList.title: Dua's Apology to Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant requests a Power of Attorney from Vishakha, causing her to become upset. Meanwhile, Dua expresses her regret to Mannat for her actions, which reminds her of Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mannat Haunted By Memories
episodesList.summary: Dua excitedly shares her new learnings as Dhairya bonds with her. Later, Mannat is left speechless when a song Dua plays brings back inescapable memories of Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mannat Clarifies Dhairya's Doubt
episodesList.summary: Yashika apologizes to Vikrant for playing unwanted music as Dhairya and Dua plan a surprise for Guddi's family. Later, Mannat tells Dhairya that Dua has no ties to Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mannat Refuses Wedding Contract
episodesList.summary: Mannat tells Dhairya that Vikrant might be Dua's biological father, but he is not her real father. Later, Mannat declines a wedding food contract on learning it's in Mumbai

episodesList.title: Mannat Sets Out For Neetu's Surgery
episodesList.summary: Dhairya suggests that Mannat take Mrs Sinha's contract so she can pay for Neetu's surgery. Later, Mannat feels uneasy and tells Ronny and Dhairya before leaving for Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Dua's Wish to Meet Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Dua feels happy as she dreams of meeting Vikrant and introducing him to Mannat. Later, Vikrant is stunned to see Shruti's name listed in the book for the langar at the gurudwara.

episodesList.title: Dua's Hopeful Gamble
episodesList.summary: Dua decides to enter the Dawate Ishq competition to win prize money for Mannat. Later, Mannat hides being in Mumbai as she unknowingly crosses paths with Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mannat Avoids Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Mannat is shocked to see Vikrant, though he does not notice her. She runs away before he can see her, leaving him emotional as he recalls their marriage.

episodesList.title: Malla Suspects Arzoo
episodesList.summary: Mannat feels she has no place in Vikrant's heart, even as he senses her presence. Later, Vishakha and Malla grow suspicious of Arzoo's behaviour.

episodesList.title: Mannat Scolds Dua
episodesList.summary: Aish confronts Malla and Vishaka for not keeping a proper watch over Vikrant's life. Meanwhile, Mannat reprimands Dua as she insists on participating in the competition.

episodesList.title: Dua's Conversation With Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Dhairya tells Ronny he feels Mannat is trying to hide her meeting with Vikrant in Mumbai. Later, Dua calls Vikrant and confesses that she is his biggest fan.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Spots Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat tells Dhairya she feels Dua is hiding something from them. Later, Vikrant stops the car upon seeing Mannat and rushes over to her.

episodesList.title: Dua's Risky Journey
episodesList.summary: Dua quietly slips out of the house while Mannat sleeps. Later, she shares her and Dhairya's carefully planned future with Mannat included.

episodesList.title: Mannat Worries For Dua
episodesList.summary: Mannat panics after reading Dua's letter, realizing she is stranded without a bus ticket. Later, Dua hides in a bag when Mannat and Dhairya spot her at the bus station.

episodesList.title: Dhairya Gives Mannat Hope
episodesList.summary: Dhairya tries to calm Mannat as she fears about Dua, assuring her that they will find her. Later, Ronny and Neetu feel that destiny might be hinting at Dua and Vikrant's union.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Vikrant learns Dua is his daughter and lashes out at Mannat.Later, Vikrant shames Mannat and forcefully takes Dua away.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Saves Dua
episodesList.summary: Vikrant heroically saves Dua from falling off the bus and cares for her while she is asleep. Later, panic ensues when Dua goes missing at their destination.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Disqualifies Dua
episodesList.summary: Vikrant finds Dua on the road and fights the goons to save her. Later, Vikrant announces the competition rules and disqualifies Dua over lack of parental approval.

episodesList.title: Dua's Culinary Triumph
episodesList.summary: Dua quickly prepares a delicious sandwich when she gets a chance. Later, Vikrant learns that the most tastiest sandwich was made by Dua, who he already disqualified.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Reconsiders His Decision?
episodesList.summary: The judges push Vikrant to give Dua another chance, while Yuvi humiliates Deepak, sparking conflict with Vishakha. As tensions rise, Dhairya and Mannat cheer Dua up.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Fight to Protect Dua
episodesList.summary: Mannat fights off the men who attempt to abduct Dua with fierce determination. Later, Dhairya intervenes and beats up both men as he, Mannat, and Dua escape together.

episodesList.title: Dhairya's Promise to Mannat
episodesList.summary: Dhairya assures Mannat he will always stay united with Dua and protect her. Meanwhile, Yashika manipulates Yuvi into convincing Vikrant to take them to Indore with him.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Prayer Against Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Mannat urges Dua to play without a phone while Vikrant receives her photo and location. Later, Neetu begins to walk as Mannat prays to never see Vikrant again.

episodesList.title: Neetu's Collapse Shocks All
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Mannat pray at the same place to never meet again, unaware of each other. Later, Neetu collapses unconscious as everyone panics for her safety.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Prayers For Family
episodesList.summary: Vikrant starts imagining Mannat is in front of him and begins asking why she is here. Later, Mannat thanks God to keep her family the same as Dhairya lifts Dua's mood positively.

episodesList.title: Arzoo's Plan Against Yashika
episodesList.summary: Arzoo devises a plan and asks Malla and Vishakha to uncover Yashika's true side. Later, Mannat's kite beats Vikrant's, unaware they're competing against each other.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Destined to Meet Mannat!
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Vikrant meet at the kite festival, as Vikrant feels destiny brought them together. Later, Vikrant is shocked to learn that Mannat is the head chef at Mr. Jindal's hotel.

episodesList.title: Mannat Faces The Consequences
episodesList.summary: Mannat apologises to Dhairya for the consequences caused by Vikrant. Later, Mr. Jindal reprimands her for being careless about the food quality at the event.

episodesList.title: Dhairya Stands By Mannat
episodesList.summary: Dhairya firmly defends Mannat against Vikrant and Yashika's accusations, assuring her of his trust. Later, Vikrant gets emotional upon seeing Ronny at the police station.

episodesList.title: Yashika Fuels Vikrant's Enmity
episodesList.summary: Yashika provokes Vikrant's anger against Mannat. Later, Dua and Mannat trick Guddi into confessing that she forged Mannat's signature, while Dhairya records the confession.

episodesList.title: Vikrant, Mannat's Heated Clash
episodesList.summary: Dhairya arranges a press meet, disclosing Guddi and Bhushan's plan to defame Mannat. Later, Vikrant and Mannat get into a heated conflict as he accuses her of betraying him.

episodesList.title: Neetu's Request to Dua
episodesList.summary: Neetu urges Dua to take part in the cooking competition and hopes to reveal the truth to Vikrant. Later, Vikrant identifies Mannat's dish and recalls a memory from their past.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Misses Neetu
episodesList.summary: Yashika schemes to win Vikrant, while the latter remembers Neetu as he feeds Yuvi. Later, the paralysed Neetu starts walking after seeing Vikrant. Will Neetu and Vikrant meet?

episodesList.title: Neetu's Accusation Breaks Dhairya
episodesList.summary: Dhairya breaks down as Neetu accuses him of trying to replace Vikrant's place in Mannat and Dua's lives. Later, Mannat stops Neetu from going to Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mannat Defends Dhairya
episodesList.summary: As Neetu doubts Dhairya's intentions, Mannat defends him, highlighting his support and sacrifice. Later, Ronny and Vikrant cross paths and get into an argument over past incidents.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Emotional Turmoil
episodesList.summary: Mannat tells Dhairya she cannot live without Dua and panics at the thought of losing her. Later, Neetu gets emotional seeing Vikrant's visit while Mannat stands shocked.

episodesList.title: Neetu Acts On False Hope
episodesList.summary: Neetu leaves her wheelchair and runs after a car, mistaking it for Vikrant. Later, Mannat feels helpless as she prays for operation money, watching Dua help.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Desperate Quest
episodesList.summary: Arzoo tries to convince Vikrant to come to Mumbai, but he prioritises Yuvi's health over travel. Later, Mannat seeks his colleague's financial help to afford Neetu's treatment.

episodesList.title: Mannat Seeks Mr. Sinha's Help
episodesList.summary: Vikrant urges Mannat to seek Mr. Sinha's help for Neetu's treatment expenses. Later, Mannat comforts Neetu and calls Mr. Sinha to request a loan for her treatment.

episodesList.title: Ronny Acknowledges Dhairya
episodesList.summary: Dua and Yuvi get into a fight. After Mannat requests financial help, Mr. Sinha turns to Vikrant for payment. Later, Ronny thanks Dhairya for supporting him after Vikrant left.

episodesList.title: Mannat Challenges Yashika
episodesList.summary: Mannat uncovers the truth behind Dua and Yuvi's conflict through video evidence and protects Dua from Yashika's wrath. Later, she boldly challenges Yashika to call Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Faces His Fallout
episodesList.summary: Dhairya confronts Vikrant for ruining his own relationship through mistrust. Later, Yashika feels relieved as Vikrant agrees to leave for Mumbai and reassures Yuvi.

episodesList.title: Mannat, Vikrant's Clash
episodesList.summary: Vikrant learns that Mannat asked Mr Sinha for money, which he refused. Later, Mannat confronts Vikrant for criticising Dua and shows him a video of Yuvi's behaviour.

episodesList.title: Dhairya's Concern for Neetu
episodesList.summary: The doctor urges Mannat to take Neetu to Mumbai for treatment. Later, Guddi offers support, and Dhairya worries about managing the expenses for Neetu's treatment.

episodesList.title: Yuvi's Desperate Move
episodesList.summary: Influenced by Yashika's words, Yuvi decides to run away from home. Later, Vikrant panics upon reading Yuvi's letter and feels guilty for driving him to such a drastic step.

episodesList.title: The Past Overwhelms Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant thanks Mannat for dropping Yuvi home and invites her inside. Later, memories resurface as Mannat enters the Saluja mansion, leaving her emotional.

episodesList.title: Mannat Learns Arzoo's Truth
episodesList.summary: The doctor tells Mannat that surgery is the only permanent solution for Neetu's recovery. Later, Mannat is shocked to see Arzoo and realises she is actually Aishwarya.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Stands by Yuvi
episodesList.summary: Yuvi tells Vikrant that he's eager to join the competition, as Vikrant encourages him to become a good chef. Meanwhile, Mannat follows Arzoo to uncover her true identity.

episodesList.title: Arzoo Slips Away Unseen
episodesList.summary: Mannat is baffled when Arzoo vanishes while being followed. Meanwhile, Yuvi's arrogance disrupts the shoot, as Dua's quiet grace unexpectedly draws the photographer's attention.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Worries for Neetu
episodesList.summary: Arzoo lashes out at Malla and Vishakha for their recklessness and reveals that Mannat saw her today. Later, Vikrant worries why Mannat didn't inform him about Neetu's health.

episodesList.title: Malla Strategises With Yashika
episodesList.summary: Malla urges Yashika to become Vikrant's life partner to remove Mannat from his life. Later, Arzoo informs Malla and Vishakha that Vikrant visited Neetu at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Arzoo Plots Against Mannat
episodesList.summary: Arzoo plans to stop Mannat from coming to the hospital with money to prevent Neetu's surgery. Later, Malla disguises herself as a driver to stop Mannat from reaching the hospital.

episodesList.title: An Attack on Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant prays for Neetu's recovery. Later, Malla and Arzoo mask themselves and attack Mannat, snatching her money bag, and then Dhairya rushes the injured Mannat to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Vishakha Sets an Emotional Trap
episodesList.summary: Vishakha emotionally manipulates Vikrant, forcing him to vow not to meet or help Mannat or Neetu. Meanwhile, Dua insists on joining Mannat to pray for Neetu at the temple.

episodesList.title: A Shattering Moment for Yuvi
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Dua walk barefoot to the temple and receive blessings from the priest. Meanwhile, shock erupts as the cooking competition poster reveals Dua's picture instead of Yuvi's.

episodesList.title: Neetu's Condition Breaks Mannat
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Ronny break down as Neetu's health worsens. Tensions spike when Vikrant visits, while Dua is stunned to see herself on his cooking competition hoarding.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Faces Mannat's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Mannat furiously rejects Vikrant's attempts to take Dua. But Neetu's critical health shocks Vikrant, leaving him torn and conflicted.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Ultimatum Shocks Mannat
episodesList.summary: Vikrant agrees to fund Neetu's surgery if Mannat lets Dua join the cooking contest. Later, Dhairya persuades Mannat to accept his deal.

episodesList.title: Dhairya Comforts Mannat
episodesList.summary: Dhairya urges Mannat to stay strong as she worries about Neetu's surgery. Later, Yuvi gets furious when Vikrant tells him that Dua will participate in the cooking competition.

episodesList.title: Malla's Sneaky Plot
episodesList.summary: Vishakha confronts Vikrant for funding Neetu's surgery. Meanwhile, Malla plans to use Yuvi to get close to Vikrant and suspects Yashika of introducing fake parents.

episodesList.title: Yashika Proposes to Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Seeing each other, Mannat and Vikrant are flooded with memories of their past and imagine a heartfelt reunion. Later, Yashika shocks everyone by proposing to Vikrant at the party.

episodesList.title: Mannat Walks Away
episodesList.summary: Vikrant agrees to marry Yashika, leaving Mannat shattered yet composed. Later, Mannat refuses his cruel condition and pulls Dua out of the competition.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Mannat
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise as Mannat is shaken upon seeing Arzoo. Meanwhile, Vikrant tries to explain that Arzoo isn't Aishwarya, but Mannat insists on calling the police.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Desperate Deal
episodesList.summary: Mannat accepts Vikrant's conditions so he can pay for Neetu's treatment. Later, Mannat plans to catch Aishwarya red-handed by staying at his home for the wedding catering.

episodesList.title: Malla's Sinister Scheme
episodesList.summary: To afford Neetu's treatment, Mannat signs the agreement to cater to Vikrant's wedding. Later, Malla and Arzoo plot to eliminate Dua from the competition.

episodesList.title: Vishakha Faces Mannat's Warning
episodesList.summary: Vikrant feels a deep connection with Dua as he ties a sacred thread on her hand. Later, Mannat sternly warns Vishakha not to reveal the past to Dua, sparking a heated argument.

episodesList.title: Mannat, Dhairya's Secret Plot
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Dhairya secretly plan to conduct Arzoo's DNA test to uncover her true identity. Later, Malla stirs Yashika's insecurity, highlighting Mannat's return in Vikrant's life.

episodesList.title: Malla Plots Against Dua
episodesList.summary: Malla instructs Yuvi to place a firecracker in Dua's barbecue grill to eliminate her from the competition. Unaware of the danger, Dua confidently focuses on preparing her dish.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Faces Mannat's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Mannat fumes at Vikrant over their negligence during the competition, and Bunty reveals that Yuvi hid crackers in the grill. Later, Dhairya suspects Aishwarya is behind the blast.

episodesList.title: Dhairya's Plan Against Arzoo
episodesList.summary: Dhairya plots to collect Arzoo's sample for a DNA test to expose her. Meanwhile, Vikrant reconducts the first round of the competition, and Dua confidently prepares the dish.

episodesList.title: Dua Shines in Round One
episodesList.summary: Vikrant declares Dua as the winner of the first round of the cooking competition, igniting Yuvi's jealousy. Later, Vishakha and Malla confront Yashika's fake parents.

episodesList.title: DNA Report Shocks Mannat
episodesList.summary: Yashika threatens Malla and Vishakha to expose Arzoo's true identity to Mannat and Dhairya. Meanwhile, Mannat is stunned as the DNA report fails to confirm Arzoo as Aishwarya.

episodesList.title: Arzoo Allies With Yashika
episodesList.summary: Arzoo joins hands with Yashika, plotting to use Dua against Mannat to drive her out of Vikrant's life. Later, Mannat feels happy overhearing Vikrant praise Dua's cooking.

episodesList.title: Yuvi's Scheme to Swap Dua's Dish
episodesList.summary: Dua confidently focuses on her dish while Yuvi plans to swap it with Yashika's help. Meanwhile, Dhairya plots to make Arzoo drink a spiked beverage to expose her reality.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Holi Glimpse
episodesList.summary: Mannat tends to Vikrant's injury as Yashika expresses gratitude to all at her engagement. Later, Vikrant and the family joyfully celebrate the Holi festival together.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Confession to Mannat
episodesList.summary: As Vikrant confesses his love for Mannat, she confronts him for leaving her during difficult times. Meanwhile, Dua gets trapped inside a freezer.

episodesList.title: Mannat Hits Yashika
episodesList.summary: Mannat angrily slaps Yashika for making accusations against Dua and Shruti. Meanwhile, Dua tries to lift the freezer door to escape, but Arzoo pushes her back inside.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Quest for Dua
episodesList.summary: Mannat panics as she discovers Dua is missing and checks the CCTV footage to track her. Meanwhile, trapped in a freezer, Dua recalls Dhairya's words and stays strong.

episodesList.title: Arzoo's Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Arzoo brings the police to search for Dua, feigning innocence. Later, Yuvi gets trapped in the freezer while rescuing Dua, but Arzoo chains it shut and sends it away.

episodesList.title: Dua's Rescue Signs
episodesList.summary: Dua and Yuvi struggle to escape the freezer, while she leaves clues to guide their rescue. Later, Mannat shares her doubts about Arzoo's role in Dua's disappearance with Dhairya.

episodesList.title: Mannat Tracks Dua, Yuvi
episodesList.summary: Arzoo and Yashika try to stop Mannat from reaching Dua. Mannat, Vikrant, and Dhairya follow the clues Dua left while being taken away in the freezer and find her with Yuvi.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Saves Dua and Yuvi
episodesList.summary: Vikrant rescues Yuvi and Dua from the locked freezer with Mannat's help. He thanks Mannat for saving Yuvi, while Dua reveals that Yuvi pushed her inside and locked her in.

episodesList.title: Dhairya Is Furious at Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Vikrant decides to send Yuvi to boarding school as Dhairya confronts him for ignoring Yuvi's mistakes. Mannat saves Yuvi as he nearly falls while escaping the house.

episodesList.title: Mannat, Dhairya Doubt Arzoo
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Dhairya suspect that Arzoo planned against Dua to remove them from Vikrant's life. Elsewhere, Yashika and her fake parents act innocent and create drama to trap Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mannat's Plan Unfolds
episodesList.summary: Mannat tells Yashika about her agreement for Vikrant's wedding catering. Additionally, Dhairya and Mannat plot to install a camera in Arzoo's room and stage a drama.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Attachment to Neetu
