episodesList.title: Karishma Goes Viral On Social Media!
episodesList.summary: Karishma comes before a group of men who are harassing iocent boys and girls in the park. Infuriated, she teache's them a lesson. The incident goes viral on social media and Haseena gets irked by this. An irritated Karishma hands over her transfer papers to Haseena who gets shocked by this.

episodesList.title: Angad Humiliates Karishma
episodesList.summary: The humiliated couple meets Karishma to express their gratitude. Angad not only insults Karishma but also shares the park raid video on social media. He urges the public to decide the right from wrong in the video.

episodesList.title: Karishma Stops a Suicide Attempt
episodesList.summary: The couples video becomes viral on social media. People declare their actions to be against Indian culture. The girl takes the criticism too harshly and attempts suicide. But Karishma saves her in the nick of time and brings her to the police station. They decide to devise a plan for the girl's safety.

episodesList.title: Antara Pretends to be Dead
episodesList.summary: While on patrol, Karishma sees a girl attempting suicide and saves the girl. She realises the identity of the girl after saving her. The girl is Antara. Karishma is taken aback. Antara expresses her sadness and says that she has no hope left since her father does not trust her. Haseena comes up with a plan and it involves the staff faking AnTara's death. Santosh and Pushpa are to train Antara to act like a dead body. Karishma disagrees with the plan but Haseena asks her to calm down.

episodesList.title: Vikram Threatens Angad
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tries to call Antara's father but fails. She then proceeds to take Antara and Mukesh for some snacks. Just then, Angad Acharya comes with AnTara's father and blames Haseena for helping Antara run away with Mukesh. Vikram displays a letter where Antara mentions her departure. Meanwhile, Santosh brings in a stretcher with somebody on it and covered in a white cloth. Vikram is told that the person under the cover is Antara. Vikram is shocked and as he reaches out to unmask the face, Karishma stops him to make him realises his mistake. As soon as Vikram realises his mistake, Haseena calls Antara in, revealing their plan. Vikram thanks everybody but Angad comes in and is shocked to see Antara. Vikram threatens Angad before leaving.

episodesList.title: Muscle Over Merit
episodesList.summary: Hassena is 2 days shy of her suspension when Angad arrives at the police station. He threatens Haseena that if she doesn't apologize publicly, he will do whatever it takes to get the police station shut down. Haseena retorts back to him and he scurries away. Outside the police station, Angad encounters Murari, whom he threatens and coaxes to be a part of his plan. Both Murari and Angad return to the police station and Angad makes an accusation that Murari was beaten up in the police station, thus maligning its image.

episodesList.title: Haseena's Apology
episodesList.summary: There looms a danger on Karishma. Also, the police station is vulnerable to threats. Haseena has no other choice but to come forward to take some actions to salvage both, Karishma as well as the police station. What will Haseena do? Will she succeed? Watch this adventurous episode to know the details.

episodesList.title: Found or Fainted
episodesList.summary: Haseena follows Karishma and reaches the location. Karishma on the other hand gets hit on her head causing her to faint. As the episode progresses you will get to know who hit Karishma and whether or not Haseena will be able to find her.

episodesList.title: Hurdles
episodesList.summary: Zoya nurtures a dream. She dreams of joining the Police force one day when she grows up. But there is a big hindrance in her life which may not make it easy for her to live her dream. Not only Zoya, there is someone else who is in big trouble as an ugly truth awaits. What is stopping Zoya from fulfilling her dream? Who else is in discomfort? Check out in this episode, all this and more.

episodesList.title: Haseena's Act
episodesList.summary: Mr. Mehra is a man of power and influence. However, he is under the police scanner for not very bright reasons. Meanwhile Haseena puts on a fake act for some important reason. What could Mr. Mehra be upto? What will Haseena's drama reveal? Find out in this catchy episode.

episodesList.title: Against Each Other
episodesList.summary: Women's Police Station is sincerely trying to collect the facts and evidences against Mr. Mehra. However, their efforts go in vain as they do not succeed in their work. Meanwhile, little Zoya's health deteriorates. Haseena then decides upon something which does not go down well with Karishma and both are at loggerheads. Which decision of Haseena's irks Karishma? Catch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Clinic Captives
episodesList.summary: As part of Haseena's last attempt to catch Mr. Mehra red handed, she sends her team to his clinic in disguise. However, in no time, not only her team, but also Haseena herself, are held captive in the clinic. Now, Karishma is the only ray of hope. Meanwhile, there is a breakthrough in the Zoya case. She is very close to finding a donor for her damaged kidney. Will Karishma be able to salvage the situation? Who has decided to help Zoya with a kidney? You will get all your answers as this episode progresses, stay tuned.

episodesList.title: Match Making
episodesList.summary: When Cheetah is urged to meet and assess a girl for being his prospective bride, he has little choice but to oblige as it is his mother's wish. On meeting the girl, Cheetah senses something amiss. In the meanwhile, the police station receives inside information of a child marriage scam that is about to take place. What the cops do next, remains to be seen in this episode.

episodesList.title: Wedding Crashers
episodesList.summary: Haseena and others learn that an underage girl, Lata, is supposed to marry a guy much older than her. She devises a plan to stop her marriage. Karisma, on the other hand, tries to teach Lata's family a lesson in her style, but fails miserably when Lata proves that she is an adult. So, Haseena asks Cheetah to marry Lata for her plan to get successfull. Watch this episode to know if Haseena can stop this marriage or not. Find out now.

episodesList.title: Mock Marriage
episodesList.summary: Haseena is leading a team of cops in a sting operation to ensure that the illegal marriage is unmasked. All goes according to the plan, but for the last moment. Will Haseena be able to execute the plan? This remains to be found out in this particular episode.

episodesList.title: Mission to Crumble?
episodesList.summary: One of Lata's relatives gets to know Pushpa and Karishma's real identity. So, they have to keep her tied up in a car. Parallelly, Cheetah is trying his best to delay the wedding. Meanwhile, Haseena locates the other minor girl hostages and leaves them in Karishma's care. In the car though, Lata's relative manages to escape. Will she jeopardise the plan? Will the cops get exposed? Find out in this exciting episode.

episodesList.title: A Misfired Plan
episodesList.summary: Even when Lata's father learns that Haseena and the others are cops, he remains adamant. Although Haseena appeals to him, he decides to get Lata married to another boy besides Cheetah. On the other hand, Karishma busts the racket by herself and beats the hell out of Shukla. As Haseena learns that Karishma neglected her specific orders, she decides to confront her. And this creates a rift between the two cops. What will happen now? Watch this exciting episode to know.

episodesList.title: Welcome Misri Pandey
episodesList.summary: As Karishma is about to go on a leave, Misri Pandey, a new cop fills in for her. Inspector Haseena welcomes Misri to the police station and starts to ignore Karishma. On the other hand, Misri misuses her authority over Pushpa and others, which leads them to complain about her to Haseena. Will Haseena take any action aganst Misri? Watch this episode now.

episodesList.title: A Criminal Escapes
episodesList.summary: While Haseena assigns her the next task of getting Nivas Tripathi, checked at the airport for illegal substances, Karishma acts swiftly and obtains Nivas Tripathi's address from a lead. But to their dismay, they find nothing when they reach the address, as Nivas has already fled. This raises the question of the presence of a mole amongst them. The easiest target for which is Misri. Find out who leaked the information and what will Haseena do when she gets to know who it is, in this episode.

episodesList.title: Mission Misri's Transfer
episodesList.summary: Haseena requests her senior officials to transfer Misri Pandey from her police station. While the investigation on Tripathi's case is on, Karishma accuses Haseena of favouritism towards Misri. Later, Haseena devises a plan along with Pushpa and Santosh to transfer Misri and bring Karishma back to her post. What is Maddam Sir's plan and will it work? Watch this episode to know.

episodesList.title: Misri's Conniving Moves
episodesList.summary: Karishma takes Haseena's word and agrees to report to Misri. Misri on the other hand, creates ripples of trouble for everyone, including Karishma. This doesn't go down well with them. Misri goes around throwing her weight and threatening everyone. She even plans on Billu's encounter but Billu finds this out. Worried for his life, he heads to Haseena to seek help. What will be Haseena's next move towards Misri? Will the sly cop get caught?

episodesList.title: Misri Gets Outwitted
episodesList.summary: Misri has been cooking up a plan to have Billu encountered. However, she is not aware that the team is well informed about this misdeed she is planning. Everyone at the station decides to trick Misri and devise a strategy to save Billu. However, Santosh makes a small mistake that can have terrible repercussions for Billu and the team. What will happen now? Will Misri's motive be met or will Haseena make sure that Misri doesn't have her way? Watch what happens in this thrilling episode.

episodesList.title: The Strange Accountant
episodesList.summary: Karishma detests the idea that her promotion is in Haseena's hand.  Haseena is pretty keen on testing Karishma's skills. On the other hand, Nawab makes a visit to the police station with his new female accountant. However, Karishma senses something odd about the accountant's conduct. Owing to this, she asks Cheetah to run a background check on her. What will Cheetah dig out about the new female account? Watch this interesting episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Nuisance Nabbing
episodesList.summary: Govind has been upto a lot of wrong doings off late. Karishma thus sets out to catch hold of him and helping her in this task is Billu.  Both manage to lay their hands on Govind and take him to the Police Station. On the other hand, Haseena has a plan up her sleeve. Will Govind confess his crime? What is Haseena's ploy? Watch this episode to uncover the facts.

episodesList.title: Calling It Quits
episodesList.summary: The town is abuzz as a Bollywood superstar gets there. The famous actor, Ajay Kumar, is in Lucknow for his film shoot. But this entertaining highlight is interrupted when he speaks in an ill manner with Pushpa Ji. This doesn't go down well with her and she is left with the sour taste of this humiliation. What will she do now? Will the team find out about this? Watch this episode to know what will be Pushpa's next step.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Plight
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is seen brooding over a recent happening. Her upset state of mind is further bothered by the poke received from some miscreants regarding her video which went viral. On seeing her upset, Haseena drives the goons away and offers a consoling thought to Pushpa. On the other hand, Cheetah's irritation knows no limits seeing the jail inmates. Will Haseena be able to help Pushpa? Why is Cheetah irritated? Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Deadly Duo
episodesList.summary: Karishma and Haseena get into a brawl with some deadly goons.The officer duo tackles the goons with expertise and sends them scurrying for cover. Back to the police station, the junior officers are debating over who fought the goons better. Watch the outcome of the debate in this episode.

episodesList.title: Taking Eve-teasers to Task
episodesList.summary: Karishma is all fired up when she spots two horrid boys trying to bully women in the middle of the street. She decides to teach them a tough lesson and takes them to the station after beating them up. Pushpa, who was to bring the girls who were being eve-teased, returns empty handed, as they refuse to file an FIR. This news reaches the DSP and he gives his word of warning. Will Haseena and team succeed in getting the girls to file an FIR or will they have to shut shop? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: A Helpless Haseena?
episodesList.summary: As Santosh is eve-teased by some boys, Karishma comes to her rescue and nabs the eve-teasers. While Santosh files an FIR against them, DCP calls Haseena regarding the same case. After talking with him, Haseena feels helpless. Why is Maddam Sir feeling helpless? Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: The Non-cooperation
episodesList.summary: Haseena gets Poonam to the police station and requests her to cooperate with them. But Poonam refuses to help them as she doesn't believe the allegations put on her brother. Karishma tries to convince Poonam. Will Poonam help Maddam Sir? Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: The Fake Viral Video
episodesList.summary: Karishma is tracing down a papad seller, selling his product as a remedy to Covid-19. Elsewhere Haseena receives the information from DSP regarding the illegal sale of alcohol. The fuming ladies determine to nab the culprit. The case is assigned to them and they get working on it. Unfortunately, a fake viral video portraying their involvement in the fake liquor racket surfaces. How will the team fight through this challenge that has landed before them?

episodesList.title: Stakes are High
episodesList.summary: Everyone's wondering about the alcohol bottles that the CBI discovered in the Police Station. Cheetah gets yelled at by Karishma because he was on night duty, when the bottles were perhaps smuggled in. The team ropes in Sunny to crack this fake news trouble. Parallelly, Haseena gets a call from the DSP to immediately get to the root of this fiasco and informs her that her job is at stake. Who could have brought in the bottles? Will Sunny be able to find out? Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Newsmaker In News
episodesList.summary: There is a breakthrough in the case of fake news, whereby the person who shot the video and made it viral has been identified. However, the person's address still remains to be located. Meanwhile, Karishma drags a person tied to her bike to the police station which leaves Haseena in disappointment. Whom does Karishma drag to the police station? What makes Haseena upset? Check out all the details in this episode.

episodesList.title: Arrest Warrant Against Haseena
episodesList.summary: Haseena makes a plan to trap Ranveer by faking to marry him. On the other hand, Karishma decides to go ahead with her raid to nab the culprit. But before that, CBI officials come to the police station to arrest Haseena. She requests some time from them to unmask the real culprit before them. Will Maddam Sir be able to catch the offender or will she get arrested? Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Online Scam Ka Shikaar
episodesList.summary: With a fractured hand, Billu gains sympathy from the Mahila Police Thana officers and extorts money from them. In reality, he uses the money to pay for an online parcel he has ordered. Later, when he opens the package, he finds out that he has been cheated. So, he arrives at the Thana once again to lodge a complaint about the online fraud. But to his dismay, Haseena informs him that the case falls under cyber cell and they cannot help him. But will Karishma let this go? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Wrong Spotlight
episodesList.summary: Karishma's tiff with the businessman brings her under the spotlight. Haseena is upset with this reckless attitude of hers. Parallelly, Haseena receives a pendrive in the police station, which has a challenge for her. What remains to be seen is will Haseena fall for this pendrive bait. Find out in this episode, stay tuned!

episodesList.title: Fraud Trail
episodesList.summary: The Cyber Cell Inspector informs Haseena that the man involved in the cyber crime is roaming around the police station. The police team goes in search of the fraudster but it seems that catching him is easier said than done. The goon is smart and fast. Will Haseena be able to round him off? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Wrong Capture
episodesList.summary: The hunt for the culprit takes the police team to a mushaira event. Karishma goofs up with the identity of the culprit. Will the MPT team manage to round off the culprit? Will Karishma's mistake prove to be costly? Watch this interesting episode to know better.

episodesList.title: The Last Letter
episodesList.summary: Iqbal's mother grows restless as her son suddenly disappears, leaving a note behind. So, she rushes to Inspector Haseena and hands over his last letter to her. When Haseena reads the letter, she finds something odd with it and decides to find Iqbal's whereabouts. Is it a normal case or is there something else? Watch this episode of Maddam Sir to know.

episodesList.title: Rescue Iqbal
episodesList.summary: Iqbal's friend, Fatema, visits the Police station and informs Inspector Haseena that Iqbal met her the previous day and apologised to her for breaking his promise. However, Inspector Haseena's investigation reaches a dead end as Fatema's information is not enough to move ahead. So, Maddam Sir takes a different approach, she decides to seek a psychiatrist's advice to analyse Iqbal's letter to rescue him. What will the Psychiatrist find out? Watch this episode to know.

episodesList.title: Iqbal - Alive or Dead?
episodesList.summary: Except Haseena, the rest of the people in and around MPT are unable to see Iqbal as he walks around and pleads with everyone that he is alive. Apparently, everyone is hell bent on making Iqbal convinced that he is dead and thus invisible to them. Is this part of a larger plan? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Just a No Helmet Case?
episodesList.summary: Haseena proudly conveys to her team that MPT has earned very good reviews in a national newspaper owing to their noble approach in crime handling, oblivious to the fact that Karishma is chasing a person who has been found violating a traffic rule. Interestingly, this same person lands up in MPT and when confronted, shares his problem and seeks MPT's help. How will MPT approach this case? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Couple and a Baba
episodesList.summary: Vijay and Anita's married life has reached a dead end, no thanks to a religious Baba, who is making Anita dance to his tunes. However, the information collected by Pushpa during her sting operation suggests something else. The case seems confusing. Haseena suddenly comes up with a plan of summoning Vijay to the police station. Will this step act as a breakthrough in this case? Watch this episode to understand.

episodesList.title: Laying The Trap For Baba
episodesList.summary: Sub-inspector Karishma Singh rushes to Baba Rang Rasiya's Ashram to investigate in her classic style, but his devotees block her efforts. At Mahila Police Thana, Haseena and other officers decide to write some fake love letters to trap the Baba in their plan. However, their love letters are not romantically upto the mark. With none of the plans working out correctly, how will Maddam Sir succeed in stopping Baba Rang Rasiya from exploiting his worshippers? Watch this dramatic episode to know.

episodesList.title: Mission: Love Revival
episodesList.summary: Giving in to Vijay's nagging regarding Laddoo Baba, Haseena comes with a rather twisted plan. She instructs Karishma to write love letters and these letters are to be sent to Vijay and Anita. Haseena is hopeful that this plot will work well and renew the romance in the couple's lives. Karishma goes the extra mile to get into the groove of love letter writing. Watch this episode to find out if the plan works, Karishma's antics and much more.

episodesList.title: Inspector Haseena's New Avataar
episodesList.summary: Inspector Haseena's plan of sending love letters to Vijay backfires on her, as Baba Rang Rasiya falsifies Vijay in front of Anita and complicates their marriage. With no hard evidence against him, the fake Baba continues to loot Anita and many others. Hence, to put an end to Baba Rang Rasiya's crimes for once and for all, Maddam Sir visits the Ashram in a new avatar and lays a trap open to expose him in front of everyone. Will Inspector Haseena's plan work this time? Stay tuned to know!

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Ka ‚ 'Fair' Plan
episodesList.summary: Santosh's friend, Ambika comes at the police station to file a complaint against Aditya. They had met on a matrimonial site, but owing to Ambika's complexion, Aditya left her and didn't return the huge sum of money he borrowed from Ambika's parents. Though Haseena refuses to file an FIR, she comes up with a plan to make Aditya realise his mistake and recover Ambika's money. What is this new 'fair' plan of Maddam Sir? Will Aditya realise his mistake? Stay tuned to know!

episodesList.title: Santosh’s Commitment Phobia
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir, as per her plan, assigns Santosh the task of faking a marriage with Aditya. Hearing this, Santosh gets very jittery and admits that she is incapable of doing this task as she suffers from commitment phobia. Maddam Sir, undeterred by all the jeers and jibes received from Karishma and others in the police station, is determined to make this plan work and suggests Santosh be trained. Watch this episode to find out if Santosh relents to accomplishing this task.

episodesList.title: Santosh's Wedding Plans
episodesList.summary: Santosh's dinner date with Aditya succeeds and he agrees to marry her. So, Inspector Haseena takes the next step in her plan and asks Santosh to call Aditya's parents to the police station for a marriage discussion. However, for her next plan to succeed, Maddam Sir, requires fake parents of Santosh to meet with Aditya's folks. Who will play the crucial role of Santosh's parents? Check out this highly-entertaining episode to know.

episodesList.title: Inspector Haseena Takes Bribes?
episodesList.summary: After Inspector Haseena sorts the issue of fairness with Aditya, she finds herself in a messy situation. A street vendor tries to file a complaint against Inspector Haseena, for taking a bribe from him while another TV actor hands over a bag of money to a lady identical to Inspector Haseena. Why is our favourite Maddam Sir taking bribes? What's all the fuss about? Tune in to this mind-blowing episode.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir's Duplicate?
episodesList.summary: When Billu asks Maddam Sir to return his money that she had borrowed the previous day, Haseena is confused as she can't recollect taking any money from him. Later, a man walks into the police station and claims to have met her earlier, whereas Haseena can't seem to recall this person by any means. Is there someone else in town who is fooling around as Maddam Sir? Watch the mystery get solved here.

episodesList.title: Phone Ka Clone
episodesList.summary: The entire city learns about Inspector Haseena's doppelganger. However, Rani, the fake inspector, decides to con a big businessman, one last time before escaping the place. And to succeed in her vicious plan, notorious Rani clones Inspector Haseena's phone, to misuse it for her own benefit. What's brewing in Fake Maddam Sir's mind? Will she succeed at conning the business tycoon? Or will the 'Real' Maddam Sir nab her doppelganger? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Fake Maddam Sir In Action
episodesList.summary: Rani, who is causing nuisance in the city by faking her identity to be that of real Haseena Malik's, seems to be quite a handful. Due to her reckless actions, real SHO's life goes haywire. When Haseena gets to know that she has been conned by this duplicate and Chopra has been robbed of his money, she sets out for Rani's chase. Just when Haseena feels she has rounded up Rani, a grave situation occurs which catches her off guard. Watch to find out more.

episodesList.title: Real Haseena Faces Fake Haseena
episodesList.summary: After chasing fake Haseena in an auto, Maddam Sir finally manages to come face to face with her. Meanwhile, Karishma is about to reach the spot by tracking Haseena's phone location. By the time Karishma reaches, the fake Haseena escapes from there and real Haseena finds herself in Rani's den. As the case gets complicated, CID is involved. Watch how CID tackles this case.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Gets a Bada Jhatka
episodesList.summary: While Haseena is trying to clear her name, Sunny gathers evidence that proves her innocence. Karishma and others seek forgiveness from Haseena and plan an undercover operation to nab Rani. On the basis of evidence gathered by Sunny, Haseena and the team reach a spot where a bigger shock is awaiting them. What is it? Watch to know.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir's Plan B
episodesList.summary: As a part of the sting operation, Karishma, Pushpa and Santosh land up in the fake MPT and get shocked to see their namesakes. However, luck does not shine on them as they do not get to meet the fake Haseena Malik. Maddam Sir then puts forward her plan B to nab Rani. On the other hand, Rani is planning something big to ensure that she and her gang need not pursue small time thefts thereafter. What is Maddam Sir's next plan? What is Rani's master plan? Stay tuned to this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Rani's Mask is Off
episodesList.summary: After she holds Billu and Cheetah hostage, Rani robs the bank with her team and asks fake Billu to bury both of them. Endangering Billu and Cheetah's life, Rani and her team decide to flee the city with the stolen money. But Inspector Haseena and Inspector Karishma won't let them leave that easily. Tune in to this action-packed episode to know if Haseena captures her doppelganger or not.

episodesList.title: The Dysfunctional Family
episodesList.summary: Karishma and Pushpa's heated argument over senior citizen policy gets interrupted when Savitri, an elderly woman, visits the Police station all lost. Hence, Inspector Haseena asks Santosh to drop Savitri home and requests her to record everything that happens there. However, while watching the recordings, Haseena and Karishma sense something fishy about Savitri's son and daughter-in-law. What's wrong with Savitri's family? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: A Twist In Savitri's Case
episodesList.summary: Haseena turns a deaf ear when Savitri Devi pleads for help citing her unwillingness to stay in an old age home. Eventually, Savitri gets kidnapped from her own home. Did Maddam Sir's denial for help bring this hardship to Savitri? Is it Maddam Sir's incompetence this time? Stay tuned to find out as this case is about to take a twist.

episodesList.title: Disguise Brings Distress
episodesList.summary: In order to save Savitri from the clutches of her merciless son and daughter-in-law, Haseena comes up with a plan, according to which, along with Karishma she visits the old lady's house in disguise. Cheetah, posing as a lawyer, reaches there with the property papers. Karishma gets the original papers signed by Ajay. Just when everything seems to go as per plan, Karishma's wig falls off. The cops get exposed. If this is not surprising enough, something more drastic takes place right after.

episodesList.title: Karishma's Bullets Prove Too Costly
episodesList.summary: Ajay gets severely injured by Karishma's bullets. Both his kidneys are damaged and doctor suggests to go for an immediate operation, the cost of which is Rs. 25 lacs. Hearing this, Ajay and his wife are dumbstruck as they do not have that much money handy. It is then that Savitri Devi pitches in with a solution. Stay tuned to find out what's her solution.

episodesList.title: The Pinky-sheena Theft Case
episodesList.summary: A new case is filed at the Mahila Police Thana. Two neighbours - Pinky and Sheena - complain about their newly bought stuff being stolen every other day. They blame each other for the theft. However, the reality is something else. Can you believe that the thieves are not the regular street urchins but someone on the online platform who keeps track of their day to day activities? Maddam Sir has devised a unique approach to solving this case. Watch to know ahead.

episodesList.title: Batting For The Win
episodesList.summary: While Haseena and Karishma are gone, a robbery takes place behind their backs at the station. Furious at their folly, the DSP tells them to handover the case to the cyber cell. There they meet Vikram, the current incharge and Haseena informs him about the purpose of their visit. Determined to clear the stain on the department's name, Karishma says she'll do anything to ensure that both the teams work together to nab the culprit. Vikram agrees, but only if Karishma wins in the cricket challenge.

episodesList.title: Nabbing The Digital Chor
episodesList.summary: True to the plan, Haseena and team reach Sheena and Pinky's party as social media celebs, to nab the thief. They spot him spiking people's drinks and swiftly whisking away their valuables. Karishma almost gets hold of him but someone hits her hard on the head. Now with Karishma injured, will the MPT team's plan see the day's light? Keep watching to know better.

episodesList.title: Karishma In Kebab Case
episodesList.summary: A restaurant, run by twin brothers, is selected for a prestigious international food contest. Both the twins want to participate and present their kebab recipe, but the contest conditions will allow only one person with one recipe from the restaurant. The duo approaches Karishma for a solution. Parallelly, one Mr. Bill accuses the brothers of stealing his kebab recipe. How will Karishma handle this case?

episodesList.title: The Kebab Case Gets Spicier
episodesList.summary: The desi kebab shop is gaining popularity among the masses. Maddam Sir is at her wit's end that how can Lallan-Kallan's kebabs taste different from Yo Kebab's given that the ingredients are exactly the same. The kebab sample test results put her in further confusion. Just then, Karishma drags a person named Abdul and puts him behind the bars. However, the next day, Abdul is bailed out. Who is Abdul? What's his crime? Who bails him out? Continue watching this case till the end.

episodesList.title: The Zam Zam Secret
episodesList.summary: It's the day of the food competition and everyone is eyeing the tussle between Laziz Kebab and Yo Kebab. Lallan and Kallan are faced with a crisis whereby the main ingredient required to produce the perfect kebabs - Zam Zam - is available with their grandmother. With time running out fast, Karishma decides to help the brothers and goes ahead to fetch Zam Zam. The brothers' chance to win the contest now rests on her. Will she prove to be the savior? Catch this episode to see the contest outcome.

episodesList.title: Karishma's Trust, Haseena's Suspicion
episodesList.summary: A hassled family of a road-singer, Radha, meets Kairshma, to voice their concerns about their daughter being threatened by the people. Karishma, who gets floored by Radha's singing skills vows to keep the family safe and also help Radha find her way to Lucknow Idol. But Haseena on the other hand seems to be uneasy about the matter, since she has doubts if Radha is the real daughter. Will this skepticism create trouble between Haseena and Karishma? Is Radha really in danger? Find out here.

episodesList.title: The Right Father Match
episodesList.summary: In an attempt to confirm her doubt that Rajkumar is not Radha's actual father, Haseena sends Billu to their house secretly to gather information. But as luck would have it, Billu gets locked up in an almirah. However, he overhears something which surely proves to be a breakthrough in this case as far as Haseena is concerned. Karishma, on the other hand, is trying hard to push Radha into the singing competition. Will Haseena and Karishma have a consensus?

episodesList.title: Caught You Haseena!
episodesList.summary: Just as Haseena and Billu are trying to escape after gathering information about Radha's father, Karishma catches them red handed. Haseena puts up a good act in front of her and in turn, blames Billu for being the thief. On the Lucknow Idol front, Radha has reached the audition stage, and thanks Karishma didi for providing her with this opportunity. Karishma says she sees her own reflection in Radha.

episodesList.title: Radha's Real Parents
episodesList.summary: After receiving information from an unknown source about Radha being ferried out of the city by her so-called father, Haseena gets an idea. With her smart wit she summons Radha's real parents to Lucknow while indirectly hinting at her fake parents to stay put. Radha, on the other hand, is excited about the Lucknow Idol. Watch this interesting episode to find out if Haseena's plan works.

episodesList.title: Radha Competes With Her Father
episodesList.summary: While Karishma is determined to make Radha win the Lucknow Idol competition, Haseena's aim is to make her unite with her real parents. As the two officers go on about their tasks, Radha and her biological father stand face to face in the singing contest. Will Radha be able to defeat her father, who is a renowned singer? Stay tuned to this episode to know the answer.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir's Missing?
episodesList.summary: After the Mahila Police Thana team reunites Radha with her real parents, Karishma and others are shocked to know from her mother that Maddam Sir hasn't gone home the previous night. Where is our favourite cop? Tune in to this exciting episode now to find out.

episodesList.title: The Bomb Man
episodesList.summary: MPT is already in tough times with Maddam Sir missing. To add to the trouble, a man named Rahul Malya walks into the thana with a strange complaint. He is deprived of respect by his in-laws which has made him so desperate that he is ready to kill himself. He has a bomb attached to this body and is hell bent on pressing the trigger if his case is not solved within a day. Watch how Karishma takes over this case. Stay tuned.

episodesList.title: Karishma’s Haseena Approach
episodesList.summary: Baffled by the current case at hand, in which Rahul threatens to kill himself by a time bomb after being denied respect in his in-laws' house, Karishma is at a fix as to how to solve this case. For a change, she wishes Haseena were there in MPT to guide her. Watch this episode, as Karishma tries to think and act like Haseena to bring some sanity in this insane case.

episodesList.title: The Known Devil
episodesList.summary: There is a new case in MPT in which, a girl named Gauri is trying to prove herself alive by getting herself arrested. Unfortunately for Gauri, her brother, who is an influential builder, has used his money and power to prove her dead, so that he can have her share of the property as well. When Gauri reveals her brother's name, the whole MPT goes into shock. Who's he? Watch ahead to know more.

episodesList.title: Karishma's Drastic Approach
episodesList.summary: When Gauri reveals the name of her brother who is inflicting atrocities on her, the MPT team gets shell shocked, for the brother is none other than the owner of Asthana Builders. Hearing him talk of family and values on TV, Karishma loses her cool and ends up threatening him of dire consequences. This step of Karishma could mess up the entire case. Watch this episode to know what happens next.

episodesList.title: Decoding Gauri's Fake Death
episodesList.summary: Karishma takes an oath to not beat up anyone during Navratri. The team tries to lighten up Gauri's mood by celebrating her birthday but she feels sore within. Karishma and team find out that as per records Gauri's funeral had taken place in 2013. While the team contemplates their next step, Babita, with Billu's help, obtains the details of the doctor who had issued the fake death certificate in Gauri's case. Will the team succeed in nabbing the doctor or will Asthana create hurdles for the team?

episodesList.title: Karishma Locks Horns With Bansal
episodesList.summary: Karishma takes down the goons and Bansal is taken into custody. However, Karishma soon learns that just like Gauri, there are many other ladies who have been declared dead by Asthana for his selfish interest. Karishma vows to bring them justice. How will Bansal take this? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Karishma Threatened
episodesList.summary: It's the day of the court hearing. Karishma is rushing to the venue with Bansal. Parallelly Santosh is driving Gauri to the court. However, Krishma faces a dire situation on the way when her car is stopped by a goon, who then points a gun at Bansal and asks her to continue driving in a different direction. Everybody is waiting for her to arrive at the court. What happens next? Keep watching.

episodesList.title: Where to Find Karishma?
episodesList.summary: Karishma Singh goes missing in the middle of a jungle. The whole team is on her lookout and upon finding her shoe and mobile phone on the spot, they get certain that it is Asthana's doing. The team, however, is hopeful that she will soon be back with full force to destroy Asthana's evil deeds. Asthana, on the other hand, plans something nasty for her. Where is Karishma? What is Asthana thinking?

episodesList.title: Karishma Dead?
episodesList.summary: Asthana brings a fresh twist in Gauri's case, by producing a fake death certificate of Karishma Singh. The court asks Karishma to prove her identity and that she is actually alive. When she fails to do so, the court declares Asthana innocent and Karishma loses her job. Will Karishma accept her fate or will she fight back?

episodesList.title: Maa Durga's Darshan to Asthana
episodesList.summary: An unexpecting Asthana comes to inaugurate the Durga pooja, only to see Karishma herself as Maa Durga. Shocked beyond belief, he retaliates. But Karishma and her team prove to be strong on Asthana's bodyguards. Will Asthana lose and have to accept his misdoings? Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Billu Protests, Karishma Accused
episodesList.summary: Billu, who is upset with the government for increasing the price of onion, decides to start a protest. Soon, Billu is joined by many others and the situation turns chaotic. While Karishma is trying her best to bring the scenario under control, there is a reporter named Loveleen, who is trying to influence Billu to go on with the strike. In no time, Karishma is charged with a false accusation. Who is calling the shots against Karishma?

episodesList.title: Misri Takes Over Karishma
episodesList.summary: Karishma's pleas at being innocent in the lathi charge on the sleeping protesters accusation fall on deaf ears. Higher authorities of police take a drastic step and bring in a new SI named Misri, to the police station. Misri and Karishma have past scores to settle. However, presently Misri has been asked to take over the case of hike in onion price from Karishma. What will Karishma's next move be?

episodesList.title: Karishma, The Corrupt Officer?
episodesList.summary: Karishma is wrongly photographed by Misri, accepting wads of notes from the onion dealer. The next day, news headlines read that she had accepted a bribe from the dealer. Karishma promises to bring down the onion scam as well as prove herself innocent within twenty four hours. Will she succeed with cunning Misri's tailgating?

episodesList.title: Karishma Calls The Shots
episodesList.summary: Karishma follows a wrong person's cab assuming it's Brijesh. Soon, Karishma discovers that Misri has planted a mic on Santosh's uniform, such that she is able to hear all their discussions and in turn is helping Brijesh to evade Karishma. Next, Karishma thinks of a solid plan. Watch this episode to find out how Karishma tackles Misri and Brijesh.

episodesList.title: Haseena, Discharged Into Shock
episodesList.summary: Haseena is all well and finally set to resume duty after her quarantine. While she readies to leave, it is revealed that Radhe, the ward boy is not what he seems to be. Meanwhile, Karishma and Santosh's jeep breaks down and Bulbul Pandey tries to provoke Karishma, calling women inferior. Will Karishma be able to control her anger? And who is posing as Radhe the ward boy? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Karishma In Bulbul's Territory
episodesList.summary: After getting into a tiff with Karishma, Bulbul Pandey next harasses Karishma and Haseena, by insulting them of being incapable and threatens them of escalating the matter to the higher authorities, if they do not withdraw Radhe's case, since it concerns his territory. Will Mahila Police succumb to Pandey's threats?

episodesList.title: Haseena's Tug Of War
episodesList.summary: The tug of war starts between Haseena's team and Bulbul Pandey's team, but unfortunately, the rope breaks and the match ends up in a draw. Bulbul declares that the case will remain with him, since the match is a draw. Just then Karishma brings a twist to the event, when she asks Bulbul on camera to solve the case of Radhey.

episodesList.title: Bulbul's Happy Realisation
episodesList.summary: For Radhey's release, Haseena accepts Bulbul's condition and records a video statement about Mahila Police Thana being incompetent. Parallely, Karishma and Pushpa bump into Bulbul's pregnant wife, unaware of her identity. The heavily pregnant lady faints, but the cop ladies are unable to take her to the hospital. So, they bring a doctor to her, and enable her to deliver the child. When Bulbul finds out about this, he realises the importance of paternity leaves.

episodesList.title: Karishma's Irrational Belief
episodesList.summary: Doubt is a seed that can bloom even in the closest of the allies. Karishma is entrusted with nabbing a big criminal Musa. So, she gets on to the task and lays a trap for him. However, when she reaches the spot, she finds Haseena already there, which plants a doubt in her mind that Haseena is there to take away her case. But Haseena's presence is merely a coincidence and she is there on a separate case related to a woman.

episodesList.title: Haseena-karishma, Tussle Of Thought and Tact
episodesList.summary: Haseena and Karishma argue over having lost Moosa, the key culprit. A frustrated Karishma requests Haseena to let her handle the case in her own way going forward. While Victor, a witness picked up from the crime scene, tries to make a total parody of Haseena and her team's interrogation, Karishma makes sure she shows Moosa's minions their rightful place. But will they give her the necessary information after all?

episodesList.title: Musa's Identity is Revealed
episodesList.summary: Though Karishma is unsure of Haseena's intent, yet she accompanies her to track Musa. However, they are misled by Arjun. Karishma gets doubtful, and she drops Haseena on the way and leaves alone. Meanwhile, Santosh and the team, using facial aging software, discover that Musa is none other than Arjun himself. They relay this crucial information to Haseena, who gets concerned about Karishma's safety.

episodesList.title: Multiple Firs For Haseena
episodesList.summary: Haseena and Karishma ensure Musa is sent behind the bars. Right after, Haseena finds multiple people waiting at MPT to lodge FIRs. On probing, she finds that all of them have been cheated. She suspects that although the nature of frauds are different, the thug is the same. Let's find out Haseena's approach to solve this case.

episodesList.title: Haseena Struggles With The Thug Case
episodesList.summary: MPT receives one more complaint from a person, who has been sold a precious stone by the same thug. As Haseena tries hard to find a way out to nab the culprit, she concludes that this thug suffers from anxiety issues and sends her team to keep a check on the pharmacy customers. Karishma reaches very close to catching the culprit, but he manages to escape. It is a person, whom Haseena knows very well.

episodesList.title: Did Nawab Sell The Mansion?
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Police Thana is shocked when some people arrive, claiming that they have bought his mansion from the Nawab. Confused, Karishma calls the Nawab. The Nawab's arrival only convolutes the situation when he claims that he never sold the mansion. Both sides get into an argument. It is at this moment that Haseena checks the buyers' papers and is shocked to find her and Karishma's names as the witness. Enraged Nawab threatens the cops. Is this the end of Mahila Police Thana?

episodesList.title: The Mystery Of Naagin
episodesList.summary: Even after being hit hard the last time, the Mahila Police team persists in its hunt for the thug. They lay their trap in a location where the criminal is most likely to show up; an exhibition of a naag mani. It is conducted by a professor who claims that at exactly 12o'clock a naagin will emerge from the mani. At first, everyone is sceptical, but when a naagin does appear, it leaves them dumbstruck. Who's this naagin and what is her motive? But most importantly, where is the thug?

episodesList.title: Haseena Fights For The Kinnar
episodesList.summary: A transgender, in order to gain acceptability in the society, adopts a kid and raises her to the best of his ability. However, when she learns his truth, she throws him out of the house. Haseena is determined to get him justice, much to the discouraging words of Amma, the head of the transgender community. Watch Maddam Sir to know what ensues.

episodesList.title: Haseena's Helpful Intention
episodesList.summary: While Haseena is trying to figure out a way of getting the Kinnar employed, his daughter, Khushi, barges into the police station, and emotionally blackmails him, to extract money. Gopal, the kinnar, parts with his life's savings. But Khushi returns to the police station in a while. Why so? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Driving Sense Into Khushi
episodesList.summary: When the team lands at the kinnar's house, they request Gopal not to proceed with his idea of joining the kinnars. But Gopal, who dotes over his daughter, is ready to make this sacrifice, so that Khushi can get the 10 lakh rupees. This doesn't go down too well with the team and they decide to take Khushi to task. They try to remind her how Gopal has been there for her at every step of her life. Tune in to find out if the team's efforts reap success.

episodesList.title: Haseena, a Friend In Need
episodesList.summary: There's nothing as fulfilling as meeting someone whom you idolize, but for Haseena Malik, the experience is a rather disturbing one, when she meets her police academy idol Vikram Rajput in a tattered and disoriented state. She investigates and learns that months ago, Vikram was suspended as he raided an influential person's house without any warrant and ample proof, which led Vikram to his current predicament. Unable to see Vikram in his current state, Haseena decides to help him.

episodesList.title: Searching Without Warrant, Haseena?
episodesList.summary: Digging deep into Vikram's case, Haseena Malik and her team of cops come across Gaurishankar's house. In order to get some clues, our Maddam Sir takes a bold step and decides to search the house, without any warrant. Will they be able to find anything in the closed house? Watch this nail-biting episode to know.

episodesList.title: Haseena's Proposes Gaurishankar
episodesList.summary: Gaurishankar might have fooled Vikram, and has succeeded in getting him suspended, but the secrets that are buried, one day do get unearthed. For Gaurishankar, it happens when Haseena and Karishma lure him, on the pretext of a marriage proposal and discover that Vikram was right all along. Gaurishankar has locked a woman in a room and it's none other than his wife, Geeta. Will Haseena succeed in rescuing her, or will Gaurishankar again register a win?

episodesList.title: Karishma's Witch-hunt
episodesList.summary: Baal Uday orphanage is under a serious threat. The children are falling sick after eating their meals. Therefore, to investigate the matter, Mahila Police Thana gets assigned this case. Wasting no time, Haseena begins the investigation. A child tells her that the previous night he saw a witch entering the orphanage. But Karishma is skeptical. She insists on foul play. Then, on Haseena's order, Karishma, Cheetah and Santosh lay a trap to catch this alleged witch. Will they succeed?

episodesList.title: Rising Challenges For Haseena-karishma
episodesList.summary: With more cases being reported at the orphanage, Haseena can't seem to wrap her head around what's going on. The trouble escalates when the lab reports arrive, declaring no adulteration in the food samples. When the team reaches the orphanage, they get to know that Rani had the key to access the place. But when Rani explains her story, they are certain that she is not the culprit. Tune into this engaging episode to know what step the MPT team takes to save the children at Baal Uday orphanage.

episodesList.title: Karishma's Utter Helplessness
episodesList.summary: Karishma shows her big heart and instead of saving her prize money of seventy-five thousand rupees for the trip, she spends it to clean up the place which was polluting the orphanage and was making the children sick. However, two lawyer brothers, Amit Verma and Sumit Verma, allegedly re-pollute the area, thereby drawing Karishma's wrath. After luring them into a trap, Karishma is about to give them a good lesson when DSP calls her, telling her not to touch the brothers. What will Karishma do?

episodesList.title: Karishma’s Action Backfires
episodesList.summary: In the absence of Haseena, Karishma receives a complaint from three ladies, who are fashion models, that someone is harassing them with life-threat calls. Karishma soon deducts that the culprit is none other than the local political leader, Bablu. She wastes no time in confronting Bablu for his misdeed and drags him to the police station. But the tables turn, when Bablu claims that he has lost his mobile phone and files a complaint for the same. This is not a good news for Karishma. Why?

episodesList.title: The Perpetrator Threatens Karishma
episodesList.summary: Badnaam, Billu and Iqbal are swooning over the three models when Karishma Singh comes and wards them away. Seeing this, the three models express that Karishma is jealous of their beauty. Pushpa overhears this and gives them an earful about the same. It's then the perpetrator calls Karishma and warns her not to send the models for the final round or else they will meet their death. Though Karishma tries to catch the nasty man, she fails. What will Karishma do now?

episodesList.title: Sherlock Haseena
episodesList.summary: The stage is set and the trap is laid. Only one thing remains, and that is to put a member of the police team in the competition as an undercover. Soon, the fashion show begins and Haseena, along with her team, is on an alert mode. It's then, Karishma spots an electrician fiddling around the stage. It makes her suspicious and she decides to take some action against him. But before she can do anything, Haseena stops her and makes her aware of the real culprit.

episodesList.title: Haseena-karishma Versus The Kidnapper
episodesList.summary: When the news of a kidnapper, who has taken a few kids as hostage, reaches MPT, Haseena and Karishma head to the spot, separately, owing to their personal differences. Karishma, due to her ill-temper, loses the chance to convince the kidnapper. Haseena is the only hope now. Watch this episode to know if Haseena succeeds in setting the kids free.

episodesList.title: Karishma's Action Clashes With Haseena's Plan
episodesList.summary: Haseena, using her logic, handles the kidnapper quite well, whereby he even agrees to release a few kids, if his demands are fulfilled. But, it is Karishma's brashness that messes up the case totally. When the kidnapper sees her aiming a gun at him, he refuses to cooperate with Haseena any further. Haseena, reaching a dead end in the case, seeks professional help from the police higher authority.

episodesList.title: Who will Replace Haseena?
episodesList.summary: Haseena surprises Pushpa by mentioning that she is leaving MPT, owing to her never-ending differences with her impulsive co-worker, Karishma. In her place, a new officer has been deputed and Haseena's transfer orders are ready. Who will replace Haseena? How will Karishma take this news? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Haseena Gets Haldi’s Case
episodesList.summary: Haseena introduces her team to Anubhav, who s soon going to replace her in MPT. Just then, Brijesh walks in with a complaint about his fiancee, Haldi, who stars in a daily soap. Unlike her on-screen behavior of a sanskaari bahu, she is completely opposite in real life, and wants Brijesh to drive his aged parents out of the house. How will Haseena approach this case, with just two days to go for Brijesh s wedding?

episodesList.title: Karishma's Over Acting
episodesList.summary: When Haseena fails to convince Haldi to respect her in-laws, Karishma steps in with a challenge. If she can prove that she is living a happy life with her mom-in-law, Haldi must change her attitude towards her in-laws. Haldi accepts the challenge, and goes to Karishma's house. What follows is a funny turn of events, with Pushpa confused about Karishma's overly nice behavior towards her.

episodesList.title: Haldi Ka Raaz
episodesList.summary: Haseena is resolute about solving Haldi's case before leaving MPT. Hesitant, Anubhav still gives her a freeway to tackle the case unofficially. While Haseena keeps a sharp eye on Haldi's moves, she gets to know about the hooded man. In an attempt to excavate more details, Haseena decides to follow him. Tune into this dramatic episode, to find out which intriguing truth about Haldi makes its way to Haseena.

episodesList.title: Karishma Blackmails Haldi?
episodesList.summary: Haseena and Karishma have got hold of the fact that Haldi has had a bad marriage, in which she was tortured by her in-laws. Thus, she is jittery about living in a joint family, after her second marriage. Karishma suggests that blackmailing Haldi is the best solution, to make her live in a joint family, an option, Haseena disagrees with. Karishma challenges Haseena that she will solve the case before Haseena can return with the DSP's permission.

episodesList.title: Haldi's Happily Never After?
episodesList.summary: While Haldi feels the world has ended for her, Karishma tries to make Haldi look at her situation without the lens of the past, and with a fresh perspective. Just when Haldi finally gets convinced of going ahead with the marriage anyway, Haseena shows up with the news of Shankar having escaped from custody. Haldi's marriage procedure begins, whereas Shankar is on his way to the registrar's office. Will Karishma be able to keep him from blurting out the truth before Haldi's in-laws?

episodesList.title: Newborn Missing, Karishma Blamed
episodesList.summary: Karishma and her team rush to the hospital to find that a newborn is missing. The mother of the newborn is so shocked that she points a finger at the ward boy. Karishma, without analysing the situation, hits the ward boy, only to later realise that he is innocent. While the security incharge claims that the abductor must be in the hospital premises, the CCTV shows no such footage. Meanwhile, a crowd gathers against Karishma, to support the ward boy's innocence.

episodesList.title: Haseena-karishma At an Ivf Clinic
episodesList.summary: Through the CCTV footage, Haseena and Karishma learn about the presence of a mysterious lady at the hospital, and head out to find more details about her. A rickshaw driver helps Karishma with the location where he had dropped the lady from the hospital. The MPT ladies decide to visit the IVF clinic to find out if they are involved in child trade. While Haseena and Karishma step into the clinic to scout for evidence, DSP Anubhav arrives at the scene. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Trailing The Abductor, Karishma-haseena
episodesList.summary: Seeing Haseena pose as Anubhav's wife at the clinic, Karishma cannot resist herself from treading into a squabble with her. Right then, Santosh hands over a list of couples who have approached the IVF centres for a baby. After a rigorous screening, the MPT team zeroes down on a couple who confesses to buying a baby from a lady. In order to get close to the perpetrator, Santosh and Pushpa work on getting the sketch ready of the potential suspect. Will the team succeed in nabbing the culprit?

episodesList.title: Can Haseena Rescue Shikha's Baby?
episodesList.summary: Haseena and Karishma rely on the location shared by Santosh and accordingly track down the lady kidnapper. The lady confesses to her crime, and all the kids except Shikha's are rescued from her clutches. Haseena sets out on her own to find Shikha's kid. Will she succeed in her mission?

episodesList.title: Haseena Involved In a Drug Racket?
episodesList.summary: The news about drugs being extracted from Haseena's car spreads like a wildfire. While Hassena is brought in for an interrogation, the head-strong officer doesn't speak a word with regards to the allegations on her. Elsewhere, Karishma, who is absolutely sure that someone is trying to put Haseena in trouble, decides with the team to scavenge for the culprit. Tune into this exciting episode to know what happens thereafter.

episodesList.title: Karishma Finds a Precious Clue
episodesList.summary: While pursuing the person who trapped Haseena, Karishma and Santosh zero in on a cobbler, whom they suspect is related to the drug peddling. They plan to catch him red-handed, but Karishma loses her calm when the cobbler misbehaves with Santosh. Things mess up, but then Karishma accidentally finds drugs on the cobbler and arrests him. Initially, the cobbler prefers silence, but when Karishma puts itching powder on him, he yields and blurts out Babban's name.

episodesList.title: Haseena's Masterplan
episodesList.summary: When Karishma comes across the news piece carrying ill news about Haseena hoarding drugs, she blows her top. Though Sunny Chadda, the journalist, refuses to answer at first, Karishma eventually finds out that this move was planned by Haseena. Trying to track back all the events that have occurred so far, Karishma finally understands Haseena's reason for keeping mum and planning all this. Tune into this exciting episode to decode Haseena's plan.

episodesList.title: Haseena Catches The Drug Lords?
episodesList.summary: Haseena breaks the news about her mission to the team. MPT's strong force is ready to support Haseena through thick and thin in this mission. The drug lords enter the party, but are taken aback when they don't find any drugs with Haseena. Leveraging the opportunity, the MPT team brings out their guns, in order to take down the notorious culprits. However, Batra's intervention spoils their plan, as the criminals slip away from their hands. What will Haseena and team do now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Weight Woes
episodesList.summary: The team at MPT is all charged up for the fitness program, and is determined to help Pushpa lose some weight. Karishma and Haseena chart out a diet and exercise plan for Pushpa. But Pushpa falls for an advertisement on TV, and opts for their diet plan. However, she ends up gaining weight instead of losing it. Mad at the company who cheated her with the wrong diet plan, Pushpa lodges a complaint against them at MPT, under the guise of Anarkali's name. Tune in to know what happens thereafter.

episodesList.title: Hassled Pushpa, Resolute Anubhav
episodesList.summary: When Pushpa notices that no one is taking Anarkali's complaint seriously, she gets enraged, and blows her top. Puzzled at Pushpa's overwhelming behaviour, Haseena permits her to visit LPJ's office along with Karishma. However, unable to control her anger, Pushpa almost attacks the founder of LPJ. Meanwhile, Anubhav meets his senior to get some crucial information on Mahipal's case. Who is Mahipal? Why is Anubhav on his trail?

episodesList.title: Trailing The Fraudsters, Haseena
episodesList.summary: Pushpa rings up Haseena at MPT as Anarkali, in order to push her case forward. But due to her carelessness, her secret is caught by Haseena. Later, on being questioned, Pushpa tells Haseena her reasons for choosing the diet, and tells her how other people are being duped due to the LPJ Fitness as well. Though Pushpa finds a lead for evidence, things go awry. Tune in to find out what plan will Haseena come up with in order to nab the fraudsters.

episodesList.title: Balli Ka Khel Khatam
episodesList.summary: Maddam sir says that Anarkali will get justice and will also get her money back. She decides to make Balli realize that whatever he is doing is wrong and takes Sunny's help to do so. Watch the full episode to find out Maddam sir's master plan to teach Balli a lesson.

episodesList.title: Haseena's Gift
episodesList.summary: Haseena and Anubhav share an awkward moment as the DSP tries to hand her over a gift. Later, Pushpa and Santosh manage to get Shalini back to the police station so she could share why she left the station without registering the FIR.

episodesList.title: Witchhunt For The Womanizer
episodesList.summary: Pushpaji shows up at Karishma's desk early in the morning with a piece of spicy news. But Karishma asks her to stop bothering her with gossips, not knowing what the news is about. Later, Madamsir and Karishma join forces with Billu to find and pin the womanizer.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir's Return Gift
episodesList.summary: Santosh catches a motorcyclist without a helmet and finds out that he is about to lose his job because he can't speak English. She guarantees that she would do everything in her power to help him retain his work. Later, they are shocked to find Maddam Sir at DSP Anubhav's office exchanging gifts.

episodesList.title: Santosh Goes Undercover
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and the team decide to investigate the bank where Bharat works to find out if they are trying to cover up a scam. Meanwhile, Billu is taking English lessons for everyone at the station so that they can handle themselves in future scenarios.

episodesList.title: Karishma Goes Undercover
episodesList.summary: Karishma infiltrates the bank as an employee and starts her investigation. She manages to flag a cashier as a probable suspect, but Maddam Sir asks her not to bring him in for questioning. An enraged Karishma confronts Maddam Sir, seeking answers.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir's Lesson to Viral
episodesList.summary: Bharat helps Viral by finding out the real thief. Rahul gets taken into custody and, Viral realises his mistake and hires Bharat again. Next day, Dipti comes to the police station with a complaint against her brother, that he is not giving her share from the paternal property. Akash and Dipti's brother also comes to the police station and asks Billu to help him in sorting the case.

episodesList.title: Karishma Catches Maddam Sir
episodesList.summary: On interrogating the maid, Karishma finds Dipti is meeting someone daily at 4 pm in the park. As Maddam sir in on her way to meet the guy, her mother asked her to, her car breaks down. Luckily, DSP Anubhav watches her and comes to her aid.

episodesList.title: Karishma Wins Back The Akhada
episodesList.summary: Dipti is on the cusp of losing her father's akhada at the hands of her brother who does not think that women won't be able to successfully run the place. Karishma tactfully deals with the situation and helps Dipti retain her akhada.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Fights Karishma
episodesList.summary: Everyone at the station has sore bodies after training for the wrestling match. Karishma finds out that Maddam Sir has canceled her subscription from a matrimonial website. Later, before their wrestling match for the leadership of Hanumaan Akhada, Karishma confronts Maddam Sir about the website's subscription.

episodesList.title: Karishma's Wrestling Fight
episodesList.summary: Despite Maddam Sir's advice, Karishma decides to take on the wrestling match. DSP Anubhav offers to train Karishma so she can win and be safe at the same time. However, Dharampal poisons Karishma's water so she would be incapable of fighting. Things get tense when DSP Anubhav drinks the water and Maddam Sir finds out about the poison.

episodesList.title: Karishma Conquers
episodesList.summary: Karishma's wrestling match against the powerful fighter begins. Soon, with DSP Anubhav's guidance, she manages to perform well and win the fight. Later, a married couple enters the station to register a complaint against their maid who stole their belongings and disappeared.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Seeks Karishma's Advice
episodesList.summary: Karishma and Maddam Sir are worried about the maids who are robbing from the homes they start working in. They decide to meet with DSP Anubhav with the hopes of uncovering new leads. Later, Maddam Sir calls Karishma to her office seeking advice on a personal matter.

episodesList.title: Karishma and Maddam Sir's Conflict
episodesList.summary: DSP Anubhav cleverly resolves the conflict between Karishma and Haseena. They realize that if they work together as teammates, they will solve their cases quicker and more efficiently. Soon, they start finding new leads and uncover the truth behind the scam of the maid agencies.

episodesList.title: Pushpa is Back
episodesList.summary: Karishma still has no leads through the drawings of the faces of the potential suspects. Maddam Sir reveals that those suspects are actually the victims of the same maid agency. Pushpa arrives back at the station, full of confidence, and has a new lead that will clear all the confusion.

episodesList.title: Karishma Uses Violence
episodesList.summary: Pia tells Haseena how Kabir is forcing her to accept his proposal. Karishma and Pushpa meet with Kabir and asks him to back off. Soon, things get out of hand, and Karishma pulls her gun out. Everyone is shocked when they realize that Kabir has gone to the media to gain sympathy.

episodesList.title: Haseena Loves Dsp Anubhav
episodesList.summary: Haseena's Ammi finds a boy for her and, he turns out to be DSP Anubhav Singh. Pushpa Ji catches her staring at his picture and, Maddam Sir confesses her feelings to her. Meanwhile, Sunny gives romance lessons to Cheetah. Suddenly, DSP Anubhav comes there and, Pushpa gets excited and tells him that Haseena has a question for him.

episodesList.title: Cheetah's Love Counselling
episodesList.summary: Everyone at the station tries to counsel Kabir with hopes that he will stop stalking. Later, Dutta Ji calls Maddam Sir with his hidden motives that Haseena is unaware of DSP Anubhav, who has tapped Haseena's phone, quickly grasped the situation and plans to act on it.

episodesList.title: Haseena's Prem Prasthav
episodesList.summary: As a last-ditch effort to make Kabir realize his mistakes, Santosh carries on with her plan to tie him and force him to accept her love. On the other hand, Haseena finally gathers the strength to tell Anubhav how she feels, and DSP Anubhav accepts her proposal without any hesitation.

episodesList.title: Haseena and Anubhav's Coffee Date
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir, along with Pushpa and Santosh, visit the hospital to take Nisha to the court but soon realizes that her child has gone missing. Later, Haseena surprises Anubhav when she shows up at his doorstep late at night to have a cup of coffee.

episodesList.title: Karishma Adopts Roshni?
episodesList.summary: Karishma decides to take care of Roshni till Nisha can come out of jail and take care of the baby herself. But, things take a turn for the worse when the team finds out that Nisha has been given a life sentence. Maddam Sir realizes that the verdict has been given based on testimonies of people, and these people can be lying.

episodesList.title: Bulbul Pandey's Half Truth
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and Karishma finally meet the officer to lead the Nisha case. They try to explain that his report contains half the truth and Nisha is just an online influencer trying to spread awareness. However, Inspector Bulbul Pandey is adamant that his report contains all the facts. Maddam Sir plans to teach him a lesson.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir's Tapped Phone
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir visits DSP Anubhav's office and finds the phone that the DSP uses to tap her phone. Meanwhile, back at the Mahila Police Station, everyone is having a balloon blowing competition when they see Maddam Sir arrive in a dazed state of mind.

episodesList.title: Dsp Anubhav Reveals The Truth
episodesList.summary: After Maddam Sir has put DSP Anubhav through a lie detector test, he reveals the truth behind his actions. He tells everything about the terror strike and her Chacha ji's involvement in it. Meanwhile, everyone at the station is waiting for Maddam Sir to address the children.

episodesList.title: Karishma Singh will Obey Every Order
episodesList.summary: Karishma Singh walks into DSP Anubhav and Haseena Mallik talking about pretending to be in love. She suspects they are hiding something and follows Maddam Sir the next day to find the DSP and Maddam Sir training for a secret mission. They don't allow her to join them for the mission. She interprets that it is because she does not follow any orders. Karishma now decides to do anything that Maddam Sir will ask her to do without any questions.

episodesList.title: Karishma's Promise
episodesList.summary: Karishma, as persistent as ever, insists that Maddam Sir and DSP Anubhav allow her to assist. Anubhav reveals that the ones going on this mission may not come back alive, and that is why Maddam Sir wasn't accepting anyone's assistance. But, later everyone from the station does not take no as an answer and force DSP Anubhav to include them.

episodesList.title: Mission Jeet Commences
episodesList.summary: The entire team sets out on mission jeet to stop the deadly virus from spreading throughout the journey. Pushpa requests Karishma to stay calm and composed throughout. Soon, the team reaches Maddam Sir's house where they meet her uncle. They try to extract information before taking any action.

episodesList.title: Karishma Singh Captured
episodesList.summary: Karishma finds a hidden room in the hospital and tries to extract information. But she is forced to fight the agents who were handling the virus in that room. Datta takes Karishma down, and the entire squad is now searching for her. Soon, Maddam Sir finds out that it is Genda, and not her uncle, who is behind everything.

episodesList.title: Genda - The Mastermind
episodesList.summary: After Haseena and Karishma go missing, DSP Anubhav starts getting agitated and forces Haseena's uncle to reveal their location. However, he is not involved in anything and does not take his aggression well, and asks the team to leave their house. Karishma and Maddam Sir work together and manage to escape and interrupt Genda's evil plan in the final minute.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Poisoned
episodesList.summary: Karishma and Anubhav quickly bring Maddam Sir, who is poisoned back home. Karishma is given the task to keep her awake while, Anubhav searches for the antidote. Later, a married couple shows up at the station where the wife claims that her drunk husband has sold off five of their properties.

episodesList.title: Karishma Teaches The Drunkard a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir, along with Karishma and Cheetah, try to counsel Ashok. However, he is still adamant about not quitting his drinking habits. So, the team, with the help of his wife, comes up with a clever plan that will open his eyes.

episodesList.title: Badnaam and Iqbal Missing
episodesList.summary: Karishma asks Badnaam and Iqbal to stay out of Maddam Sir's sight after her plan gets them injured. Soon, Badnaam shows up as Dimple, his wife, with tea and tells everyone that her husband has gone to his hometown. Ashok smuggles oranges into the station which are spiked with alcohol and people at the station, not knowing about it, eat them.

episodesList.title: Ashok Hibernates For 20 Years
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and Karishma ask Ashok to bring ice for them. They lock him inside the freezer as soon as he gets in. The next day, he comes out and gets surprised to find everyone old. He finds he has been hibernating for 20 years. It reduces Ashok to tears when he finds his wife begging for money and his son becoming a drunk like him.

episodesList.title: Best Police Thana
episodesList.summary: Ashok gets a glimpse into the future where his family will have to suffer because of his drinking habit. He agrees to quit drinking and admits himself to a rehabilitation centre. Later, Maddam Sir reveals that there will be a competition to see which police station is the best in Lucknow.

episodesList.title: Bulbul Pandey Insults The Women's Police Station
episodesList.summary: Karishma and her team successfully ambush the kidnapper, who reveals that he did it because the victim asked him to do so. Later, Bulbul Pandey arrives at the station to make fun of the work they do in the women's police station.

episodesList.title: Saas-bahu Problems
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir requests DSP Anubhav to go shopping with her and act like a couple for a day. Back at the station, Karishma and Pushpa try to solve the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law's quarrel.

episodesList.title: The Saas-bahu Role Reversal
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir removes Karishma and Pushpa from the Saas-Bahu case and takes the lead herself. Bulbul Pandey arrives at the station to watch all of them fail. Later, Karishma and Pushpa end up becoming participants of Maddam Sir's "Saas-Bahu Debate", but now their roles are reversed.

episodesList.title: Billu - The Writer
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir finally pulls out her principal weapon to put an end to the saas-bahu case. Later, Billu writes a movie script about two female police officers who resemble Maddam Sir and Karishma. He also pitches his story to a movie director, who is intrigued by the concept.

episodesList.title: Billu Needs His Family
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and Karishma find out that Shambu Spielberg has made a movie based on their real-life characters, a story that was pitched to him by Billu. Later, Billu confronts him but he is put behind bars in Bulbul's station. Maddam Sir is now determined to teach Shambu a lesson.

episodesList.title: Haseena and Karishma Role Reversal
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and Karishma go undercover as they decide to audition for their roles. However, both get selected to play each other's real-life characters. Soon, Maddam Sir realizes Shambu records everything on his phone and it might have a recording of Billu pitching his story.

episodesList.title: Billu is Not Alone
episodesList.summary: Santosh clones Shambu's phone to find the evidence that will exonerate Billu. However, Bulbul calls Shambu asking him to delete the video if he does not want to get caught. Maddam Sir has to come up with another clever plan to catch Shambu off-guard.

episodesList.title: Tiger In The Station
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir finds everyone busy with their phones at the station. She declares a no phone day at least once a week. Soon, Pushpa receives a call informing her about a tiger that is running lose in the city. Later, the tiger finds its way to the Mahila Police Thana.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Saves The Tiger
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and Karishma pull Pushpa out of the room where the tiger is trapped. Soon, a mob accumulates that wants the tiger killed as it has caused a lot of harm to them. Maddam Sir comes up with a plan to save the tiger and disperse the mob.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Warns Karishma
episodesList.summary: Bulbul Pandey is diverting all his cases to the women's police station that has caused a fall in the efficiency of the station. Karishma plans to solve these cases privately without registering the FIR to help her station edge ahead in the "Best Police Station competition."

episodesList.title: Karishma's Private Police Station
episodesList.summary: Karishma Singh goes against Maddam Sir's order and starts solving cases privately. How will Maddam Sir react when she finds out the things that are happening at her police station?

episodesList.title: Karishma - The Walking Talking Police Station
episodesList.summary: Karishma and her associates at her private police station find success in solving crimes. Soon, they are greeted by an intriguing civilian who finds their work skeptical.

episodesList.title: Whose Side are You On?
episodesList.summary: Karishma asks Billu to secretly give her a report of every case coming to the police station. What will happen when Maddam Sir finds out the truth? Will Karishma and Maddam sir patch things up?

episodesList.title: Karishma has Eyes On The Prize
episodesList.summary: Karishma will go to any extent to help her police station win the 'Best Police Station' award, even when she is not on duty. Will she succeed in keeping the crime rate low?

episodesList.title: Live For Yourself
episodesList.summary: Pallavi gets admitted to the hospital as she gets exhausted due to stress and working for the family all day. Maddam Sir comes up with an elaborate plan to teach her a valuable lesson.

episodesList.title: Karishma is Back!
episodesList.summary: Karishma apologises to Maddam Sir and rejoins her duty. However, she is more determined than ever to win the "Best Police Station" competition.

episodesList.title: Station's Future Looks Bleak
episodesList.summary: Santosh pulls out all statistics to find out that their station lies at the bottom of the charts. Maddam Sir reveals that if things remain unchanged, then there will be no future for their Women's Police Station.

episodesList.title: Close Calls For Karishma
episodesList.summary: Karishma manages to make narrow escapes multiple times, however, she is still headstrong about winning the competition.

episodesList.title: Finding Qayamat
episodesList.summary: Everyone lays down an elaborate plan to teach Sanjay a lesson. Later, Sunny shows up with information about Qayamat. Will Maddam Sir find out the truth about her?

episodesList.title: Two Cases One Qayamat
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir gives Billu the task to resolve two cases at the same time. Later at night, Qayamat shows up at the station and helps with the cases in her style.

episodesList.title: Tara or Sitara - Who Came First?
