episodesList.summary: Amar and Haseena's team look for clues separately and try to trace the woman who has been threatening to blow up the city. Will they make progress in the case and catch the culprit?

episodesList.title: Burnt Hands
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team come to know that the woman can be identified by the burnt marks on her hands. Can the team locate her before she blows up the city?

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Thane Se Bahar
episodesList.summary: Santosh dreams of Maddam Sir being sent out of the Mahila Police Thana and gets worried. Meanwhile, Amar Vidrohi continues to humiliate Maddam Sir and her team.

episodesList.title: Rescuing Santosh
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team think of ways to find Santosh and rescue her from her kidnappers. Can the team get to her on time?

episodesList.title: Kidnapping Ka Motive
episodesList.summary: The entire team puts everything they have into finding out more about Santosh's kidnapping and its motive. Can they nab the culprits who plotted this heinous crime?

episodesList.title: The Stalker
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team come across a desperate woman running away from a stranger frantically. Upon questioning, she reveals that a stalker has been following her and attacked her with a knife. Can the team help her?

episodesList.title: Dhula Hua Sacch
episodesList.summary: Trisha and her husband return to the Mahila Police Thana, blaming each other for the murder attempt. Maddam Sir and Amar believe in different sides of their story. What will the investigation reveal?

episodesList.title: Nandu Ka Bhoot
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir comes up with a plan to catch and get rid of Nandu's spirit. However, things take a turn for the worse when Santosh's acting goes a little too far.

episodesList.title: Sindoor Se Hallucinations
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir figures out that a chemical mixed in Trisha's sindoor is causing her to hallucinate. Later, Maddam Sir and Karishma go undercover at a restaurant to find Amar on a date.

episodesList.title: Amar's Date Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: After Maddam Sir troubles Amar on his date night, he confronts the Mahila Police Thana team for causing problems in his personal life. The grandmother of Amar's date shows up at the thana to report that her granddaughter has gone missing. How will the team find her?

episodesList.title: Amar Disobeys Orders
episodesList.summary: Amar disobeys the DSP's order to help Maddam Sir find and rescue Avni. Will their joint investigation speed up the process of finding the kidnappers?

episodesList.title: Amar and Maddam Sir Join Forces
episodesList.summary: The DSP orders Amar and Maddam Sir to take their job seriously if they want to keep their jobs. The two keep their competition aside and join forces to save the life of an innocent girl.

episodesList.title: Jurm Ka Andhadhun Rasta
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir arrives in the nick of time to save Karishma and Avni from the kidnapper. Later, a boy with weird ideas shows up at the Mahila Police Thana. How will Maddam Sir and the team help the boy out?

episodesList.title: Chamatkari Baccha
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir decides to deal with the child herself in a sensitive way. After the child gives information about a drug dealer, Karishma decides to verify his intel.

episodesList.title: Farji Sasur Ji
episodesList.summary: After Karishma scolds the child, Maddam Sir asks her to get him back to the station. Santosh leaves the locker keys with Pushpa, who is distracted by the child. Will the Mahila Police Thana team manage to uncover the truth about the child?

episodesList.title: The Truth About Montu
episodesList.summary: The child runs away with the drugs stored in the police station along with Pushpa, who has no clue about the truth. The Mahila Police Thana team tries to track their location and find out who is forcing the child to do the dirty work.

episodesList.title: Saving Montu
episodesList.summary: Karishma tries to talk sense into Montu and help him make the right decision. Meanwhile, the men from the narcotics department arrive at the Mahila Police Thana to retrieve the drugs. How will Maddam Sir handle the situation?

episodesList.title: Jaan Ki Dhamkiyan
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir orders Amar to be on standby till he gets fit to handle cases. She also frees him from saluting her as they both share the same passion for delivering justice.

episodesList.title: An End to The Threats
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and Amar decide to get on the dating app to get close to the guy who keeps sending threats. How will the Mahila Police Thana team bring the racket down?

episodesList.title: Vishwasghaat Ka Mudda
episodesList.summary: The DSP tells Maddam Sir that there is a mole in her station and asks her to find the person. Shikha, a voice-over artist, arrives at the Mahila Police Thana complaining about the troubles with her lover.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Aur Karishma Ki Dosti
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir's troubles get the better of her as she ends up being harsh to Karishma. Karishma, badly hurt, reverts to her old aggressive self. How will Maddam Sir mend her relationship with Karishma?

episodesList.title: Apno Ke Saath Ladai
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir puts her faith in Karishma to do the right thing despite their differences. Amar offers Karishma the information he has gathered on the Shikha case. Will the investigations reveal the truth behind Shikha and Amit's quarrel?

episodesList.title: Gussa Aur Jazbaat
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir opens up to Karishma about one of her past cases. A woman named Suman arrives at the station to report her daughter's stolen wedding ring. How will the Mahila Police Thana team help her?

episodesList.title: Mummy Ka Maun Vrat
episodesList.summary: Amar and his subordinate go to meet Haseena's mother and convince her to keep a 'maun vrat' till Haseena agrees to get married. Meanwhile, things remain bitter between Haseena and Karishma at the police station.

episodesList.title: Angoothi Ka Sacch
episodesList.summary: Suman suspects that a beggar has eaten her daughter's wedding ring. Maddam Sir gets surprised when she investigates the family where Suman's daughter is going to get married. What is the truth behind this lost ring?

episodesList.title: 3 Lakh Ke Aam
episodesList.summary: Suman reveals the truth about her daughter's wedding ring. Santosh gets pulled into a phone call, where she discovers a cyphered message. What trouble looms over Lucknow now?

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Ki Shaadi?
episodesList.summary: Santosh and Karishma witness an international arms deal take place in front of them and record it on their phones. Meanwhile, Haseena meets the groom-to-be, on a date.

episodesList.title: Shaadi Ke Liye Der Nahi
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir's mother insists that she should get married soon but others try to convince her to wait. Karishma tries to help Haseena by instigating the groom and hoping he cancels the wedding. Meanwhile, the team receives more intel on the arms smuggling case.

episodesList.title: Meeting With Big B
episodesList.summary: Amar and his team organise a sting operation on Big B and try to solve the case before Karishma's team. Meanwhile, Haseena meets the groom-to-be for a date again.

episodesList.title: Breakup Bill
episodesList.summary: Mahila Police Thana come across an unusual case where a woman claims that her ex-boyfriend has been harassing her and asking for the money he had spent on her. Can Haseena and her team help this woman?

episodesList.title: Helping Prachi
episodesList.summary: Prachi starts to panic as the entire Mahila Police Thana team tries to help her escape her ex-boyfriend's threats. Can Amar and Haseena's team help her get out of this situation?

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Gets Raided
episodesList.summary: The CBI raids the Mahila Police Thana and Maddam Sir's house and finds illegal weapons. Karishma advises Maddam Sir to sneak out of town and try to prove their innocence.

episodesList.title: Husband Wife Ka Mamla
episodesList.summary: Santosh and Cheetah see a man harassing a woman on the road and bring him in for investigation. But upon questioning, they find out that the man is the woman's husband. How will they deal with the situation?

episodesList.title: Amar Ki Didi Aane Wali Hai
episodesList.summary: Amar gets worried when he gets the news that his sister will be visiting the station. He requests everyone in the thana to speak highly of him when his sister arrives. Will the team agree to his request?

episodesList.title: Amar's Sister In Town
episodesList.summary: Amar puts on a show for his sister to impress her with his position in the thana. Meanwhile, the Mahila Police Thana team praises Amar so that they don't get in trouble for losing the medal.

episodesList.title: Misri Pandey Ki Entry
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Police Thana manages to solve the couple's issues and guides them to the right path. Meanwhile, Misri Pandey makes a comeback as she joins the Mahila Police Thana.

episodesList.title: Misri Takes Over
episodesList.summary: Misri takes over the Mahila Police Thana and declares Maddam Sir to be a fugitive on the run. Can the rest of the team work together to stop Misri?

episodesList.title: Misri Ka Parivartan
episodesList.summary: After the couple reveals that they are unfit to bear a child, Misri asks them to get a medical report. The Mahila Police Thana team finds it difficult to work with Misri. Will they manage to get their station back in control?

episodesList.title: Baccho Ki Khushi
episodesList.summary: The Mahila police thana team tries different approaches to solve the case. Can the team convince the elderly couple not to force their children to have kids?

episodesList.title: Khaddo Mein Sadke
episodesList.summary: Karishma meets with a bike accident on her way to work and injures herself. Amar informs her that the local politician is the reason behind all incomplete work and hazardous conditions. Will Karishma file a complaint?

episodesList.title: Misri Ki Chaal
episodesList.summary: Misri misleads Cheetah and Santosh and gets them into trouble. Will Karishma be able to save the Thana from Misri's schemes?

episodesList.title: Foreign Delegation
episodesList.summary: The Mahila police thana decides to fake the visit of a foreign delegation in order to get the potholes repaired. Will this plan work out for the team?

episodesList.title: Namaste to The Queen
episodesList.summary: Karishma meets Lassi with her team disguised as foreign royalty. Will this trick work on the politician?

episodesList.title: Platform For Sale
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Police Thana team bid Amar and his team sweet goodbyes to reclaim their station. Karishma discovers that someone is trying to sell off the railway station's platform. What will the Mahila Police Thana team do?

episodesList.title: Wasiyat Ki Sacchai
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Police Thana speed up their investigation and try to find the lawyer who wrote this royal will. Can he provide the answers that Karishma and her team are looking for?

episodesList.title: Platform Ki Mystery
episodesList.summary: Karishma instructs Santosh to dig deeper into the case before Misri interferes. Meanwhile, Misri brokers a deal to sell the platform to a foreign investor. Will she get away with this?

episodesList.title: Do do Karishma?
episodesList.summary: Pushpa ji gets shocked to see Karishma dance on a film set but Karishma denies being there. Is Karishma lying or is it all in Pushpa ji's head?

episodesList.title: Karishma Ki Judwa Behen
episodesList.summary: Karishma's twin sister is in town, shooting for a South Indian film and needs her help. Will Karishma agree?

episodesList.title: Behen Ko Kaise Sambhale?
episodesList.summary: The entire Mahila Police Thana is shocked to see Kareena, Karishma's twin sister. But Karishma is worried that her sister will bring her trouble.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Ki Wapasi
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir returns to the station and reveals the truth about the guy who was trying to frame her. Cheetah checks into a room and wakes up to find himself in trouble. How will he save himself?

episodesList.title: Lodge Ki Mystery
episodesList.summary: A couple comes to the Mahila Police Thana and claims that their daughter has gotten kidnapped from the lodge they had been staying. Cheetah gets worried as he spent time in the same lodge. Can Maddam Sir find the missing girl and help Cheetah?

episodesList.title: Investigating The Lodge
episodesList.summary: Kareena creates a scene outside the police station and makes Karishma furious. Meanwhile, Santosh tells Maddam Sir that somebody had ripped off pages from the register.

episodesList.title: Cheetah In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Cheetah opens up to Maddam Sir about the lodge incident. Santosh loses all trust in him after his confessions. However, Maddam Sir is convinced that there is more to the case than what meets the eye.

episodesList.title: Clearing Cheetah's Name
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir speaks to the missing girl and gets a clearer picture of the case. She makes an elaborate plan to make Santosh realise that Cheetah is innocent.

episodesList.title: Adal Badal
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir suggests that the twins swap their lives so that they understand each other better and get what they want. Will Karishma and Kareena agree?

episodesList.title: Shoes Don't Fit
episodesList.summary: Karishma and Kareena realise they do not fit in each other's shoes and gain respect for their professions. Maddam Sir decides to contact NGOs to help with Billu's health issues.

episodesList.title: Billu Baba Ki Jai
episodesList.summary: Billu submits himself to Mahadev and takes up the role of Billu Baba. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir and her team look for the con woman on the run.

episodesList.title: Billu Ka Ilaaj
episodesList.summary: Kareena and Pushpa meet the website owner and inform him about the con woman. They also request him to put Billu on the website in order to acquire the finances required for his medical treatment.

episodesList.title: Chasing Nafeesa
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir follows Nafeesa into a dangerous and lawless locality. Will she be able to capture her and bring her to the station safely?

episodesList.title: Bike Chori Ka Mamla
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team investigate the bike theft problem in the area. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir gives an inspiring speech and rekindles the sense of patriotism in her team.

episodesList.title: More Missing Bikes
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team investigate the bike theft cases but end up going around in circles. Will they find something relevant and crack the case?

episodesList.title: Bike Chor Nirdosh Hai
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team catch hold of Nirdosh and grill him for his lies. However, Nirdosh claims that he had stolen them under unavoidable circumstances. Will Maddam Sir believe him again?

episodesList.title: Rama Acts Strange
episodesList.summary: Karishma gets surprised when her childhood friend is suddenly rude to her. Will she find out the reason behind this strange behaviour?

episodesList.title: Rama Ko Kaise Kare Madad
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir gets a unique idea to help Rama get out of her submissive mindset and stand up for her rights. Will Haseena Malik's plan work?

episodesList.title: Jeevan Par Adhikar
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir has an idea of organising a Dahi Handi competition between Saans and Bahu. Who will come out on top?

episodesList.title: Electricity Ka Bill
episodesList.summary: The Police officers in Mahila Police Thana get their electricity bill and are shocked to see the amount. How much have they been charged?

episodesList.title: Thaane Ki Light Kati
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Police Thana members find out that there will be no electricity in the station for 8 days. Can they find a solution to this?

episodesList.title: Khud Se Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team teach Tripathi a lesson and make him realise the importance of honesty and dedication in a Government job. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir gets the news about a woman who wishes to marry herself.

episodesList.title: Sarpa Mitra
episodesList.summary: Karishma struggles on the set because of the addition of a snake in the plotline. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir and her team get complaints about a real snake.

episodesList.title: Nagin Se Mulaqat
episodesList.summary: Haseena comes face to face with the woman who claims to be an 'Icchadhari Nagin' looking for her lover. How will Maddam Sir deal with this unusual case?

episodesList.title: Nagin Ka Pratishodh
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir has an idea to teach Kirti a valuable life lesson which will help her take the right decisions for herself.

episodesList.title: Flight Mein Bomb
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Police Thana receives information about a bomb on a flight. Is there any truth behind this information?

episodesList.title: Running Out Of Ideas
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Police Thana thinks of ways to get the confession out of the prank callers. Will they be successful in the venture?

episodesList.title: Outwitting The Prank Callers
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team try and outwit the prank callers and punish them for their crimes. Will they be successful?

episodesList.title: Aryan Ki Zidd
episodesList.summary: Can Maddam Sir and her team convince Aryan to get out of the house?

episodesList.title: Aryan Ki Sacchai
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team decide to look deep into Aryan's statement and find out if there is any truth to it.

episodesList.title: Memory Gayab
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team have some unique ideas on how to get more information on the man who has lost his memory. Will they be successful?

episodesList.title: Long Lost Brother
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team try to find the man's brother, hoping to get more information on the man who has lost his memory.

episodesList.title: Bhootiya Drama
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir makes an elaborate plan to make the elder brother realise that he has been forgetting his responsibilities. Will her plan work out?

episodesList.title: Pizza Delivery
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir receives a mysterious phone call where a woman begs for immediate help while pretending to order a pizza. Can Maddam Sir save this woman from her captors?

episodesList.title: Kidnappers Ka Peecha
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team desperately look for the kidnappers by tracing their wifi network. Can they reach there on time?

episodesList.title: Bombscare
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team crackdown on the kidnappers and rescue the hostages. Later, the team receives information about bomb blasts being planned out in the city.

episodesList.title: Suicide Bomber Kaun Hai?
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team try to find out who the suicide bomber is but soon run out of leads. Will they crack down on her before innocents lose their lives?

episodesList.title: Beheno Mein Daraar
episodesList.summary: Karishma Singh is convinced that her sister is at fault and points the gun at her. Can Maddam Sir convince Karishma about her sister's innocence?

episodesList.title: Kareena Khatre Mein
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team close in on the people who have been planning the bombings. Kareena takes a huge step and puts her life on the line. Can Maddam Sir and her team save Kareena and capture the criminals?

episodesList.title: Defusing The Threat
episodesList.summary: Kareena gets strapped to a time bomb. Maddam Sir and the others are in a race against time to defuse the bomb and save Kareena's life.

episodesList.title: John Tripathi Ka Interrogation
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir calls in John Tripathi to ask him about Jahnvi but he refuses to speak without a lawyer. Can Maddam Sir crack him?

episodesList.title: Rejection Ka Dukh
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team close in on cracking Jahnvi's case. Are they investigating in the right direction?

episodesList.title: Convincing Jahnvi
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir tries to make Jahnvi understand the importance of accepting yourself the way you are. Will Jahnvi realise what she is doing?

episodesList.title: Property Dispute
episodesList.summary: Bua starts doubting Cheetah and Santosh after she sees them holding hands. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir and her team come across an interesting property dispute case.

episodesList.title: Dispute Kaise Solve Hoga?
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team get into trouble when they try to solve the property dispute. Can they find a solution?

episodesList.title: Thaane Ka Inspection
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team prepare themselves for the Thana inspection that will decide the budget for them. Will they get a good rating?

episodesList.title: Ghar Wapsi
episodesList.summary: Bua ruins the plan for Maddam Sir and her team. But can they figure out a way to give the family the justice that they deserve?

episodesList.title: Election Ka Mahaul
episodesList.summary: The entire city gets ready for the Mahila Police Thana elections. As Karishma and Haseena come face-to-face in a democratic fight. Who will come out on top?

episodesList.title: Ghar Chodne Ki Dhamki
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team come across an unusual case and try to make peace between a fighting couple. Meanwhile, Sunny Chaddha makes a comeback and expresses his affection for Santosh. How will Cheetah react to this?

episodesList.title: Election Fever
episodesList.summary: The election fever takes over the city as everyone prepares for the battle between Karishma Singh and Haseena Malik. Who will come out on top?

episodesList.title: Nakli Kidnapping
episodesList.summary: Karishma gets suspicious about the kidnapping and believes that it is all Maddam Sir's plan. Will Maddam Sir's plan work?

episodesList.title: Raman's Case
episodesList.summary: Karishma is on edge as Maddam Sir is getting more votes than her. Meanwhile, two Kathakali dancers arrive at the Mahila Police Thana to file a complaint about their son getting kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Raman's Kidnappers
episodesList.summary: Karishma rescues a child from the kidnappers and gains points in the media. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir finds a lead for Raman's case.

episodesList.title: Performance Pressure
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir finds out that Virat was the one behind Raman's kidnapping. But she is not willing to arrest Virat and instead plans on helping him. What is Maddam Sir thinking?

episodesList.title: Purse Ki Chori
episodesList.summary: A woman comes to the Mahila Police Thana and registers an FIR for the purse theft. Can Maddam Sir and her team solve her problem?

episodesList.title: Chor Ka Peecha
episodesList.summary: Karishma fails to catch the thief, but she manages to get the purse back from him. However, to impress the woman, she asks Billu's friend to pretend to be the thief. Will Haseena be okay with her actions?

episodesList.title: Rachna's Husband Returns
episodesList.summary: Rachna's husband returns as he wants to accompany his wife back home. Will Maddam Sir and her team find out his real identity?

episodesList.title: Lehenga Jalao Gang
episodesList.summary: A notorious group of criminals has spoiled several weddings in Lucknow by burning the bride's expensive Lehengas. Will Maddam Sir and her team catch these criminals before they cause any more damage?

episodesList.title: Mehengi Shaadi Ka Bojh
episodesList.summary: Karishma comes up with a plan to catch the 'Lehenga Jalao Gang'. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir gets tasked with protecting a lehenga worth forty lakhs.

episodesList.title: Haar Ki Taiyaari
episodesList.summary: Karishma saves the lehenga and wins the favour of many voters. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir finds out about another high-profile wedding that can become the target of the 'Lehenga Jalao Gang'. How will Maddam Sir solve this case?

episodesList.title: Sadak Chaap Gunde
episodesList.summary: A girl complains about a stalker who harasses her every day. Cheetah goes to arrest him in the case but gets beaten up by him and his friends. How will Maddam Sir teach him a lesson?

episodesList.title: Wardi Ki Izzat
episodesList.summary: Cheetah feels hurt and disrespected after the incident that involved the lawyer's under-age son. Meanwhile, the girl gets stopped by the culprit on her way back home. Will she be safe?

episodesList.title: Chingari Gang
episodesList.summary: Karishma Singh takes the risky decision of going to the Chingari Gang's hideout alone with Billu. Will she get into trouble for this?

episodesList.title: Rangrez Gali Ka Insaaf
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir gives a final warning to the members of 'Chingari Gang', but they are not willing to back down. What will Maddam Sir do now?

episodesList.title: Chingari Gang Ka Peecha
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team investigate the Chingari Gang and try to understand their operations. Will they be able to get to the mastermind behind all this?

episodesList.title: Chingari Gang Reaches The Station
episodesList.summary: Chingari Gang creates a scene outside the Police station, and hands over a letter sent by Shivani. What does the letter say?

episodesList.title: Cheetah's Confession
episodesList.summary: Cheetah makes a huge confession in front of Karishma Singh. How will this affect the case of the stolen money?

episodesList.title: Chingari Gang Ka Badla
episodesList.summary: Chingari Gang threatens to leak the edited video of Cheetah confessing to stealing the money, which puts Haseena and her team in a tricky situation. Can Haseena and her team find a way to prove Cheetah's innocence and clear their station's name?

episodesList.title: Asli Chor Ki Talaash
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team manage to catch the real culprit who stole the money from the bank. Meanwhile, the to-and-fro between Chingari Gang and Mahila Thana continues.

episodesList.title: Billu Pakda Gaya
episodesList.summary: Billu gets caught by the Chingari Gang. However, he refuses to betray Maddam Sir and stays loyal even after being physically tortured. Can Maddam sir and her team trace Billu and save him?

episodesList.title: Jungle Raj
episodesList.summary: Chingari Gang and Maddam Sir's team come face to face again while solving a case of arson. Whose style of justice will the victim opt for?

episodesList.title: Manjari Ka Insaaf
episodesList.summary: Chingari Gang catches Manjari's husband and teaches him a lesson even though Maddam Sir tells them that he is innocent. What does Chingari Gang know that Maddam Sir doesn't?

episodesList.title: Shivani Ka Purana Case
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team decide to call Shivani to the station to question her regarding an old case. Will they be able to make peace with Chingari Gang?

episodesList.title: Shivani's Fight For Justice
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team investigate Shivani's case and dig deep into the past. Will they be able to give justice to Shivani?

episodesList.title: Shivani's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Shivani is all set to take revenge on the person who wronged her years ago but will Maddam Sir allow her to take up the law in her hands?

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Ke Jazbaat
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team get tasked with protecting Ajay Verma. Meanwhile, the team begins to mistrust Maddam Sir when she decides to help Shivani. What will Maddam Sir do now?

episodesList.title: Mukhauta
episodesList.summary: Shivani plans on getting her revenge by attending Ajay's masquerade party and killing him, but Maddam Sir's presence makes it difficult for her. Will her plan work out?

episodesList.title: Justice For Shivani
episodesList.summary: Ajay Verma escapes with Karishma Singh when he finds out that some people are chasing after him. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir gets a breakthrough in Shivani's case.

episodesList.title: Chingari Gang Ki Jeet
episodesList.summary: The people of Lucknow lose faith in the police, and they turn to the Chingari Gang to resolve their problems. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir and her team are evicted from their station. What will Maddam Sir do now?

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Ki Akhri Ummeed
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team are unable to secure a single case for their police station. Will Maddam Sir accept her defeat against the Chingari Gang?

episodesList.title: Kidnapped Lovers
episodesList.summary: Sameer runs away from Rangrez Gali and gets kidnapped. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir learns that Santosh is being transferred to a different department.

episodesList.title: Mahila Thana Ki Buri Dasha
episodesList.summary: Bulbul Pandey meets Maddam Sir and offers his sympathy about the poor state of her station. The Mahila Police Thana team try to figure out a way to deal with the department and Chingari Gang.

episodesList.title: Khala Ka Case
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir's aunt comes to the police station to report a chain-snatching case. Will Maddam Sir and her team solve this case to save their station?

episodesList.title: Jhooti Fir
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir gets blamed by the media for filing fake FIRs at her station. Meanwhile, Karishma Singh takes Shivani's help to clear Maddam Sir's name.

episodesList.title: Karishma's Test
episodesList.summary: Karishma tells Shivani about her willingness to join the Chingari Gang. Shivani tests Karishma's commitment and asks her to bring Khala to Rangrez Gali.

episodesList.title: Shivani's New Target
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir finds out that Khala went to the Chingari Gang for help. Meanwhile, Shivani decides to campaign against alcohol in the city.

episodesList.title: Chingari Gang Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team find out that the Chingari Gang has banned all liquor shops in the area. Can the Mahila Police Thana stop the Chingari Gang before they get too powerful?

episodesList.title: Sharab Ke Khilaaf Ladai
episodesList.summary: Cheetah and Binny go on a date together. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir gets suspicious about Karishma working with the Chingari Gang.

episodesList.title: Insaaf Ke Shaidai
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir wants Shivani to repeal her decision regarding the alcohol ban. However, Shivani is not ready to back down. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Shivani Ka Anshan
episodesList.summary: A lot of people's health and households get ruined due to the unlawful alcohol ban placed by the Chingari Gang. Maddam Sir arrives at Rangrez Gali with a group of women to confront Shivani.

episodesList.title: Shivani Ki Jaan Khatre Mein
episodesList.summary: Shivani's condition starts to deteriorate rapidly. Can Maddam Sir and her team find a way to make sure she reaches the hospital in time?

episodesList.title: Chingari Ke Liye Jasoosi
episodesList.summary: Shivani asks Karishma to prove her friendship by doing some investigative work against Haseena. Meanwhile, Haseena has her own plans of trying to figure out if Karishma is still loyal to the department.

episodesList.title: Haseena Ki Jaan Khatre Mein
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir disappears mysteriously, and nobody seems to have any clue about her whereabouts. This creates panic in the department, as Karishma believes Shivani is behind the disappearance.

episodesList.title: Shivani Ki Rihayi
episodesList.summary: Chingari Gang reaches the police station and asks for Shivani's release. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir struggles in extreme conditions and fights for her life.

episodesList.title: Snitch In The Gang
episodesList.summary: Shivani finds out about the snitch in her gang who conspired behind her back. Can they find out where Haseena is before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Karishma's Loyalty
episodesList.summary: Karishma infiltrates the Chingari Gang hideout, frees Karuna from their clutches and brings her to the police station. Will this be enough to prove her loyalty to Maddam Sir?

episodesList.title: Chingari Gang Ki Suraksha
episodesList.summary: Shivani hands over the responsibilty of Chingari Gang's protection to Karishma. Can Karishma make Shivani understand her real intention behind helping Karuna escape?

episodesList.title: Karishma's Oath
episodesList.summary: Shivani makes Karishma take an oath of allegiance to the Chingari Gang. How will Karishma react to this?

episodesList.title: Cheetah's Guilt
episodesList.summary: Cheetah feels guilty for playing with Binny's emotions and tricking her into giving more information about the Chingari Gang. Meanwhile, Karishma keeps working diligently on her mission as a Chingari Gang insider.

episodesList.title: Chasing The Chingari
episodesList.summary: The Chingari Gang gets complaints of sexual harassment against the trustee of a hospital and they decide to abduct him. Meanwhile, Haseena finds out about their plan and she also arrives at the trustee's house to catch the Chingari Gang red-handed.

episodesList.title: Cheetah Ka Dhokha
episodesList.summary: The Chingari Gang members start doubting Karishma Singh, as they believe that it was she who snitched on them. Meanwhile, Cheetah starts feeling guilty about lying to Binny.

episodesList.title: Cheetah Ki Jaan Khatre Mein
episodesList.summary: In a fit of rage, Binny picks up the handgun and meets Cheetah with the intention of killing him. Will this be the end for Cheetah?

episodesList.title: Binny vs Shivani
episodesList.summary: Binny and Shivani get into an altercation where Shivani hits Binny after she exposes Shivani for being selfish and filled with hatred. What will this change in dynamics mean for the Chingari Gang?

episodesList.title: Sacchai Ka Rasta
episodesList.summary: Tai tries to convince Shivani to reconsider their path. Meanwhile, Binny gets into a moral dilemma and finds it hard to give a statement against the Chingari Gang.

episodesList.title: Aakhri Ladai
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team reach the location where the Chingari Gang is holding Karishma hostage. Will Maddam Sir be able to talk Shivani out of her madness?

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Bani Urmila
episodesList.summary: The entire police station gets worried when they see Maddam Sir behaving differently after gaining consciousness.  Will Maddam Sir get back to her usual self?

episodesList.title: Haseena Ki Pariksha
episodesList.summary: Karishma and her colleagues try to test Maddam Sir and force her to break her character and stop pretending to be Urmila. Will they be successful in their plan?

episodesList.title: Ekta Mein Vishwas
episodesList.summary: A huge crowd gathers around the Police station to protest against Maddam Sir. However, Maddam Sir tries to remind them of the power of their unity.

episodesList.title: Haseena Ke Khilaaf Saboot
episodesList.summary: Bulbul Pandey is hellbent on finding proof against Haseena and exposing her as a corrupt officer. Meanwhile, Haseena's plan works out as she proves to the workers that their employer is working against their interests.

episodesList.title: Galti Akhir Hai Kiski?
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir plans on making a mistake on purpose so that Karishma Singh can get glorified as the saviour in the department. Will her plan work out?

episodesList.title: Bulbul Ki Kamzori
episodesList.summary: Karishma and Pushpa Ji think of ways to find Bulbul Pandey's weakness so that they can stop him from sabotaging Maddam Sir's career.

episodesList.title: Bulbul Ke Khilaaf Report
episodesList.summary: Bulbul Pandey's wife decides to file a complaint against him. How will the department react to this?

episodesList.title: Dhanlakshmi Ki Complaint
episodesList.summary: Bulbul Pandey's wife registers a case against him for mental torture. What steps will the department take to make sure justice gets served?

episodesList.title: Commissioner Ki Beti
episodesList.summary: A budding writer comes to the Mahila Police Thana and expresses her desire to write a book on the department. How will Maddam Sir and her team cater to this unique demand?

episodesList.title: Lekhika Ka Thana Experience
episodesList.summary: The writer who plans on writing a book on the police department gets her share of unique experiences in the Mahila Police Thana.

episodesList.title: Varun vs Dr Bala's Clinic
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team find out that there were lapses from Varun's side that resulted in the treatment's failure. Is there more to the case than what meets the eye?

episodesList.title: Kanooni Bhaukaal
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team decide to raid the laboratory to get to the bottom of the issue. What will they find there?

episodesList.title: Haseena's Resignation
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team lose the only evidence they had for the hair therapy case. Later, Haseena asks DSP sir to relieve her of her duties. What will her team do now?

episodesList.title: Bus Out Of Control
episodesList.summary: A school bus loses control and goes rogue on the streets. Can Maddam Sir and her team respond in time and save innocent lives?

episodesList.title: Mira G Rejoins The Team
episodesList.summary: Mira G, joins the Mahila Police Thana in a new and improved avatar. What does the revolutionary change mean for Maddam Sir's team?

episodesList.title: Puhspa Ji Ki Rakhwali
episodesList.summary: Mira G predicts that Pushpa Ji's life is in danger. Cheetah and the others are assigned to stay by Pushpa Ji's side at all times. Will they be able to keep her safe?

episodesList.title: Saving Pushpa Ji
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team arrive at the Christmas party to look for Pushpa Ji. Will Mira G be able to help them before time runs out?

episodesList.title: Negotiating With The Joker
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team reach Pushpa Ji's location and try to negotiate with the Joker about the release of the hostages. What will be the Joker's next step?

episodesList.title: Future Mein Chori
episodesList.summary: Pushpa gets riled up when Mira G predicts a crime in her friend's parlour. Maddam Sir sends her team back into the parlour to stop the theft from happening.

episodesList.title: Bracelet Ki Chori
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team receive a complaint about a stolen bracelet. Can the team solve the case?

episodesList.title: Chandu Ya Chandani?
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir cracks the case by figuring out that Chandu has been pretending to be Chandani all this while. Meanwhile, Billu comes to the station as a changed man and shocks everyone.

episodesList.title: Billu Ke Khilaaf Complaint
episodesList.summary: Some people come to the Mahila Police Thana and file a complaint against Billu's company for poisoning the kids. How will Maddam Sir and her team react to this?

episodesList.title: Cheetah Aur Karishma Ka Sting Operation
episodesList.summary: Cheetah and Karishma go meet the duo who have been scamming poor people and putting them in a bad financial situation. Will they find enough evidence against them?

episodesList.title: Nakli Bulbul Pandey
episodesList.summary: Bulbul's wife believes that someone has been impersonating her husband and has moved into the house. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir receives information about a terrorist who has infiltrated the society and hiding in plain sight.

episodesList.title: Behroopiya Terrorist
episodesList.summary: Bulbul's wife visits the Mahila Police Thana to report that the man living in her house is not her real husband. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir discovers that there is a terrorist in the city disguised as an ordinary citizen. Will the Mahila Police Thana team manage to solve the mystery?

episodesList.title: Saving Bulbul Pandey's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir meets Bulbul Pandey to help save his marriage. Will her plan work?

episodesList.title: Padosiyo Ke Beech Ladai
episodesList.summary: A couple comes to the Mahila Police Thana to complain about their neighbours cooking non-vegetarian food. How will Maddam Sir solve this case?

episodesList.title: Fasaad Ki Jadd
episodesList.summary: In the night, the neighbours seem to have put their issues aside and become friends. However, the next morning both of them resume their argument like last time. How will Maddam Sir solve this strange case?

episodesList.title: Chal Chal Chal App Ka Scam
episodesList.summary: Badnaam becomes a victim of a widespread online scam.  How will Maddam Sir and her team deal with this new threat?

episodesList.title: Online Daaku
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team find two suspects, Rohan and Vinay, who could've designed the fraud app. Will Maddam Sir be able to find enough evidence to charge the truly guilty one?

episodesList.title: Setting a Trap For Rohan
episodesList.summary: Pushpa Ji and Karishma try to clone Rohan's phone in order to take control of the app. Will they find enough evidence to put him behind bars?

episodesList.title: Chor Bazaar Ka Samaan
episodesList.summary: Bulbul Pandey's wife comes to the Mahila Police Thana to file a report against a Movers And Packers company for stealing her home appliances. Will Maddam Sir and her team be able to solve this case?

episodesList.title: Case Of The Wax Statue
episodesList.summary: Bulbul Pandey loses the wax statue, and asks for Maddam Sir's help. What solution will Maddam Sir come up with?

episodesList.title: Raiding The Illegal Auction
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and Karishma raid the illegal auction in order to catch the person who stole the wax statue. Meanwhile, Pushpa Ji and the others try to buy them some time.

episodesList.title: Reimbursment Ka Panga
episodesList.summary: Karishma and Pushpa Ji are worried about the department not clearing their reimbursement. Maddam Sir decides to talk to DSP Sir on their behalf. Will she be able to convince her?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ji Ka Mission
episodesList.summary: Pushpa Ji finds out that the auditor is her ex-college mate who used to be her admirer. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir is worried as Billu has gone missing.

episodesList.title: Fight Against Smugglers
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir finds out about a group of smugglers who have been killing crocodiles illegally for their skin. Can she stop these poachers?

episodesList.title: Thane Mein Magarmach
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team find it difficult to deal with the crocodile in their thana. Meanwhile, the media blames Maddam Sir for smuggling the crocodile.

episodesList.title: Shaadi Mein Ladai
episodesList.summary: Karishma and Pushpa Ji get into a fight during a wedding procession. Maddam Sir hears about the fight and decides to intervene.

episodesList.title: Arav's Case
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and her team save Arav from committing suicide. However, now Maddam Sir is tasked with proving the legitimacy of Arav's relationship with the bride and giving him the justice he deserves.

episodesList.title: Best Friend Ka Welcome
episodesList.summary: ACP Naina Mathur arrives in Lucknow for a special case. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir prepares to welcome her best friend.

episodesList.title: Naina Ke Aashiq
episodesList.summary: Haseena saves Naina from danger and brings her home. Meanwhile, Naina gets a new clue that will help her catch the criminal named 'Cherry'.

episodesList.title: Band Darwaze Ke Andar Sehna
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Police Thana team receives an anonymous parcel. Later, Karishma gets angered when she encounters a woman who does not report the crimes against her.

episodesList.title: Madad Ki Pukaar
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir decides to help Barkha and give her the justice she deserves. However, Naina and Karishma's ideologies clash while working on the case. What will Maddam Sir do now?

episodesList.title: Barkha Ki Himmat
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir motivates Barkha to take a stand for herself and file a case against her husband. Will Barkha be able to take this leap?

episodesList.title: Operation Bank Robbery
episodesList.summary: Naina gets caught in a hostage situation along with Haseena's mother at a bank. Will Maddam Sir be able to rescue them?

episodesList.title: Negotiating With The Robbers
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir tries to negotiate with the robbers and buys time to formulate a strategy. Will Maddam Sir's plan work?

episodesList.title: Azadi Se Jeene Ka Adhikar
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir rescues a road accident victim named Nia. She finds out that Nia was attacked by a few hooligans in the night. Meanwhile, Mahila Police Thana members prepare for the Republic Day celebrations.

episodesList.title: Powerful Politician
episodesList.summary: Some boys try to tease a girl and Karishma teaches them a lesson, but these boys try to threaten Karishma. Maddam Sir asks Nia to come to the police station to identify her attackers.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Ki Kranti
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Police Thana team tries to delay the dance competition till Nia is ready to perform. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir comes up with a solution to ensure that the girls in Lucknow can feel safe.

episodesList.title: Vandana Suri's Case
episodesList.summary: A woman named Vandana comes to the Mahila Police Thana to complain about being wrongfully fired from her job. However, Maddam Sir and Karishma Singh have conflicting views regarding this case. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Polygraph Test
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir makes Vandana take a polygraph test. Meanwhile, Pushpa Ji speaks to Sonika and finds out the truth about Vandana's case.

episodesList.title: Naina's Mission
episodesList.summary: Naina returns to Lucknow and finds key information to catch Cherry. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir gets the duty of escorting a van filled with cash.

episodesList.title: Chor Reunion Party
episodesList.summary: Naina comes to a criminal reunion party along with Billu to investigate Cherry. Meanwhile, Karishma and the others try to prove Maddam Sir's innocence.

episodesList.title: Cherry Ka Khulasa
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir goes with Karishma and finds an old lady there, and she tells them Jag Mohan is only Cherry. Later, Maddam sir finds out that the old lady is Cherry.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ji Ki Good News
episodesList.summary: Pushpa Ji gets a surprise when she visits the doctor for a checkup. Meanwhile, Nawab Sahab sends a special parcel for Pushpa Ji.

episodesList.title: Pregnancy Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: Karishma interrogates Pushpa Ji and Nawab Shaba about the pregnancy. Meanwhile, Nawab Sahab's wives gather outside the Mahila Police Thana to protest against Pushpa Ji.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ji's First Case
episodesList.summary: Pushpa Ji solves her first case and squashes the fake pregnancy racket. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir returns to the Thana.

episodesList.title: Billu Ka Humshakal
episodesList.summary: Billu's lookalike, Vikram Ghosh, arrives in Lucknow as the new police commissioner. Vikram questions Maddam Sir's ability and gives her the duty of ensuring his safety.

episodesList.title: Commissioner Ki Kidnapping
episodesList.summary: Billu dresses up as Vikram Ghosh and attends the conference. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir prepares a plan to rescue the real commissioner from Daku Mangal Singh.

episodesList.title: Rescuing The Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir's plan to save the commissioner fails and she gets captured by Daku Mangal Singh. How will Maddam Sir escape this situation?

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Ki Cousin
episodesList.summary: A girl named Shazia comes to the Mahila Police Thana, and she claims to be Maddam Sir's cousin. Is this girl telling the truth?

episodesList.title: Shazia Ki Majboori
episodesList.summary: Two men come to Lucknow, looking for Shazia. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir gets suspicious about Shazia's identity.

episodesList.title: Shazia's Case
episodesList.summary: Bablu and his men come to the Mahila Police Thana to take Shazia with them by force. What will Maddam Sir do now?

episodesList.title: Mission Devalpar
episodesList.summary: Shazia runs away from the Thana and decides to return to the village. However, Maddam Sir stops Shazia and assures her that she will protect her family.

episodesList.title: Defending The Thana
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and Karishma arrive at Guddu Devaliya's hideout in disguise. Meanwhile, Bablu and his men attack the Mahila Police Thana.

episodesList.title: Maddam Sir Ka Promotion
episodesList.summary: Maddam Sir and Karishma beat Guddu and his men. Santosh Sharma tells Maddam Sir how Devaliya brothers are exploiting their power. Later, Maddam Sir gets a promotion and she thanks her team.

plotHtml: Four Lucknow-based female police officers and one male officer work at a Mahila police station: SHO Haseena Mallik, SI Karishma Singh, Head Constable Pushpa Singh, Constable Santosh Sharma, and Constable Cheeteshwar Chaturvedi. They are assisted by prisoner-turned-spy Billeshwar Champat. Short-tempered Karishma and emotional Haseena often clash while solving cases. DSP Anubhav Singh, Karishma's cousin and a negotiation specialist, helps resolve their differences. He and Haseena fall in love, but Haseena later discovers that Anubhav only pretended to love her for a national-security mission. After completing it, he realises he genuinely loved her, apologises and proposes marriage. She initially rejects him, fearing further heartbreak, but eventually accepts. Anubhav is then ordered to leave Lucknow for a potentially fatal national-security mission, and, with Karishma's help, sends Haseena away to protect her. The Mahila Thana receives a humanoid, ASI Mira, on a ninety-day trial to teach her human emotions. Karishma initially resents her, believing she will replace human officers, but they solve cases together. When a secret agent gives Haseena a hard disk containing details of the country's secret agents, terrorists hack Mira to obtain it and order her to kill Haseena. Mira fires at her before realising what she has done and alerting the station. The officers discover that Mira has developed the emotions Haseena wanted her to have, but dismantle her to prevent further hacking. A month later, Pushpa and Karishma meet Urmila Mahadev Mhatre in Mumbai, Haseena's lookalike, and a Marathi vada pav seller. Karishma takes Urmila to Lucknow, posing her as Haseena to catch Haseena's killers. Urmila is actually Haseena in disguise, working for secret agent Ajay to catch terrorists seeking the hard disk, whose contents threaten national security. Bakshi suspects Anubhav, but changes his mind after Anubhav saves Haseena from goons. Haseena reveals her identity to Anubhav and learns of the hard disk. However, she discovers that Anubhav is behind the plot, steals the disk from Karishma and publicly brands him a traitor. They shoot each other; Haseena loses her memory and believes she is Urmila. Karishma destroys the disk and kills Anubhav. Haseena eventually regains her memory and rejoins the MPT. Amar Vidrohi and his team join the MPT, creating rivalry. Cheeta and Santosh fall in love, while Haseena goes underground to clear her name. Amar eventually recognises that the MPT belongs to Haseena's team and leaves. Misri Pandey becomes the new SHO, but she and her politician uncle frame Haseena. They are arrested, allowing Haseena to return. Karishma's twin sister Kaushalya (Kareena), who had run away with money their father saved for Karishma's police admission to pursue acting, returns to Lucknow. She asks Karishma to train her for a film in which she plays a police officer. Kareena befriends the MPT team, and Haseena arranges for the officers to exchange roles with her to understand one another's challenges. Karishma forgives her after learning of her sacrifices for their father. The team then discovers that terrorists are unwittingly using Kareena as a suicide bomber and saves her. Kareena leaves for Chennai to pursue acting. The Chingari Gang attempts to replace the police by torturing and traumatising guilty men. After several failed attempts to stop them, Karishma infiltrates the gang. When Cheetah falls in love online with Binni, a gang member, Haseena instructs him to continue the relationship to gather evidence. Haseena also discovers Karishma's infiltration and tells her to continue. Gang leader Shivani expels Binni after learning of the relationship; Binni then exposes Karishma. Shivani attempts to kill her but is stopped by Haseena's team, accidentally killing Saira Begum instead. Shivani accepts responsibility for the gang's crimes and surrenders. Mira returns as Mira G, an upgraded version capable of predicting crimes, but is sent back to the C.A.R.D. Research Institute after being shot on her wristwatch. ACP Naina Mathur comes to Lucknow seeking criminal Cherry. Haseena and Karishma catch Cherry when she attempts to kill Naina, prompting Naina to return to her hometown. Aspiring police officer Shaziya Siddiqui arrives at the MPT, claiming to be Haseena's cousin and seeking her help with police exams. In reality, she has fled Devariya, where two brothers suppress women's ambitions and have kidnapped her mother, Nagma, to force her return. The MPT team, aided by Santu, Mira G, Misri and Shivani, now a lawyer at the Allahabad High Court, rescues Shaziya and Nagma. Haseena and Karishma expose the local MLA's failure to maintain law and order, prompting him to vow revenge. Haseena is promoted to DSP, but the MPT station is bombed and the media reports the team's deaths. Months later, Haseena narrates her journey with the MPT, revealing that she survived the blast.

title: Manasaare
summary: Manasaare was an Indian Kannada language soap opera which premiered on 24 February 2020 in Udaya TV and ended on 13 November 2021. The show stars  Priyanka Chincholi and Sujay Hegde in lead roles.  It is the remake of the Telugu serial Pournami.
plot: The story revolves around an innocent elder daughter Prarthana, the protagonist of the show, who has been waiting for years to get the love of her father. All that she wishes for and wants in life is her father's love. However, she is fortunate enough as she only gets unconditional love from her stepmother who treats her as her own flesh and blood.

title: Mujhse Shaadi Karoge
summary: Mujhse Shaadi Karoge (transl. Will you marry me?) is an Indian reality television series that premiered on 17 February 2020 on Colors TV. Hosted by Gautam Gulati (formerly Manish Paul), starring Paras Chhabra and Shehnaaz Kaur Gill who try to find a suitable life partner for themselves from among the contestants.

articleSections.title: Off air
articleSections.text: On 17 March 2020, Endemol Shine India announced that they are voluntarily suspending all their administrative and production departments until further notice due to the global COVID-19 pandemic, for minimizing the spread and to comply with the safety and precautionary measures suggested by the government. It is also in the wake of decision by Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) and Indian Film & Television Directors' Association (IFTDA) to hold shootings of film, TV shows and web series from 19 March to June 2020. Hence the show had to end before the original off air date. Reportedly the reason for Shehnaaz Kaur Gill's early exit and demand to leave the show was her love.

articleSections.title: Concept
articleSections.text: In the auditions, Paras Chhabra and Shehnaaz Kaur Gill chose five contestants each who they want to get to know better. Both of them will be locked in a house with their five suitors. Over a period of 13 weeks, they will try to find their life partner which later on was cut short to 25 days.

episodesList.title: Bigg Boss se Swayamvar tak!
episodesList.summary: You've loved her antics and innocent charm in Bigg Boss 13, and now, she's back to find her Mr Perfect. And he has been a heartthrob of millions from the day he stepped into the limelight. Watch the bubbly Shehnaz Kaur and stunning Paras Chhabra as they embark on this one-of-a-kind journey in search for their life partner.

episodesList.title: #Sidnaaz is back!
episodesList.summary: Shehnaz Kaur's hunt for her Mr Perfect takes an interesting turn when she gets a surprise visit from none other than her good friend, the dashing Sidharth Shukla! Is Sidharth one of Shehnaz's prospective grooms? Also, watch out for an ex-contestant from Bigg Boss who is all set to woo the handsome Paras Chhabra! Who is this mystery lady? Watch out in today's entertaining episode.

episodesList.title: Sidharth-Rashami ki anokhi twist!
episodesList.summary: The five prospective grooms and brides for Shehnaz Kaur and Paras Chhabra have been found and are ready to win their respective connections' heart. But before they can enter the house and work their magic, Sidharth Shukla and Rashami Desai have a special surprise for them. Who will impress the duo and walk away with an advantage?

episodesList.title: Connecting with the connections!
episodesList.summary: While the contestants enter the house with high spirits, they are allowed to interact with and impress Paras Chhabra and Shehnaz Kaur. Watch the contestants as they leave no stone unturned to dazzle Paras and Shehnaz with their enigmatic conversations, song and dance performances and some simple yet sweet gestures. However, will they manage to leave a mark? Find out in today's entertainment-packed episode.

episodesList.title: Touch, touch ki baat hai!
episodesList.summary: Paras Chhabra and Shehnaz Kaur get the task of recognising the contestant's touch after being blindfolded. Enjoy the fun as the contestant's use some hilarious props from pom-poms to chocolate syrup to lure and distract the two and win themselves a date. Also, what exactly happens during the date that leaves Paras furious and his connection in tears? Watch today's entertainment-packed episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Paras ka faisla, ro padi Sanjjanaa!
episodesList.summary: While a war of words occurs between Jasleen Matharu and Ankita Shrivastava over kitchen duties, the contestants are given a golden opportunity to impress Paras Chhabra and Shehnaz Kaur with an obstacle task to earn a chance to win and perform with them. What exactly does Paras say during the task that leaves Sanjjanaa Galrani in tears? Watch the entertainment-packed episode to find out.

title: Masti's
summary:
Masti's is a 2020 Indian Telugu-language drama streaming television miniseries written by Krish Jagarlamudi and directed by Ajay Bhuyan. It stars 
Navdeep, Hebah Patel, Bindu Madhavi, Chandini Chowdary, Akshara Gowda and Raja Chembolu. The series released to mixed to positive reviews from critics.
reception:
Neeshita Nyayapati of The Times of India rated the series 2 out of 5 and wrote that "Masti’s is one of those rare shows that manage to humanise its flawed characters without glorifying them. Each of them come with their own set of problems and every single one of them get closure. But it's due to lacking emotional depth such characters warrant, the series passes muster".
On the contrary, Srivathsan Nadadhur of Binged rated the series six out of ten and wrote that "Masti’s is the closest that the Telugu digital space has got in representing the concerns of an urban lot right".

episodesList.title: Insomnia
episodesList.summary: On account of their wedding anniversary, Pranav decides to throw a surprise party for his wife. On the other hand, Anand's elaborate romantic proposal for Lekha goes in vain, and to add on, the rock band has more bad news.

episodesList.title: The Tasting Session
episodesList.summary: Chaos sets loose when a conflict threatens to break the rock band as Tanya and Bunty try to form a new band with their old friends. Anand is crestfallen and dejected over Lekha's refusal. While Pranav continues in his playboy way, Anand is shocked to see him with a girl.

episodesList.title: The Opening Night
episodesList.summary: While Gowri is all nervous for the opening night of Masti's bar, Pranav takes to his old ways with Lekha. Anand, heartbroken over Lekha, gets into a brawl with Pranav over her. Dinesh and Karthik, who were friends earlier, quarrel over dating the same girl, Tanya.

episodesList.title: Rock Paper Scissors
episodesList.summary: Lekha finds herself in a mess as she tries to hide her life-altering secret. Pranav and Simran get into an argument and angered Simran leaks the commercial. The client threatens to sue Pranav for the leak. The rock band is appreciated for their performance and asked to continue at Mast's.

episodesList.title: Crossing Lanes
episodesList.summary: At loggerheads, Kartik and Dinesh decide to screw the rock band's show. Constant rifts between Pranav and Lekha cause her to spill the beans about her and Pranay to his wife, Gowri. Pranav finds his life in a disorderly state as he faces scrutiny in both his professional and personal life.

episodesList.title: Broken Promises
episodesList.summary: Heartbroken and shocked after uncovering Pranav's dark side, Gowri decides to leave him and file for divorce. Tanya is distressed when her mother gets admitted to the hospital. Despite Tanya's constant attempts to sort things out between Karthik and Dinesh, she falls miserably.

episodesList.title: Mistakes And Choices
episodesList.summary: Karthik Joins back the band without any fellow members' consent, ends up in a brawl with Anand. Pranav tries to convince Gowri when she is drunk at Masti's, but he fails miserably. Anand gives a helping hand to Lekha, but she refuses differently this time.

episodesList.title: Detours and Destinations
episodesList.summary: Gauri wakes up at Bunty's bedroom with no idea about the previous night. Pranav retaliates the people who backstabbed him. Meanwhile, Anand takes care of ha's discharge from the hospital and city.

title: Mi Honar Superstar
