articleSections.text: The producers of the show launched a sequel titled Excuse Me Maadam, which revolves around a similar concept and storyline, however changes were made in the cast as it features Rajesh Kumar as Sanam Harjayi, Nyra Banerjee as Sanam's boss and Sucheta Khanna as Sanam's caring wife. Sapna Sikarwar and Anup Upadhyay are also part of the series. Anup Upadhyay portrays Adhu, who is Sanam's best friend and husband of his sister-in-law Amar, played by Sapna Sikarwar.

episodesList.title: Sajan, Na Ghar Ke Na Ghat Ke
episodesList.summary: Sajan Agarwal, works as a manager for an advertising company and is fascinated by his glamorous boss, Sanjana. Sajan's wife, Kashmira is suspicious of his friendship with Sanjana. Will Sajan be able to balance between the wife and the boss?

episodesList.title: Sajan Pe Laga Lipstick Ka Nishan
episodesList.summary: Sajan and Sanjana have a moment in the lift. Later, Sanjana calls Sajan into her cabin for a discussion on a new lipstick brand. She leaves a lipstick mark on his shirt, which could land Sajan in a lot of trouble at home.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Shirt Ban Gayi Musibat
episodesList.summary: Sajan gives a sizzling presentation of 'Mandakini' lipstick, wearing a wet shirt. The shirt, later lands him in a lot of problems. It also invites the wrath of his 'nocturnal' Dadi!

episodesList.title: Sanjana-sajan Lock Lips
episodesList.summary: Sajan is worried because his boss, Sanjana wants him to get the lipstick-stained shirt to office and he can't find it. He pretends to have a 'gas' problem. Sanjana decides to give him a mouth to mouth treatment. Will Sajan recover now?

episodesList.title: Sanjana's Saadi Pad Gayi Bhaari
episodesList.summary: Kashmira's mother tries to make her realise that Sajan is not loyal to her and doesn't remember important dates. Sanjana asks Sajan to get her sari from the laundry. The sari create a lot of confusion. In short, Sanjana ki saadi pad gayi Sajan pe bhaari!

episodesList.title: Sanju's 'goonda'wala Fantasy
episodesList.summary: Sanjana calls up Sajan to tell him that she is going to visit his house to pick her sari. Sajan is in a soup because Kashmira has worn the sari! Sajan tries various tricks including behaving like a 'filmi' goonda to make Kashmira take it off but with hilarious consequences!

episodesList.title: Madam De Gayi Gift
episodesList.summary: Sajan asks his friend Khiloni to bail him out. Sanjana, however, slaps Khiloni hard! Later, she reaches Sanju's house and decides to gift the sari to Kashmira. Sajan heaves a sigh of relief but Madam has a change of mind!

episodesList.title: Sajan's 'wet' Dream
episodesList.summary: Sajan's happiness turns fourfold when a drenched Sanjana comes knocking at his door! One look at her wet hair and his imagination starts running wild. While Kashmira is on her way back home, Sajan and Sanjana are disturbed by a knock at the door.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Baj Gayi Band
episodesList.summary: Sanjana plays with her words to seduce Sajan which sends his imagination racing. As the rain comes to a stop, Sanjana decides to leave. Just then, Sajan's mother-in-law comes knocking at the door and sees Sanjana!  Will she tell her daughter about Sanjana? Kya Sajan Ka Bajega Band?

episodesList.title: Sajan's Pants Are Off
episodesList.summary: Sajan brings a snake to the office with the intention of impressing Sanjana by saving her. Bhupesh spills hot tea on him and Sajan rushes to clean it. When he puts his pants out to dry, someone takes them away!

episodesList.title: Sajan, Caught With Pants Down?
episodesList.summary: Sajan tries his best to keep himself from being seen in his underwear. Just then Sanjana calls Sajan for an urgent meeting. During Sajan's presentation, the snake crawls up his leg. Later, Kashmira arrives at Sajan's office.

episodesList.title: Holi Ke Rang, Sanjana Ke Sang
episodesList.summary: Sanjana is surprised to see Sajan without his pants. Sajan tells Kashmira that he does not like celebrating Holi. Later, Sanjana tells him that she loves playing Holi. Chedilal applies colour on Sajan and he fantasises about playing Holi with Sanjana.

episodesList.title: Bhaang, Ladoo Aur Sanjana!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan to get bhaang for her. Sajan tells his friend that Kashmira doesn't want him to play Holi. Sanjana calls Sajan and urges him to play Holi with her. Sajan reaches office with bhaang ladoos and a water gun.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ko Yaad Rahegi Yeh Holi
episodesList.summary: Sajan eats a bhaang laddoo at Sanjana's insistence. She, too, eats a few laddoos. Watch if a high-on-bhaang Sanjana fulfills Sajan's 'Holi' fantasies.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Decides To Visit Sajan
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan to have dinner with her to discuss a project. Sajan recalls his promise to Kashmira about taking her mother for dinner and lies to Sanjana that his mother-in-law is sick. Sanjana decides to visit Sajan's home to see his ailing mother-in-law. Will Sajan be caught this time?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Saas Ne Li Uski Saans
episodesList.summary: Sajan's friend pretends to be his mother-in-law in front of Sanjana and her father but his family returns home earlier than expected. Later, Sanjana arranges a prayer meeting for Sajan's ailing mother-in-law!

episodesList.title: Sajan-sanjana Chale Date Pe!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana sends a doctor to Sajan's house to cure his mother-in-law! On Sanjana's order, Sajan dresses up smartly for office. Sanjana tells Sajan that she wants to go on a date with him.

episodesList.title: Phas Gaya Re Sajan!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan to pretend to be her boyfriend to get rid of her ex-boyfriend, Chandan. Bhupesh finds Sanjana in Sajan's arms. Chandan threatens Sajan on finding out that he is married! Later, at home, Sajan has a tough time explaning to Kashmira.

episodesList.title: Sajan Wants To Be Sanjana's Love
episodesList.summary: Sajan tells Sanjana that Chandan is at his house. He calls Sajan and threatens to reveal his secret. Sajan appears with his face covered before Chandan. Kashmira is furious when Sajan blurts out that he wants to be Sanjana's love forever.

episodesList.title: Hot Model Aur Phas Gaya Sajan
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan to shoot a romantic ad with a hot model. The same pictures are soon shared on the social network. Later, Kashmira asks Sajan for the password to his social network account. Sajan shares his worry with Sanjana and his mother-in-law overhears the same!

episodesList.title: Sanjana Ne Padha Sajan Ka Haath
episodesList.summary: Sajan stops Kashmira from checking his social network account. Sanjana informs Sajan that the client will be using his photograph for their commercial. Meanwhile, Sajan imagines lifting Sanjana to help her fetch a book. Later, Sanjana reads Sajan's palm.

episodesList.title: Ab Toh Sajan Doob Gaya
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan about his acts of bravery. Sajan lies about swimming across many rivers in a single breath. Sanjana wants Sajan to teach her swimming. Later, Sajan asks Khiloni to help him learn swimming. Khiloni lies to Kashmira that Sajan drowned while rescuing a woman!

episodesList.title: Madam Ne Pehna Swimsuit?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana tells Sajan about her dream of swimming in the sea. Sajan's imagination starts running wild again! He also imagines seeing Sanjana in a swimming costume. Will Sajan's dreams bear any fruit?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Haath Safaai!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan to take the measurements of a model. The model turns out to be a mannequin. While taking the measurements, Sajan accidentally breaks her hand! Ab kya karega Sajan?

episodesList.title: Sajan Is Attacked!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana recalls her friend's story about a killer when she sees a hand poking out of a sack under Sajan's desk. Meanwhile, the same killer enters Sajan's cabin. Mistakenly, Sanjana hands over a knife to the actual killer who then attacks Sajan.

episodesList.title: Sajan's Topless Portrait!
episodesList.summary: Sajan receives a text message from Sanjana saying that she wishes to paint a topless portrait of him. He workouts for a perfectly toned body. Later, Sanjana realises that she had by mistake sent the message to Sajan when he removes his shirt and poses for a portrait in front of her.

episodesList.title: Sajan Strips For Madam
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan to completely strip down for the portrait. Meanwhile, even as a naked Sajan waits for Sanjana, Kashmira catches him in the same state! Later, a Bengali baba predicts that Sajan might leave Kashmira for another woman.

episodesList.title: Madam Ke Baalon Mein Uljha Sajan
episodesList.summary: A baba advises Sajan to attach a few strands of Sanjana's hair to a magical doll to have complete control over Sanjana. Sajan tries his best to complete his task, while Bhupesh tries to make Sajan drink the enchanted water.

episodesList.title: Will Sajan Get Lucky?
episodesList.summary: Bhupesh squeezes the 'mystical' lemon on Sajan's head. Sajan manages to cut off a few strands of Sanjana's hair when she requests him for a head massage. The moment Sajan attaches the hair to the enchanted doll, Sanjana asks him to stay and continue to work in the same office.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ke Paas Bandook!
episodesList.summary: Sajan dreams of hypnotising Sanjana with a doll. Later, he gets to know about the fake black magician. Chedilal tells Sajan and Bhupesh that Sanjana used to like a goon, Mannu. Sajan starts keeping a pistol in order to impress Sanjana.

episodesList.title: Sajan Joins Madam's Gang
episodesList.summary: Khiloni pretends to be a goon before Sanjana, to help Sajan prove his machoism. Sanjana tells Sajan that she is the leader of Kali Bijli gang and asks him to join her. Later, Sajan narrowly escapes the police.

episodesList.title: Sajan Gets Cold Feet
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan to deliver a package for the last time. Chedilal also pretends to be involved in smuggling. Sajan encounters the police while he is on a mission and later panics seeing them in the office. Out of fear, Sajan confesses to Sanjana that he was lying about being a goon.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Shirt Safed Kaise?
episodesList.summary: Sajan and Sanjana go to a disco. A tarot card reader tells Sanjana that the man of her dreams will meet her in white shirt and blue trousers. Kashmira confronts Sajan for coming home late. Guess, who turns up wearing a white shirt?

episodesList.title: Saala Pad Gaya Sajan Pe Bhaari
episodesList.summary: Sajan is irritated to learn that Sanjana is interested in Bhupesh. Later, Sanjana confronts Sajan for being rude to Bhupesh. Bhupesh gets promoted to Sajan's position. Back home, a possessed Kashmira punishes Sajan for speaking ill about Bhupesh!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Nayi Chaal
episodesList.summary: While Sanjana and Bhupesh romance, a frustated Sajan disguises as a pregnant woman and claims that it is Bhupesh's child. Will Madam catch Sajan's bluff or is Bhupesh in trouble?

episodesList.title: Sajan Wants Madam Ki Sympathy
episodesList.summary: Sanjana tells Sajan that she can't help comforting people who are sad or upset. The next day, Sajan narrates his dukhbhari kahani to Sanjana, claiming that Kashmira doesn't treat him well. Later, at home, Sajan faces Dadi!

episodesList.title: Madam Ne Ki Sajan Ki Taarif
episodesList.summary: Sajan sneaks out at night to have pizza with Sanjana. The following day, Sanjana puts a board outside her cabin reading, 'Dogs and Sajan not allowed'. Later, in the evening, she pays Kashmira a visit! Why?

episodesList.title: Sanjana's Secret Tattoo
episodesList.summary: Sajan is shocked to see Kashmira in Sanjana's cabin. Sanjana gifts Kashmira and Sajan a holiday package to Goa. The following day, Sanjana tells Sajan that she has got a tattoo done. Meanwhile at home, Kashmira insists that Sajan gets her name tattooed.

episodesList.title: Kya Sajan Pakda Jaayega?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana ignores Sajan in the lift. He comes to know about Sanjana's displeasure with tattoos. He goes to a hospital to get it removed, but bumps into his sister-in-law and Kashmira!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ke 'model' Sapne
episodesList.summary: Kashmira comes to know that Sajan got the tattoo removed. Sanjana later asks Sajan to model for an ad campaign. But Sajan's happiness is short-lived!

episodesList.title: Sanjana's Night Out With Sajan
episodesList.summary: Sanjana invites Sajan for dinner as her father Chhedilal is going out of town. When Sanjana's Russian friend does not turn up at the last moment, she decides to spend the night at Sajan's place!

episodesList.title: Sapne Sajan Ke!
episodesList.summary: Sajan falls off the bed dreaming about Sanjana. He sneaks into Kashmira's room. Later, Sajan lies to Sanjana that Kashmira doesn't like her. He returns home drunk!

episodesList.title: Ab Biwi, Madam Saath Mein!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana is frightened after meeting Dadi. Kashmira fights with Sajan for not taking her to the movie. Sajan is shocked to learn that Sanjana has hired Kashmira!

episodesList.title: Kashmira Ne Li Sajan Ki Class
episodesList.summary: Sanjana and Kashmira enter the office together. Sajan feels left out. Kashmira is Sajan's new boss and wants him to complete his work on time. Sajan requests Sanjana to fire Kashmira.

episodesList.title: Sajan, Sanjana Saath Saath!
episodesList.summary: Kashmira catches Sajan inside Sanjana's tent. Sajan wants to quit his job, but Sanjana wants Kashmira to leave. Sanjana plans to send Kashmira to Singapore, but she declines the offer and later quits her job.

episodesList.title: Sajan, Sanjana Ka Dostana
episodesList.summary: Sanjana confides in Chedilal about being friendless. Sajan hides his identity and becomes a friend to Sanjana. Later, Sajan finds himself in trouble when Chedilal and Kashmira, thinking him to be Sanjana’s anonymous friend call and talk about him.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Naya Affair?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana calls and disturbs Sajan while he romances with Kashmira. She complains to him about her anonymous friend not answering her call. Sajan pulls a prank on Bhupesh. Sanjana tells Kashmira that Sajan is having an affair. Is Sajan in trouble again?

episodesList.title: Khiloni Ki Anokhi Salah
episodesList.summary: Sanjana gets irritated listening to Sajan's shayari. Khiloni advises Sajan to keep away from Sanjana in order to attract her towards him. Sajan applies the same theory at home and romances with Kashmira to get rid of her, while at office he avoids Sanjana to get her attention.

episodesList.title: Sajan Gets Romantic
episodesList.summary: Sajan continues to ignore Sanjana. He gifts a bottle of expensive scotch to Khiloni! Kashmira gets irritated when Sajan wakes her up in the night and tries to act romantic. Will Khiloni's plan work for Sajan?

episodesList.title: Swiss Alps Are Calling Sajan
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan if he would like to go to the mountains for some office work. Sajan tells her that he has phobia for mountains. What will Sajan do when the trip is actually a visit to Switzerland with Madam?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Nayi Mushkil
episodesList.summary: Sanjana insists that Sajan should get his NOC form signed by Kashmira. Acting on Khiloni's advice, he tries to provoke his family. Later, he resorts to emotional drama to convince Kashmira.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ke Saath Hua Dhokha
episodesList.summary: Sajan faints on learning that he is going to Nainital and not Switzerland. Later, he learns about Sanjana's adventurous camping trip. He takes Khiloni's advice to go camping with her.

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Sajni
episodesList.summary: Sajan behaves like a woman and plans for a kitty party in front of Sanjana. Later, Sajan introduces his friends, Mrs Takkar and Kanchu to Sanjana. At home, Kashimira is shocked to see Sajan in her nightgown.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ko Mila Invitation
episodesList.summary: Sajan continues to behave like a woman. Sanjana panics when Sajan enters the ladies toilet. Kashmira tells Sanjana about Sajan's weird behaviour. Later, Sanjana invites Sajan to join her for the camp.

episodesList.title: Sanjana, Sajan Are Friends?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana compliments Sajan for having found a true friend in him. Sajan confesses to Sanjana that he behaved like a woman to make her feel less lonely. Later, Khiloni advises Sajan to save his job by proving his masculinity.

episodesList.title: Madam Ne Maangi Sajan Ki Kidney
episodesList.summary: Bhupesh collects the wrong diagnostic report of Haseena from the hospital. The family members misunderstand thinking Haseena's kidneys have failed! To test Sajan's loyalty towards the company, Sanjana asks Sajan to donate one of his kidneys to Chedilal!

episodesList.title: Bura Phasa Sajan
episodesList.summary: Sajan is in a dilemma whether to donate his kidney or not after Kashmira asks him to donate his kidney to her mother. Meanwhile, Chedilal and Sanjana continue with their prank. Will Sajan donate his kidney to anyone?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Anokhi Demand
episodesList.summary: Bhupesh tells the family members that he collected the wrong medical report. Sajan demands Chedilal to give him a share in the company in exchange of his kidney. Later, Kashmira learns about Sajan's decision to give his kidney to Chedilal.

episodesList.title: Madam Ko Khaana Hai Achaar
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan to get her the pickle he brought in his lunchbox. Sajan flatters Kashmira to get the pickle jar from her. Later, he manages to steal the jar and gives it to Sanjana!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Khiloni Chachi
episodesList.summary: Sajan retrieves the pickle jar from Sanjana. She expresses her desire to learn the pickle recipe from Sajan's aunt. Khiloni disguises as his aunt. Meanwhile, Kashmira invites Sajan's aunt for dinner.

episodesList.title: Ab Kya Karega, Sajan?
episodesList.summary: Sajan promises to take Kashmira out for dinner. Sanjana calls for a meeting and asks her employees to work overtime. What will now happen to Sajan and Kashmira's dinner date?

episodesList.title: Dadi Ne Diya Sajan Ko Order
episodesList.summary: Sanjana-Sajan go to a restaurant for a client meeting. Kashmira is angry to see them together. Dadi orders Sajan to take Kashmira out for dinner. Sajan pretends to be sick so that he can leave the office.

episodesList.title: Sajan Sirf Sach Bolega
episodesList.summary: A client introduces Sanjana to a pill that makes people speak the truth. She decides to test the pill on Sajan. Later, Sajan humiliates Kashmira when she asks him about her sari. The next day, he confides his deed to Sanjana.

episodesList.title: Kashmira Kholegi Sajan's Raaz
episodesList.summary: The effect of the truth pill continues. Sajan fails to stop himself from insulting Chedilal. Sanjana stops Chedilal from firing Sajan. Kashmira decides to make the most of 'Sajan's truth telling' exercise. Will Sajan land in some big trouble?

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Kaam Wali Bai!
episodesList.summary: Sajan is made to sit on the hot seat and is bombarded with questions. Later, Sanjana tells Sajan that her maid has left the job. Sajan reaches her house disguised as a maid.

episodesList.title: Meet Shanta Lopez!
episodesList.summary: A woman called Shanta Lopez visits Sanjana's house. Later, Sanjana questions Sajan for coming late to office. Kashmira suspects Sajan's actions and asks Bhupesh to spy on him. Later, Chedilal tries to flirt with Shanta.

episodesList.title: Kab Tak Bachega Sajan?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana confronts Sajan for being late to work. She asks Shanta to make dinner at Kashmira's house. Later, Kashmira and Bhupesh find women's clothes in Sajan's bag!

episodesList.title: Chedilal Ki Shaadi Shanta Se?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Shanta to marry Chedilal. Sajan tries hard to explain Kashmira about the women's clothes in his bag. Khiloni visits Sanjana's house as Shanta's husband!

episodesList.title: Sajan's Madam Gayi Out Of Hand
episodesList.summary: How will Sajan tackle a hypnotised Sanjana as she gets too hot to handle? Sajan is in deep trouble when Khiloni tells him about the stolen book!

episodesList.title: Sajan Hypnotises Kashmira
episodesList.summary: Sajan retrieves the book from the gorilla and hypnotises Kashmira. Meanwhile, what is Sanjana doing in Sajan's house?

episodesList.title: Kya Bhupesh Ki Lottery Lagegi?
episodesList.summary: Will Sajan succeed in his attempt to hypnotise his family and erase the memory of Sanjana's visit? Later, Bhupesh buys a lottery ticket with Sajan's money!

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Crorepati
episodesList.summary: Sajan claims the lottery money. He tells Chedilal to make him his business partner and gifts a bike to Bhupesh. Later, he tries to brag about his changed status before Sanjana.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ko Mila Thenga
episodesList.summary: Chedilal and Sanjana want Sajan to prove that he is a crorepati. Later, a shock awaits Sajan when he calls the lottery office. How will Sajan deal with it?

episodesList.title: Meet Janu, Madam's Cousin!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana deliberately puts Sajan into trouble when Kashmira calls him. Kashmira misunderstands Sajan to be with another woman. Meanwhile, Madam's cousin, Janu arrives on the scene!

episodesList.title: Kashmira Ka Ban Gaya Janu
episodesList.summary: Sajan gets angry on seeing Janu romance Kashmira. However, he is unaware about a bigger plan!

episodesList.title: Janu Ne Li Sajan Ki Jaan
episodesList.summary: Janu continues to romance with Kashmira. At the office, Sanjana tells Sajan about Janu's past affairs with married women. Is there cause for concern for Sajan?

episodesList.title: Madam Bheegi Baarish Mein
episodesList.summary: Sanjana expresses her desire to get drenched in the rain. Despite being sick, Sajan goes to the office the next day to watch her enjoy the rain. Will everything happen as Sajan wished?

episodesList.title: Madam Ki Fantasy
episodesList.summary: Bhupesh finds Sajan jumping up and down in the rain and asking Sanjana to join him. Later, Sanjana tells Sajan about her fantasy to see a man, drenched!

episodesList.title: Sajan Baal Baal Bacha?
episodesList.summary: Chedi invites Kashmira's mother for tea. Sajan starts using a hair tonic. But will it benefit him?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Ujda Chaman!
episodesList.summary: Sajan covers his head with a bandana and goes to office. Sanjana is disgusted to see his bald head and asks him to stay away from her. Sajan's problems double up when Kashmira too asks him to not come home!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ko Mili Jadui Dawai
episodesList.summary: Sajan is depressed as everyone ignores him because of his baldness. Meanwhile, Khiloni provides him with a quick solution to get his hair back.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Paanv Kabar Mein
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan to spend a night with her at the cemetery. Fear grips Sajan at the graveyard when someone in a mask scares him!

episodesList.title: Bhaago Sajan, Bhoot Aaya?
episodesList.summary: Someone slaps Sajan inside the lift when the lights go off. Later, some uncanny incidents leave him unnerved. Someone calls out his name when he is alone at home! Who is it?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ke Peeche Bhoot?
episodesList.summary: Sajan tells Sanjana about his encounter with a ghost. The next day, they visit a graveyard where an old man tells them that they resemble people from the past!

episodesList.title: Madam High 'spirit' Mein!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana wants to meet Johny's ghost. At night, she disguises herself as Julie and tries to flirt with Sajan to summon Johny's spirit.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ko Mila Johny Se Chutkara
episodesList.summary: Sanjana orders Sajan to summon Dadi's ghost or else! Sajan tries to insult Kashmira to summon Dadi. Later, Dadi's ghost saves Sanjana and Sajan from Johny's ghost!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Naya Dhong
episodesList.summary: Khiloni reminds Sajan about his marriage anniversary after he plans to go out with Sanjana for dinner. Later, he pretends to have lost his memory in order to avoid Kashmira's anger. Will Sajan succeed in his act?

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Chaprasi!
episodesList.summary: Sajan ends up squatting flies and preparing tea for Sanjana after Chedilal makes him a peon! His situation gets worse at home. Find out why.

episodesList.title: Kya Pakda Jayega Sajan?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana flirts with Sajan to summon Dadi, hoping that he will recall everything. Later, she calls him to her house and asks him to give a back massage to Chedilal. Is Sajan falling into Sanjana's trap?

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Madam Ka Chamcha
episodesList.summary: The loss of another major client leads Sanjana to put ridiculous suggestions into effect. Soon, she turns Sajan into her personal office pet!

episodesList.title: It's A Dog's Life For Sajan!
episodesList.summary: Bhupesh finds Sanjana tying a dog's collar on Sajan's neck. Later, Sanjana asks Kashmira to treat Sajan like a dog. What happens next that makes Sajan an 'aggressive dog!'

episodesList.title: Madam Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
episodesList.summary: Sajan brags that he can spend money to get Sanjana out of any problem. She lies to him that someone is threatening to release her obscene pictures if she doesn't pay him. What will Sajan do?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ne Ki Chori
episodesList.summary: Sanjana tells Sajan that the kidnapper is blackmailing her for more money. Sajan steals money from Kashmira's purse and later, disguises himself as a robber!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ne Ki Maang Puri
episodesList.summary: Sanjana manipulates Sajan into getting more money for her, getting him into trouble with Kashmira. Later, Sajan is depressed when he sees Sanjana!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ban Gaya Love Guru
episodesList.summary: Sajan is beaten up by Manu for insulting him in front of Sanjana. However, Sanjana reveals to him that she was pretending to be Manu's wife all this time. Later, Sajan poses as Love Guru, Aashiq Awara.

episodesList.title: Madam Ne Dil Ki Raaz Kholi!
episodesList.summary: Sajan puts a fake snake under Sanjana's desk and tries to act heroic by saving her. Later, Sanjana calls Love Guru Aashiq Awara and bares her heart to him.

episodesList.title: Phas Gaya Bechara Sajan
episodesList.summary: Chedilal is unhappy about Sanjana's decision to marry Love Guru Aashiq Awara. Meanwhile, is Kashmira having an affair with Aashiq Awara?

episodesList.title: Sajan Hua Badnaam
episodesList.summary: To make her company famous, Sanjana makes Sajan a part of her controversy and tells the media that he had tried to harass her. Later, Kashmira drives Sajan out of the house! Where will Sajan go?

episodesList.title: Chedi Complains Against Sajan
episodesList.summary: Sajan wears a sari to stop people from recognising him. Later, he manages to convince Kashmira about the controversy. Meanwhile, Chedilal is adamant on filing a FIR against Sajan.

episodesList.title: Madam Ki Tarkeeb Kaam Ayegi?
episodesList.summary: Sajan’s mother-in-law presents his case in court, while Chedilal defends Sanjana. The two try to prove their respective clients to be innocent. Later, Sanjana comes up with a plan and shares it with Sajan. What is it?

episodesList.title: Hum Tum Ek Gufe Mein Phase Ho
episodesList.summary: Sanjana and Sajan get stranded and find shelter in a cave when their car breaks down. Sajan falls unconscious due to extreme cold and finds himself in a sticky situation. The next day, Sanjana plays a prank on him.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Is Pregnant!
episodesList.summary: While Sanjana tells Sajan that she is pregnant with his child, at home, Kashmira, too desires to have a child. Ab kya karega Sajan?

episodesList.title: Kashmira Seduces Sajan
episodesList.summary: Sanjana tells Sajan that she will do a DNA test to prove that he is the father. Meanwhile, Kashmira tries to seduce Sajan!

episodesList.title: Madam Ne Bataya Kashmira Ko
episodesList.summary: Khiloni advises Sajan to use poison when he decides to commit suicide. At Chedi's birthday party, Sanjana tells Kashmira that she is pregnant with Sajan's child!

episodesList.title: Sajan Turns Into A Matchmaker
episodesList.summary: Kashmira gets angry when Sajan suggests Chedi's marriage with his mother-in-law. The following day, Sanjana arranges for a date for her dad. Will Sajan be able to persuade his mother-in-law to go on a date?

episodesList.title: Sajan Sedates His Mother-in-law
episodesList.summary: Kashmira finds her mother with Chedilal at the restaurant. Later, Sajan tries to manipulate his mother-in-law to elope with Chedilal. After Kashmira falls asleep, he manages to sedate his mother-in-law and take her to Chedilal.

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Babysitter!
episodesList.summary: Sajan brings his mother-in-law to Sanjana's house where they set up the marriage altar. The following day, Sanjana asks Sajan to look after her friend's baby. Can Sajan do it?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Bachcha Kahan Hai?
episodesList.summary: Kashmira throws Sajan out of the house on seeing him with a baby. Later, Sajan stops Sanjana from finding out that the baby is missing!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ke Peeche Chedi!
episodesList.summary: Sajan's mother-in-law meets Chedilal and learns about his plan to expose Sajan. Sajan tries to hide something from Sanjana. Will he be caught?

episodesList.title: Bhupesh, Madam Saath Saath
episodesList.summary: Sajan tells Sanjana's friend that Chedilal stole the baby from him. Kashmira comes in with the baby before any action is taken. Meanwhile, Sanjana and Bhupesh plan a new prank on Sajan.

episodesList.title: Murda Gayab!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana tells Sajan that she is going to confess to the police about Bhupesh's murder. Later, Sajan finds Bhupesh's body missing.

episodesList.title: Murda Gayab!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana tells Sajan that she is going to confess to the police about Bhupesh's murder. Later, Sajan finds Bhupesh's body missing.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Naya Natak
episodesList.summary: Sajan learns about the prank that Sanjana and Bhupesh had played on him. Chedilal tries to commit suicide! Later, Sanjana asks Sajan to comfort Chedilal by acting as a man possessed.

episodesList.title: Sajan Pe Hua Bhoot Sawar!
episodesList.summary: Sajan pretends to be possessed by Chedi's dead wife in order to please Sanjana. But, later, Chedi gets possessive of his late wife, putting Sajan in a spot!

episodesList.title: Madam Ka Plan
episodesList.summary: Sajan seeks refuge in Sanjana's house after being thrown out of his own house. But, he is in trouble when Chedi wants to communicate with his dead wife. Sanjana comes up with a plan to end the game!

episodesList.title: The Rajni Fever!
episodesList.summary: Sajan comes to know that Sanjana is an ardent fan of Rajnikant and lies to her that the superstar is his childhood buddy. Later, confusion makes way for chaos when Sanjana calls a look-alike of the famous actor to her office.

episodesList.title: Sajan Meets Thalaiva!
episodesList.summary: Fearing exposure, Sajan tells Khiloni to kidnap him, so that he doesn't have to go to office. Later, he notices the lookalike of Rajnikant and understands Sanjana's plan.

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Sanjana Ka Bhai!
episodesList.summary: Everyone is eagerly waiting to celebrate Raksha Bandhan. Since Sanjana doesn't have a brother, she decides to tie a rakhi on Sajan and make him her brother!

episodesList.title: Sanjana Ne Bandhi Sajan Ko Rakhi!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana seeks Kashmira’s permission to let her tie rakhi on Sajan’s hand. Sajan tries to avoid her and makes a desperate attempt to flee.

episodesList.title: Sajan Turns Into A Chef!
episodesList.summary: Sajan gets himself arrested, hoping to evade Sanjana. But, she is adamant about tying him a rakhi and comes to the police station. The next day, Sajan lies to Sanjana about his culinary skills and then finds himself in a fix!

episodesList.title: Sanjana Ki Lajawab Dishes
episodesList.summary: Sajan falsely praises Sanjana's cooking after she prepares shahi paneer. Sanjana asks him to teach some other dishes as well. How will Chedilal react when he will be served the dishes prepared by Sanjana?

episodesList.title: Sajan Banega Krishna Kanhaiya
episodesList.summary: Kashmira gets angry with Sajan after she learns that he has been teaching Sanjana how to cook. The next day, she tells Sajan that she wants him to take part in the Janmashtami celebrations. Will Sajan oblige?

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Giridhari!
episodesList.summary: Sajan gets into an argument with his neighbour regarding the Janmashtami celebrations. The next day, at work, Sajan jumps at the idea of Sanjana playing Radha's role opposite him.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Fitness Mantra
episodesList.summary: A scared Sajan, unaware of Chidchide's plan, climbs over the human pyramid to break the handi. Later, Kashmira asks Sajan to join her for an early morning jog!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Power Yoga
episodesList.summary: Sajan expresses his wish to be Sanjana's partner in doing power yoga. Later, Bhupesh shoots a video of Sajan doing yoga. Why?

episodesList.title: Sajan Breaks His Arm!
episodesList.summary: Sajan is forced to go on a fitness run with Kashmira and then with Sanjana. Khiloni suggests that Sajan fake an injury in order to escape the rigorous regime. But, Sanjana gets a little too worried about Sajan!

episodesList.title: Sanjana Bani Naagin!
episodesList.summary: Sajan asks his friend, Khiloni to break his hand before his meeting with Sanjana. Later, Sajan overhears Sanjana talking over the phone about her role as a Naagin and mistakes her to be one!

episodesList.title: Sajan Is Scared Of Sanjana
episodesList.summary: Sajan runs home after meeting Sanjana. Later, he sees a snake in his house and his fear of Sanjana grows bigger. The next day, Chedi gets to know about Sajan's fear and scares him.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Naagin, Sajan Sapera
episodesList.summary: Sanjana continues to fool Sajan by pretending to be an Ichchhadhari Naagin. Meanwhile, Khiloni gives Sajan a pungi to tame her and the others. Will Sajan come to know about Sanjana's plan?

episodesList.title: Shak Ke Ghere Mein Sajan
episodesList.summary: Chedilal's dominating sister visits India to get Sanjana married. Kashmira becoes suspicious when an upset Sajan tells her about it.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Tricks Her Aunt
episodesList.summary: Sajan goes to Sanjana's house disguised as a potential suitor for marriage, but Chedi recognises him. Soon, Kashmira comes in with her mother, leaving Sajan in a panic.

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Madam Ka Dulha
episodesList.summary: Sajan disguises himself as a prospective groom for Sanjana. Later, Sanjana's aunt insists that the groom's family stays at Kashmira's house. Meanwhile, Kashmira waits for Sajan at home. How will Sajan play the double role?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Atki Jaan
episodesList.summary: Sanjana tells Kashmira that she does not want to marry and asks her help to avoid the groom and his family. But, Sanjana's aunt brings a lawyer to get them married. What will Sajan do?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ne Piya Syrup
episodesList.summary: Sanjana mocks Sajan's physique when he volunteers to model for an ad. Later, Khiloni gives Sajan a syrup to tone down his physique. Will it work for Sajan?

episodesList.title: Andher Nagri Mein Sajan
episodesList.summary: Bhupesh deceives Sajan and takes him to the terrace instead of taking him to Sanjana's office. Will it land Sajan in some fresh trouble at office and at home?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Kismat Hi Kharab
episodesList.summary: Sajan curses himself for having no vision as Sanjana takes him to a water park and wears a bikini. While returning home, they are abducted by a dangerous mental patient. How will Sajan and Sanjana save themselves?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ne Kho Di Property
episodesList.summary: Sanjana calls Chedi irresponsible and their argument takes an ugly turn when he decides to give away all his possessions. Who will Chedi give away his property to?

episodesList.title: Sajan's Promise To Sanjana
episodesList.summary: Sanjana gets furious on learning that Chedi has transferred his property in Ramvati's name. Sajan promises her that he will find a solution to this problem. Can he?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ne Banaya Plan
episodesList.summary: Sajan uses Khiloni in his plan to stop Bhupesh, Ramvati and Kashmira from taking over Chedi's property. Later, he tries to warn Chedi about Ramvati's intentions.

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Shehzada!
episodesList.summary: Sajan reads Sanjana's personal diary and learns about her wish to have a boyfriend from a royal family. He asks a local vendor to visit the office dressed as royalty and introduce himself as Sajan's grandfather!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ke Rangeen Shauk!
episodesList.summary: The vendor in a Maharaja's disguise visits Sanjana's house pretending to be Sajan's grandfather. Sajan reveals about a tradition of his royal dynasty to have a girlfriend apart from a wife. What will happen when Kashmira learns about this?

episodesList.title: Dada Ke Chakkar Mein Phasa Sajan
episodesList.summary: Sajan lies about his grandfather's part time job when Sanjana finds him selling vegetables on the streets. Later, Kashmira invites his grandfather and requests him to stay with them!

episodesList.title: Sanjana Bani Sajan Ki Gf!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana makes Sajan's day as she agrees to be his girlfriend. But, his wild fantasies soon meet a dead end! Find out why.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ko Chahiye Sukoon
episodesList.summary: Sajan and Kashmira's romance comes to an abrupt halt with Kashmira's family interrupting them. Meanwhile, Sanjana's aunt also starts troubling her at night. The next day, Sajan and Sanjana exchange ideas to solve their problems.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ko Sona Padega Tent Mein!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana's aunt says that her snoring reminds her of her husband. The next day, Sajan tells Kashmira that he will not stay in the house till her family leaves. Later, Sajan has another idea to solve Sanjana's problem.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Sajan Ke Saath?
episodesList.summary: Sajan goes through a troubled night, with no other choice but to sleep in a tent. However, when asked about it, he lies to Sanjana and Kashmira. Later, fed up with her aunt, Sanjana requests Sajan to allow her to sleep in the tent with him. What will Sajan do now?

episodesList.title: Kashmira Is Anxious!
episodesList.summary: Kashmira is worried with Sanjana's arrival and persuades her mother and brother to apologise to Sajan. Later, Kashmira's grandmother arrives and scares them.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ne Diya Sanjana Ko Tohfa
episodesList.summary: Sanjana is in a bad mood as Chedi has forgotten her birthday. Meanwhile, Sajan finds out that it is her birthday and lies about remembering it. What will he gift Sanjana??

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Tohfa Pad Gaya Mehenga
episodesList.summary: Sajan gifts a pair of earrings to Sanjana. However, he panics when he realises that the earrings are a family heirloom. What will he do?

episodesList.title: Sanjana's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Sajan is worried when his mother-in-law visits his office. He desperately tries to keep her from seeing Sanjana. Soon, Sanjana invites Sajan's family for her birthday party!

episodesList.title: Sajan, Khiloni Ka Bangkok Trip
episodesList.summary: Sajan asks Sanjana for a leave as he wants to go on a trip with Khiloni to Bangkok. Khiloni tells Sajan that Kashmira has found their tickets for Bangkok. Sajan leaves for home but Sanjana calls him back for some official work.

episodesList.title: Begani Shaadi Mein Sajan Deewana
episodesList.summary: Sanjana tells Sajan that she will attend Khiloni's sister's marriage with him. Kashmira and the others too plan to go along with him. What will Sajan do now?

episodesList.title: Who Is Dadi's Soulmate?
episodesList.summary: Sajan persuades Dadi, but faces problems in convincing Sanjana. Khiloni lies about the marriage getting cancelled, while Sanjana decides to help. Later, Dadi talks to Sajan about her soulmate!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ne Kheli Nayi Chaal
episodesList.summary: Sajan convinces a local street vendor to pretend as Khiloni's grandfather in front of Sanjana and in return, promises to take him to Bangkok with them. Will their plan to fool Sanjana work out?

episodesList.title: Sajan Chala Bangkok?
episodesList.summary: Dadi tells Sajan that Khiloni's 'grandfather' was the childhood friend whom she liked. The next day, Khiloni's sister shows up at Sanjana's office and Sajan is left with no other option but to spill the beans about his Bangkok trip!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Nayi Chalupanti!
episodesList.summary: Sajan gifts Sanjana a flower vase with a spy camera planted inside and is thrilled when she promises to place it in her bedroom. Later at night, his fantasies are shattered when he watches the footage on his phone.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Aurat Nahi Aadmi Hai!
episodesList.summary: Sajan gets restless after finding out that Sanjana is actually a man and tries to avoid her. Meanwhile, Kashmira calls Sanjana over for dinner. What will Sajan do when Sanjana decides to spend the night at his place?

episodesList.title: Sajan Is Confused!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana pretends to enter the men's washroom in front of Sajan and confuses him. Sajan also catches her shaving while he goes to offer his resignation. Later, Sajan takes the police to Sanjana's place and makes wild claims.

episodesList.title: Shreyas Talpade On The Show
episodesList.summary: Sajan reads a notice in the newspaper that actor, Shreyas Talpade, is looking for a couple to act in his movie and sends photographs of Sanjana. Later Shreyas pays them a surprise visit.

episodesList.title: Kya Sajan Banega Madam Ka Hero?
episodesList.summary: Shreyas Talpade tells Sanjana that she's been selected as the main heroine in his next movie. He then gives her a narration, while Sajan impresses him with his creative inputs. Will Sajan get a role too?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ko Mila Ek Naya Role
episodesList.summary: Chedilal tells Sajan about his plan to cast Kashmira and her mother in his movie. Later, Shreyas offers Sajan a role in his film. However, Sajan is not happy with his role.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ban Gaya Pregnant
episodesList.summary: Sajan tries to stop Sanjana and Shreyas Talpade from working together in a movie. Later, he comes to office disguised as a pregnant woman!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ban Gaya Dadaji!
episodesList.summary: Sajan is shocked to see Sanjana in a new avatar. Young and energetic again, Sanjana scares Sajan by chasing him on skates. Later, Dadi asks Sajan to disguise himself as Dadaji and pretend to be her lover.

episodesList.title: Has Sanjana Fired Sajan?
episodesList.summary: Dadi forces Sajan to dress up as Dadaji, creating problems in his office. In an attempt to make Dadi hate him, Sajan tries to ruin the memories related to Dadaji. But, things turn ugly when Sanjana hires a new creative head.

episodesList.title: Sajan Gets His Job Back
episodesList.summary: Bhupesh saves Sajan's skin! The next day, Sanjana scolds Sajan, but is happy to learn that Rajan is gone. Later, Sanjana's aunt has a proposal for her.

episodesList.title: Sajan Sanjana Ka Sticky Affair!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana uses a powerful glue to get stuck to Sajan. Sajan is delighted but is soon in for big trouble!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ko Hai Dadi Ka Darr
episodesList.summary: Sajan and Sanjana try to find a way to separate their hands. Later, Sajan is scared to face Dadi. Meanwhile, who is this childhood friend who Sanjana is missing?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ke Udd Gaye Tote!
episodesList.summary: Chedi tells Sajan a bitter truth that totally frustrates him! What is it? How will Sajan deal with the new equation that he has to share now with Sanjana?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Naya Position
episodesList.summary: Chedi and Sanjana surprise Sajan by giving him a new position in office and decide to hold a puja for him. But Sajan has other plans.

episodesList.title: Sajan Chala Dubai!
episodesList.summary: Sajan overhears that Chedi is going to Dubai. Later, he panics when he is told to retrieve a special package from a Sheikh in Dubai since Chedi can't go.

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Smuggler
episodesList.summary: Sajan has a nightmare in which Sanjana deceives him. Bhupesh tells him about a friend who is in jail for smuggling gold. Sanjana asks Sajan to smuggle gold biscuits for her from Dubai. Will Sajan follow her orders?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ke Peeche Padi Police!
episodesList.summary: Sajan sneaks into Chedi's house and beats him with a stick to make him run. The next day, Sajan panics on seeing a policeman chase him and tells him that Chedi is making him smuggle gold. Later, Sajan accuses Bhupesh of being a thief.

episodesList.title: Lut Gaya Sajan!
episodesList.summary: Bhupesh plans to take revenge on Sajan and keeps office stationary in his bag. Soon, Sanjana gives Sajan a huge amount of money for safe-keeping but it gets stolen. The next day, Sajan decides to tell Sanjana about the theft.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ne Kiya Saas Pe Vaar!
episodesList.summary: Sajan is desperate to pay off Sanjana and tells Kashmira’s mother to sell her land. Unable to convince her, he takes a drastic step!

episodesList.title: Phas Gaye Sajan
episodesList.summary: Sajan scares Kashmira and Chedi that the kidnappers are demanding ransom. Chedi agrees to pay the ransom but Sajan is caught in a tight spot when Dadi threatens him!

episodesList.title: Sanjana's Copycat
episodesList.summary: Sanjana suggests the idea of a double-role for an ad, but Sajan doesn't believe in the existence of doppelgangers. His opinion changes when he meets Raseela, Sanjana's lookalike. Later, she enters Sajan's room while Kashmira is asleep beside him.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Is Kidnapped!
episodesList.summary: Sajan meets Raseela in the office and learns that she has abducted Sanjana for money. Later, he falls unconscious after meeting Raseela's gang.

episodesList.title: Sajan Is Pregnant?
episodesList.summary: Sajan accidentally gets injected by Lalwani's experimental fertility medicine. Later, he sees Sanjana treating her pregnant friend with a lot of care! The next day, he pretends to be ill and goes for a check-up. What is he ailing from?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Baj Gayi Band
episodesList.summary: Sanjana does a research on male pregnancy and starts to doubt Sajan and the doctor. Later, she and Kashmira confront the doctor to find out the truth.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Godh Bharai!
episodesList.summary: Sajan is having a good time pretending to be pregnant. Later, he goes to the doctor and finds himself in a soup! Back home, a baby shower is organised for him and that's not all!

episodesList.title: Madam Bani Gayi Bewdi!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana is tired of Chedilal's drinking habit so, Sajan gives her a suggestion. The following day, Sanjana gets tanked and creates a scene in the office in front of Chedilal. Can Sajan control madam this time?

episodesList.title: Sanjana Gets Drunk!
episodesList.summary: Sajan is arrested by the police after Sanjana accuses him of making her dance. Later, Chedi decides to quit alcohol after seeing Sanjana drunk!

episodesList.title: Sharaabi Sajan!
episodesList.summary: The cops arrest Sajan for drinking and dancing on the streets. The next day, Sajan takes a hasty decision when Sanjana refuses to quit drinking.

episodesList.title: Kya Chedi Ko Hua Hai Pyaar?
episodesList.summary: Sajan decides to quit his job, as he believes that Sanjana's drinking habit is affecting his life. Later, Sanjana plays around with Sajan, while Chedi gets romantic with Kashmira's mother.

episodesList.title: Sajan Works Overtime
episodesList.summary: Sanjana continues to seduce Sajan in order to win the challenge against Chedi. Meanwhile, Sanjana shows up in office while Kashmira asks Sajan to work overtime!

episodesList.title: Kya Madam Hongi Impress?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana continues to trouble Sajan, only to win her challenge against Chedi. Later, Khiloni gives some tips to Sajan to impress Sanjana.

episodesList.title: Sanjana's Mysterious Lover
episodesList.summary: An ecstatic Sanjana tells Sajan about her mysterious lover. Sajan decides to write Sanjana a letter. But when Sanjana tells Kashmira about her mystery man, she frightens Sanjana with her advice.

episodesList.title: Sajan Flirts With Sanjana
episodesList.summary: Sajan enjoys flirting with Sanjana on the phone. However, Sanjana taps the call to get the caller arrested. Will Sanjana find out the identity of the caller?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ke Paas Kaala Dhan!
episodesList.summary: Sanjana requests Sajan to deposit the black money in a bank. At the same time, Kashmira and her mother also try to convince Sajan to deposit their money!

episodesList.title: Sajan Phir Phans Gaya Re
episodesList.summary: Sanjana asks Sajan to convert Chedi's black money into white. Bhupesh notices Sajan giving the money to the liftman. To double the trouble, Karishma too gives money to Sajan!

episodesList.title: Sajan Is In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Sanjana and Kashmira notice a negative vibe around Sajan and decide to do something about it. They make him work harder and later, humiliate him for his efforts. Will Sajan be able to cope up with their challenges?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ho Gaya Buddha?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana tries to convince Sajan that he has grown old. Kashmira and Khiloni too play along. How will Sajan handle the situation?

episodesList.title: Sajan In A Soup
episodesList.summary: Sajan's happiness knows no bounds when Sanjana asks him to meet her in the evening, during the power cut. However, his excitement goes for a toss. Find out why.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Ne Maangi Maafi Sajan Se!
episodesList.summary: Sajan is shocked to learn about Kashmira and her mother’s secrets. Later, Sanjana apologises to Sajan, but gets angry at him again. What has he done now?

episodesList.title: Wajah Tum Ho Cast Visit
episodesList.summary: Sajan loses control over himself! He sneaks into the office late at night to see Sanjana's pictures on her laptop. Later, the lead pair of Wajah Tum Ho visit their office!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ko Hua Sanjana Se Pyaar?
episodesList.summary: Sajan meets his old friend who tells him that he was madly in love with a girl. Later, Sajan starts thinking about Sanjana and sees her everywhere. He even mistakes his mother-in-law to be his boss. Sajan's strange behaviour strikes Kashmira as odd and she confronts him.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Wants A Massage
episodesList.summary: Sanjana’s request for a massage fires up Sajan’s imagination. Later, Kashmira’s attempt to seduce Sajan ends up in a fiasco!

episodesList.title: Sajan In A Tight Situation
episodesList.summary: Sanjana agrees to help Sajan after he confides his addiction to her. Later, she calls the police to arrest him. To get out of the situation, Sajan lies about being a tightrope walker!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Langdi Chaal
episodesList.summary: Sajan arrives at the office on a wheelchair and claims to have lost control of his legs. Will Sanjana and Chedi believe him?

episodesList.title: New Girl In Sajan's Office
episodesList.summary: With Kashmira and her mother at home and Sanjana in office, how will Sajan tackle them all? Will the new girl in office help him?

episodesList.title: Sajan, Madam Ka Costume Drama
episodesList.summary: Sajan continues to fantasise about Sanjana. Sanjana requests Sajan to accompany her to a costume party. What will happen when Kashmira finds out about it?

episodesList.title: Sajan Quits His Job!
episodesList.summary: Sajan's conscience pricks him and he quits his job. Later, he regrets his decision and tries to get his job back. Will Sanjana oblige.

episodesList.title: Sanjana To Get Married?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana is worried on learning that her aunt has found a suitable groom for her. Later, her decision to evade marriage makes Sajan insecure.

episodesList.title: Sanjana To Marry Bhupesh
episodesList.summary: Sanjana's aunt decides to stay at Sajan's house to give her lessons on being an ideal daughter-in-law. Later, Sanjana tells Sajan that she's going to marry Bhupesh!

episodesList.summary: Sajan tries to make Sanjana hate Bhupesh but his plan backfires. Upon Khiloni's advice, Sajan tells Bhupesh that Sanjana admires men who dominate women.

episodesList.title: Sanjana's New Hobby
episodesList.summary: Sajan advises Sanjana to pick up a hobby and they go fishing together. However, Sajan gets into trouble as Sanjana informs Kashmira about the trip. Later, Sanjana involves Sajan in her new pastime.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ka Naya Hobby!
episodesList.summary: Sajan looks forward to swimming with Sanjana. But, soon he gets bored, and Khiloni comes up with a new idea!

episodesList.title: Sajan Bana Santa Claus!
episodesList.summary: Sajan misunderstands Sanjana and ends up undressing in office! However, he soon realises that Sanjana had actually asked him to play Santa Claus. Later, Kashmira overhears Sajan and Khiloni's conversation.

episodesList.title: Has Santa Arrived?
episodesList.summary: Kashmira's mother wants to see her husband in Santa's costume, while Kashmira waits for Sajan. Meanwhile, Sanjana too is waiting for her surprise from Santa Claus! So who will have a merry Christmas?

episodesList.summary: After failing to be Sanjana's Santa Claus, Sajan is in trouble again as Kashmira wants him to take her to the new Tarzan movie. But what happens when Sanjana expresses her love for Tarzan?

episodesList.title: Madam Ka Albela Aashiq
episodesList.summary: Sanjana is a big fan of an anonymous poet called Albela Aashiq and is desperate to meet him. Sajan tells her that he is Albela Aashiq. Later, Khiloni helps Sajan steal Kashmira's diary filled with similar poems to give Sanjana a proof.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Fines Sajan
episodesList.summary: Kashmira fails to find her diary and accuses Sajan of stealing it. Meanwhile, Sanjana learns about Sajan's lies and decides to fine him Rs 25 lakhs!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ne Ki Charity
episodesList.summary: Sajan gives his money away and watch to a random beggar as an act of charity to impress Sanjana. Later, he imagines Sanjana confessing her love to him.

episodesList.title: Sanjana Steals Kashmira's Shoes!
episodesList.summary: Kashmira accuses Sajan of stealing her sari. Later, Sanjana steals Kashmira's golden shoes!

episodesList.title: Sajan Ke Paas Itne Paise?
episodesList.summary: The family refuses to believe Sanjana has a sleepwalking disorder. Sanjana comes to Sajan's house with a sack full of money. Does that mean fresh trouble for Sajan?

episodesList.title: Sajan To Marry Sanjana?
episodesList.summary: Sajan decides to separate from Kashmira when he learns that Sanjana will only marry a divorcee. Later, he goes on a date with Sanjana. Will the two finally hit it off?

episodesList.title: Sajan Still Loves Kashmira?
episodesList.summary: Sajan plans to divorce Kashmira but keeps talking about her on his date with Sanjana! What will Sanjana do next?Meanwhile, Kashmira tries to commit suicide.

episodesList.title: Sajan Ban Gaya Bawarchi
episodesList.summary: Sanjana takes Sajan’s help when her cook goes on leave. On Khiloni’s advice, Sajan disguises himself as Durjan, his twin brother!

episodesList.title: Phir Phas Gaya Sajan
episodesList.summary: Sajan goes to Sanjana's house as Durjan and plans to leave before Kashmira arrives. But Kashmira, along with her mother and brother arrive before time. Is this the end of Sajan's double role?

episodesList.title: Sanjana To Marry Durjan?
episodesList.summary: Sanjana decides to marry Durjan and goes to Kashmira's house to fix their engagement. Sajan forgets to take along his phone. Will this land him in trouble?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Ho Gayi Maut?
episodesList.summary: Planning to teach Sajan a lesson, Sanjana takes help from his family and pretends that Sajan is dead. A bewildered Sajan starts believing that he had in fact died! Will he come to know about the plan?

episodesList.title: Kashmira Banegi Dulhania!
episodesList.summary: Unaware of Sanjana's prank, Sajan gets depressed as she convinces Kashmira to get married again. Seeing Kashmira happy, Sajan goes mad. How will he react when he learns the truth?

episodesList.title: Sanjana Ya Kashmira?
episodesList.summary: Sajan daydreams about Sanjana, while Kashmira tells Sajan to give a fresh start to their relationship. Whom will Sajan select?

episodesList.title: Sajan Ki Yaadgaar Date!
episodesList.summary: Kashmira tricks Sajan to reveal his secret plans of dating Sanjana. Later, Sajan goes on a date with Sanjana! Will everything go smooth?

episodesList.title: Meet Sajan's Bobby Uncle!
episodesList.summary: Sajan lies to Kashmira when she accuses him of deceiving her. Later, Bobby Uncle is eager to meet Sajan's well-educated wife. What will Sajan do now?

episodesList.title: Bobby Uncle Ne Di Sajan Ko Tension
episodesList.summary: Sajan and Sanjana act like a couple and wait for Bobby uncle to leave. However, Bobby uncle decides to stay overnight. How long can they continue with their act?

episodesList.title: Athithi Tum Kab Jaoge?
episodesList.summary: On Sajan's insistence, Sanjana visits his house to meet Bobby uncle in the night. Later, Bobby uncle scolds Sajan and Kashmira on seeing them together.

episodesList.title: Madam Aur Sajan Honeymoon Pe?
episodesList.summary: Bobby uncle suspects something is wrong between Sajan and Kashmira. Later, Sajan and Kashmira plan to spend some romantic moments, while Bobby uncle decides to send Sajan and Sanjana on a honeymoon trip!

episodesList.title: Sajan And Kashmira Romance!
episodesList.summary: Bobby uncle finds Sajan and Kashmira romancing in the kitchen and decides to leave the house. Sajan hits a man who steals Sanjana's bracelet. Later, income tax officers arrive to raid Sanjana's office. Why?

episodesList.summary: A goon waits outside Sajan's house to attack him. Meanwhile, Sanjana calls Sajan urgently to office as the income tax officers have arrived. What will Sajan do now?

episodesList.summary: Sajan, in a burkha, gets stuck with the goon in an elevator. He also avoids Kashmira and Sanjana's calls to protect his identity. Meanwhile, the income tax officer warns Sanjana about the consequences she might have to face. How will Sajan save himself?

Meri Awaaz Hi Pehchaan Hai (English: My voice is my identity) is an Indian musical drama television series, which premiered on 7 March 2016 on &TV. It is produced by a brand new production company The House of Originals of Nivedita Basu.
Amrita Rao and Aditi Vasudev along with Deepti Naval and Zarina Wahab played the lead roles. The story showed three generations of two sisters whose lives revolve around music.
The show ended on 15 July 2016 and was replaced by Tere Bin.
plot:
The story is told by Devika Gaikwad, mother of Kalyani and Ketaki, two sisters who grew together and had the same passion for singing, faced many troubles, struggles, were repeatedly deceived in their personal lives and finally achieved immense success; but later had differences, misunderstandings which led their separation for a good 21 years.
In the last episode they reconcile forgetting the differences and the show ends on a good note.

title: MTV Girls on Top
summary:
MTV Girls on Top is an Indian Hindi Romance television series. It premiered on 7 March 2016. It was broadcast on MTV India and produced by BBC Worldwide Productions, airing Monday to Thursday nights. The final episode was broadcast on 29 September 2016.
The series highlighted challenges and issues women face in India. The three leading women navigate careers, love, and their responsibilities.
plot: The show follows the lives of three young women living together in Mumbai as they look to further their careers: Isha (a young TV producer), Gia (an aspiring broadcast journalist), and Revati (a DJ hoping to win an international DJ competition in Amsterdam). It showcases the various challenges they face while trying to elevate their careers, including their love lives, responsibilities and friendship.
editedBy: Praveen Vishwakarma, Vinay Mandal, Sundip Singh

plotHtml: The show follows the lives of three young women living together in Mumbai as they look to further their careers: Isha (a young TV producer), Gia (an aspiring broadcast journalist), and Revati (a DJ hoping to win an international DJ competition in Amsterdam). title: Mera Yaar Miladay
summary:
Mera Yaar Miladay (Urdu: میرا یار ملادے) is a 2016 romantic Pakistani television series aired on ARY Digital. It stars Sajal Ali, Faysal Qureshi and Ahmed Ali Akbar in pivot roles. Produced by Fahad Mustafa and Ali Kazmi under Big Bang Entertainment, it was directed by Anjum Shahzad.
The show received lukewarm response owing to low viewership.

title: Meri Saasu Maa
summary:
Meri Saasu Maa (English: My Mother-In-Law) is a 2016 family television drama that aired on Indian television channel Zee TV. Hiba Nawab played a lead role in the series. It replaced Qubool Hai in its timeslot. It was then replaced by Sanyukt.
The series follows lead character Pari Sinha, who grew up without motherly love and seeks to establish a loving relationship with in her mother-in-law. As a newlywed, Pari finds it difficult to adjust to living with her in-laws.
plot:
The story opens at the Shinha household with preparations for Pari's wedding. Her miserly aunt, who raised her without affection, refuses to spend money on it and Pari is doing much of the work, including restarting the house's generator. The baraat (groom's wedding procession) arrives, and Pari is reprimanded by her aunt for not being ready. As Pari goes to dress, she spies upon the baraat and sees the groom's mother – and imagines receiving the motherly love she always wanted. However, Pari overhears the groom and his mother talking to his lover in the rickshaw, saying that the marriage is a sham. The aunt rushes a horrified Pari to the ceremony, where Pari confronts them with what she witnessed; they deny it and leave, feigning insult, and Pari is blamed.
The next day at the Sharma household, celebrity and family matriarch Bhawna Devi chases down her granddaughter Suman for wearing Western clothes and riding on a motorcycle with a boy. She reprimands the women of the house for the way Suman was raised, which taints her reputation, and threatens Suman and her mother – who thinks Devi can only be calmed by her favourite son Sattu. Sattu is then shown devotedly praying in a temple, asking blessings for his mother. As he descends the temple stairs, he bumps into Pari. The diyas (oil lamps) set fire to her dupatta (scarf) and then all the hangings around them. Sattu jumps into the fire surrounding a frightened Pari.

articleSections.title: Arc two
articleSections.text: Sattu dies in a car accident. The plot makes a six-year leap and sees Pari and Maasaab in a house with Bunty Singh Chauhan, whom she later marries, and Bhavna living happily.

title: Mastaangi
summary: Mastaangi (English: Playfulness) is an Indian television series that premiered on Channel V India on 18 January 2016. The show is about a couple whose love story comes to a tragic end with both of them having untimely deaths. They meet again in a new life only to uncover the mystery of their past life and rekindle their love.

articleSections.text:
In 1995 a young couple named Kabir, a RAW agent, and Udita (taken name), an ISI agent, meet mysterious deaths in Pune.
They meet each other 21 years after that incident, certainly through reincarnation and named Karan and Ria. Ria has irregular heartbeat and often has mysterious nightmares about her previous life. They study in St. Stephen's college, Pune. Individually and in many instances when one comes face to face with the other, they recall their past life incidents. Anushka, another RAW agent and partner of Kabir in a mission that year has also taken a rebirth and is named Anaita. Anushka had crush on Kabir. She was involved in their tragic deaths. Anaita, who is now Ria's best friend, studies in the same college. "Operation Tabahi" mastermind ISI Commander Zuber, too, was connected with their past life.
Zuber, under the name Ishaan, lives in Pune as an industrialist just to fulfill that unaccomplished operation. Coincidentally, he is one of the members of board of trustees of St. Stephen's college and his son Yuvraj (given name) studies in that college. Ria's father is a psychiatrist who tries to figure out Ria's disease. Anaita stays in Ria's house in Pune. Karan lives in Pune with his brother and sister-in-law. His brother works in a newspaper agency. During a mask party at college when Euro tries to harass Ria, Karqn starts beating him but stops immediately when Ria refers to him as "Kabir". After the incident, Ria and Anaita become friends with Karan. Su, Vanessa, Jiggs and Trumpet are also their friends. Zuber plots to restart Mission Tabahi to destroy India.
Anaita gets attracted to Karan and as a result of her obsession, develops hatred towards Ria, whom Karan is attracted to. Anaita feels that Ria is framing herself to be innocent and kind while portraying her as the bad one. The friendship of the two are spoiled not due to any of Ria's doings but Anushka's hatred towards Udita in the past life.
In the end, they all get to know about Zuber's plans. Anaita helps Karan and Ria. Veer Singh helps them to discover their past lives. Anushka killed Kabir and Udita. Eventually, they come together to fight Zuber and Yuvraj is killed. Finally, everyone is saved and Anaita and Veer confess their feelings for each other. Jiggs and Su also unite. Karan and Ria re-unite and lived happily ever after.

title: MTV Love School
summary:
MTV Love School is an Indian reality television series that premiered on 5 December 2015 on MTV India.
The first season was hosted by Upen Patel and Karishma Tanna, and the subsequent seasons were hosted by Karan Kundra and Anusha Dandekar. The series focuses on the relationships of real-life couples.
Love School Season 4 was the first Indian reality TV show to have a Gay couple featured.

title: Milon Tithi
summary: Milon Tithi (Bengali: মিলন তিথি) is an Indian Bengali language television soap that premiered on 23 November 2015 on Star Jalsha. The story primarily revolves around Aditya, Arjun, Ahona and Bonhi. It was produced by Acropoliis Entertainment Pvt. Ltd. and starred Riju Biswas, Ushasi Ray, Jeetu Kamal, Debjani Chakraborty and Ishaan Majumder in the lead roles. The show was replaced by Pratidaan.
plot: Milon Tithi revolves around a male and two female characters: Arjun, Ahona and Bonhi. Arjun is a rich, young man who liked Bonhi, yet married Ahona. Ahona is the daughter of a house owner and Bonhi is the daughter of a maid servant. Arjun always kept Bonhi happy, even with all her greedy needs. Ahona sees Bonhi as her best friend, but Bonhi dislikes Ahona and uses Arjun and separates him from Ahona. The story ends with Arjun and Ahona's separation.

articleSections.title: Three-year leap
articleSections.text: After three years everyone thinks Ahona is dead and that Bonhi killed Ahona's parents. Ahona vows revenge on Bonhi. Ahona has a son named Chiku, but he's actually Bonhi's son. A new man enters Ahona's life named Aditya. Aditya loves Ahona, yet Arjun still loves Ahona. He draws Ahona a painting every day. Bonhi has now become the owner of Mallick's villa. She is making the Mallick villa a living hell. Ahona ( Meera) buys the Mallick villa and returns the property papers to her father. Later, Bonhi and Mrinal get arrested and Bonhi and Mrinal confess all their crimes. Bonhi gets out of jail but Mrinal is sentenced to jail for seven years.

articleSections.title: Three-month leap
articleSections.text: After a few days, Ahona and Aditya marry and Bonhi's father appears. Ahona reunited Bonhi's father and mother. Later after many twists Bohni and Arjun get married forcibly by Ahona. There was a big conspiracy against Ahona and Aditya. The conspiracy is plotted by none other than Arjun. Later Arjun kidnaps Aditya on the day of his and Ahona's wedding but Bonhi gets to know that Arjun is the one who kidnapped Aditya. Later Ahona rescues Aditya from Arjun. Then Bonhi tells Ahona Arjun is behind all the kidnapping and everything else. Then, Ahona Aditya and Arjun Bonhi goes for honeymoon. There is a big conspiracy to kill Aditya plotted by Arjun. Ahona saves Aditya many times from Arjun. Later she gets to know everything is being plotted by Arjun. Later Bonhi in Ahona's avatar pushes Arjun from a cliff. But Arjun thinks it was Bonhi. She took Ahona's avatar so Ahona receives the entire blame.

articleSections.title: One-year leap
articleSections.text: Later Ahona aka Bonhi pushes Arjun over a cliff. But everyone thinks Ahona was the one who pushed Arjun from the cliff. Leaving everyone to think that Arjun had died one year ago. One year later, Chiku is four years old. Arjun comes back and pretends to be Jishnu who got lost many years ago by falling from a cliff. Arjun goes to Malick's house to take revenge on Ahona as Jishnu. Later it was revealed that it was not Ahona who pushed Arjun from a cliff actually it was Bonhi. She was the one who pushed Arjun from the cliff, in order to obtain all the property of Arjun. Later she joins hands with Jishnu ( Arjun) to ruin Aditya and Ahona's life. Later Mrinal comes back to seek revenge from Ahona. Bonhi calls Ahona and fakes that Rahul has kidnapped her and tells Ahona to come to a temple to rescue her. It turns out to be a fake kidnapping to trap Ahona in their evil plans. They will try to kill Ahona. Bonhi's true colors are revealed and she and Arjun are jailed for few months.

articleSections.title: Six months leap
articleSections.text: Everything is normal in the Mallick house. Bonhi writes a letter to Ahona that she will never come back in her life to trouble her. The show ends on a happy note on Chiku's sixth birthday.

summary:

title: Maan
summary:
Maan (Urdu: مان ; lit. Proud) is a Pakistani family drama series that premiered on Hum TV on 19 October 2015, airing a weekly episode on Mondays. Due to the drama serial Mann Mayal, Maan aired on Fridays instead of Mondays from 29 January 2016. It is directed by Amin Iqbal and written by Shehla Shakoor. This drama serial is produced by Abdullah Kadwani and Asad Qureshi of 7th Sky Productions and Mikaal Zulfiqar who also served as the head of the project and Hira Anwar of Hum TV.
Meekal Zulfiqar and Kiran Haq star as parents of two girls and the younger girl has a heart problem. They are facing financial problems and can't afford surgery for their younger girl, which leads their family to destruction. Maha Warsi portrays a villainous role while Seemi Raheel stars as the mother of Zulfiqar and Saleem Sheikh as his brother.
plot: 'Maan' revolves around the story of a married couple, Imaan (Mikaal Zulfiqar) and Wafa (Kiran Haq). They have two daughters lead happy lives. Things become difficult when their younger daughter is diagnosed with heart disease and they don't have the 6 million rupees needed for her treatment. In this condition, Imaan is forced to join a job that Maya (Maha Warsi), his first love, offers him. Maya asks Imaan for his hand in marriage and he accepts on the condition that she will pay for his younger daughter, Hania's treatment. His life changes as he has two wives and is left in a tiff as he has to care for both. His first wife eventually finds out of his betrayal and stops talking to him. He tries his best to explain but she is not ready to listen. Meanwhile, their younger daughter dies under the stress of her father's absence who swore he would return home but was unable to due to a meeting. During her funeral, Maya and Imaan go to the house to see Hania. Wafa, in a rage of anger yells at them that Hania's death was all caused by Imaan. She explains that her daughter waited and waited but her father didn't come home. After getting told to leave by his mum, Imaan and Maya return to the house unhappily. Maya plans to go on holiday to make Imaan happy but he is sad and feels guilty due to the words of Wafa. The drama explores their love for each other and the misunderstandings that caused a divide between them. In the end love triumphs, Maya gets her punishment and Imaan and Wafa live happily ever after.

title: MTV Big F
summary: MTV Big F is a television anthology series broadcast by MTV India. It premiered on 11 October 2015, every Sunday. The show brings Gautam Gulati as host and deals with young people's forbidden fantasies  by showcasing stories of young people in each episode. The second season was hosted by Bollywood actor Randeep Hooda which primarily revolves around the psyche of Indian women to explore their hidden desires.

articleSections.title: Host
articleSections.text: Gautam Gulati – season 1 (13 episodes) * Randeep Hooda – season 2 (13 episodes)

episodesList.title: Fantasy and Rebellion
episodesList.summary: Shruti's marriage is arranged with Mohit, whom she barely knows. Shruti(Priyal Gor) loves Vikram(Abhinav Shukla) but she never dares to reveal it to Mohit. Mohit's inappropriate behavior gives Shruti the power to rebel.

episodesList.title: Love Just Happens
episodesList.summary: Gyan(Rohit Saraf) works in an advertising agency where he meets Raima(Megha Gupta), a woman few years older. He finds his colleagues belittling Raima but when he starts to get to know her, falls in love with her.

episodesList.title: Being Fat isn't a Shame
episodesList.summary: Rajji(Tavneet Rekhi) is a chubby young girl and her slim friends make fun of her. She falls in love with a tennis player, Abhimanyu(Ruslaan Mumtaz) who also happens to fall for her. Abhimanyu makes her realize her true worth.

episodesList.title: Business Meets Pleasure
episodesList.summary: Sagar and Ahana are two people who meet by chance and get intimate as they are attracted. They give in to their desires without caring for the world [11]

episodesList.title: Private Tutor
episodesList.summary: Anjali(Plabita Borthakur), a small town girl comes to Mumbai to chase her dreams of becoming a singer. She meets Arjun, who helps her regain the confidence.

episodesList.title: Girl's Love
episodesList.summary: Sharmishta(Asma Badar) is a lesbian who has not been able to express her desires. She and her best friend Riteish(Aditya Singh Rajput) both fall in love with a model named Madhurima(Madhura Naik).

episodesList.title: Pati, Patni aur Pilot.
episodesList.summary: Sakshi(Neetha Shetty)is married to Pranav who never cares about her. Finally Varun(Rohit Khandelwal), a pilot makes Sakshi realize the importance of being a woman.

episodesList.title: The Unforgetable Coincidence
episodesList.summary: Aman and Maya get to know about each other on a social media platform with pseudo names. However, they coincidently meet each other and fall in love. Later, they share intimate moments with each other.[15]

episodesList.title: Love is Fair
episodesList.summary: Jia(Krishna Mukherjee) wants to enjoy her life like everyone but she is a handicap. She meets Maan(Shravan Reddy), who starts taking care of her and boosts her confidence. Gradually, Maan's love succeeds to make Jia stand up on her feet.

episodesList.title: Virtuous Love
episodesList.summary: A young virtuous man, Pawan happens to meet a super model, Carol who doesn't seem to win his confidence at first. But as Pawan spends more time with her, he ends up falling in love with her.

episodesList.title: Rebelling Against The Odds
episodesList.summary: Nakul has a soft corner for his deceased brother's wife, Jaya(Abigail Jain) . Eventually their attachment makes them fall in love. Their love gives Jaya the confidence to stand up for herself.

episodesList.title: Beauty lies in the eyes of the beholder
episodesList.summary: Armaan falls in love with his landlord's daughter Ishita who is under-confident because of a scar on her face. But Armaan helps her discover her true beauty.

episodesList.title: The Last Chapter
episodesList.summary: KD suffers from a stammering problem and is in love with Sameera, a beauty queen. Soon he realizes that Sameera too doesn't have an exciting life. Together they come out of their shells.

episodesList.title: Forbidden No More
episodesList.summary: Rashi(Cherry Mardia) takes up the challenge thrown at her by her misogynist fiancé, Akshay(Mrinal Dutt) as well as the society which always seems ready to label women as either the virtuous or the vamp. She finds herself questioning her values as she meets Terry(Shantanu Maheshwari), the lady-killer and a choreographer.

episodesList.title: Dil ye Ziddi hai
episodesList.summary: In a society that has set norms for the fairer sex, Dhapan(Mansi Srivastava) dares to break the shackles of age-old customs and traditions to follow her dreams. title: Mohi – Ek Khwab Ke Khilne Ki Kahani
wikiTitle: Mohi – Ek Khwab Ke Khilne Ki Kahani
summary: Mohi – Ek Khwab Ke Khilne Ki Kahani is an Indian television series which premiered from 10 August 2015 on Star Plus. The series is the Hindi remake of Star Jalsha's series Ishti Kutum. The show stars Vinita Joshi and Karan Sharma. The show went off air on 27 February 2016.
plot: The story of the show is about a young tribal girl named Mohi. Ayush is forced to marry Mohi during his visit to her remote village. After, life takes a sharp turn for Mohi when she comes to the big city. Ayush introduces her as the maidservant to the family as his family, unaware of his wedding to Mohi, continue planning his wedding with his girlfriend.
reception: 4 Lions Films producer Gul Khan remade the series again as Imlie in 2020 for StarPlus stating, "I know you have heard and seen this before, many times, but we’ll play it more real." While Mohi could not garner good viewership, Imlie airing in a prime slot 8:30 pm became one of the top viewed Hindi GEC.
