title: Miley Jab Hum Tum
summary: Miley Jab Hum Tum (transl. When You and I Met) is an Indian Hindi-language teen drama television series that aired on Star One from 22 September 2008 to 19 November 2010. It is digitally available on Disney+ Hotstar. Produced by Sudhir Sharma and Seema Sharma under Endemol India Sunshine Productions, the series depicts themes of falling in love during college and building lifelong relationships. It starred Mohit Sehgal, Sanaya Irani, Rati Pandey, and Arjun Bijlani.
plot:
The story begins at Excel College, introducing basketball champion Samrat Shergill (Mohit Sehgal), college diva Dia Bhushan (Navina Bole), their friends Benji Swami (Abhishek Sharma) and Uday Bhushan (Jaskaran Gandhi), studious sisters Nupur Bhushan (Rati Pandey) and Gunjan Bhushan (Sanaya Irani), and academically inclined Mayank Sharma (Arjun Bijlani). Nupur is fashion-conscious and carefree, while Gunjan is introverted, responsible, and focused on her studies. Initially, the sisters face competition from their cousin Dia, who is jealous of them, but they eventually become close. Nupur and Mayank frequently argue, but over time they fall in love and get married. Gunjan and Samrat develop a friendship that leads to romance, and later on get engaged.
Mayank and Nupur later decide to move to the United States. On their way to the airport with Gunjan and Samrat, the group is involved in a serious accident.

articleSections.title: Three years later
articleSections.text: In the aftermath of the accident, the group is separated, Nupur is presumed dead, and Samrat js blamed for the accident. Mayank is devastated. Samrat and Gunjan end their engagement and part ways. It is later revealed that Nupur's obsessive admirer, Dhruv Verma (Rohit Khurana), was responsible for the accident, and that Nupur is alive. After Dhruv is brought to justice, Nupur reunites with Mayank. The series concludes with Samrat and Gunjan getting married, and Mayank and Nupur becoming parents to twin boys.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Miley Jab Hum Tum was produced under Endemol India and Sunshine Productions by Sudhir Sharma and Seema Sharma. The series narrates the story of two sisters, their move to a metropolitan city, their experiences of falling in love during college, and the development of lifelong relationships.
In 2010, the series took a three-year leap, following which new characters were introduced. Producer Sudhir Sharma stated, "We've done almost 400 episodes and now I feel that we need to revamp it to bring back the enthusiasm we had when we first started. We want the youth to be able to connect with the show. I wouldn't say that the audience is bored, but as a precaution, it's better if we give them something fresh."

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Rati Pandey and Sanaya Irani were cast as the lead sisters, Nupur and Gunjan, respectively. Arjun Bijlani and Mohit Sehgal were cast opposite them as the male leads, Mayank and Samrat. The role of Samrat marked Sehgal's acting debut. Rohit Khurana was cast in a cameo role as Dhruv, Nupur's obsessive admirer.
In 2010, Pandey exited the series following her character's on-screen death before the leap. She rejoined the cast a few months later, after the TRP ratings declined in her absence.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The series is primarily set in Mumbai. Some portions depicting Excel College were filmed at Sophia College for Women, Mumbai. Additional scenes were shot at Kanjurmarg.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text:
Miley Jab Hum Tum is regarded as one of the most popular youth and college dramas. It received positive reviews from both critics and audiences. Raya Mehnaz of The Daily Star observed that the series became a fan favourite due to its "college setting and engaging storylines," adding that the show, "while adhering to the western tropes common in coming-of-age stories set in college, also subverted these tropes in uncommon ways."
The Times of India included Rati Pandey and Arjun Bijlani in its list of "Evergreen Romantic Couples," noting that Nupur and Mayank's compelling on-screen chemistry elevated the show to new heights.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text: Miley Jab Hum Tum was the number one show on Star One between 2008 and 2009, frequently topping the TRP charts.

episodesList.title: Dia Joins Excel College
episodesList.summary: Dia joins Excel college and everyone admires her. She likes Samrat, but is upset he ignores her. Later, Samrat talks about the girl of his dreams. Meanwhile,  Gunjan and Nupur decide to leave for Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Mayank Joins Excel College
episodesList.summary: Mayank joins Excel college and meets Samrat. Meanwhile, Gunjan and Nupur reach Mumbai. Samrat, Dia and Uday want to welcome Nupur and Gunjan. They plan a party for them. Mayank learns about the party and makes plans.

episodesList.title: Gunjan Falls Into the Pool
episodesList.summary: Nupur and Gunjan are not comfortable at the party. Nupur is told to dance but everyone laughs at her. Meanwhile, Gunjan is blindfolded and falls into the swimming pool. Nupur starts screaming and tells everyone that Gunjan doesn’t know how to swim. Will Gunjan survive?

episodesList.title: Nupur Gets Locked Up
episodesList.summary: On Nupur and Gunjan’s first day in college, they are subjected to ragging by Uday and Dia, who want them to leave the college. They play a prank on Gunjan when she enters the library. Meanwhile, Nupur is locked in the men’s washroom.

episodesList.title: Mayank Saves Nupur
episodesList.summary: Mayank saves Nupur from the men's washroom. Later, Nupur and Gunjan receive punishment from the professors for not paying attention. Mayank and Nupur are expected to work in a project together. Later, Nupur seeks Dia's help to stand out in the college without being ragged.

episodesList.title: Nupur 'S Fashion Disaster
episodesList.summary: Nupur becomes a laughing stock at college after Dia dresses her up. Later, she tries to bunk class but gets caught. Meanwhile, As Gunjan answers all the answers in the class, the professor takes her to the principle. She comes across Nupur as well.

episodesList.title: Gunjan , a Brilliant Student
episodesList.summary: The principal declares Gunjan as the brilliant student, while he punishes Nupur. Gunjan advises Nupur to concentrate on studies. Later, Mayank helps Gunjan at the library. Diya tries to help Nupur change her talking style. Samrat tries to disturb Gunjan , but she ignores him.

episodesList.title: Nupur's Naive Nature
episodesList.summary: Mayank keeps calling out for Nupur regarding the project, leaving Uday miserable as his plans to fool her fails. Everyone at college takes advantage of Nupur for her naive nature. Mayank and Nupur worry about their project. Gunjan and Samrat are paired in a psychology game.

episodesList.title: Nupur Taunts Mayank
episodesList.summary: Mayank overhears Nupur taunting him. On his insistence, Nupur takes the responsibility to research for the project. Samrat finds Gunjan in the cafeteria and tries to apologize to her. Later, Gunjan sees Nupur struggling about the project and decides to help her. Dia learns about Uday's party.

episodesList.title: Dia Insults Samrat
episodesList.summary: Nupur is annoyed as Mayank instructs her to watch a documentary film related to their project. Samrat calls for Uday, and talks to Gunjan. Dia learns about the party and takes Gunjan with her. Gunjan feels upset as Dia insults Samrat at the pub.

episodesList.title: Samrat Drops Gunjan Home
episodesList.summary: Gunjan worries as Dia left her alone at the party. Samrat consoles her and decides to drop her home. Later, Gunjan consoles her as Nupur worries about the project. She prepares Nupur's project. Mayank and Nupur submit their project report.

episodesList.title: Mayank Is Impressed With Nupur
episodesList.summary: Mayank is impressed as Nupur submits the project. Nupur thanks Gunjan for her help. Samrat blindfolds himself to sing and apologize to Dia. However, Gunjan takes Dia's place. Mayank apologizes to Nupur for underestimating her. A talent parade competition is announced. Dia plans to insult Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Auditions for Talent Parade
episodesList.summary: Nupur is excited for the talent parade competition. Dia informs Nupur about the auditions and asks her to convince Mayank to be her partner. Samrat asks Gunjan to be his partner for the competition.

episodesList.title: Nupur and Mayank Dance
episodesList.summary: Samrat irritates Gunjan with his pranks. Meanwhile, Nupur tries her best to convince Mayank. Dia is upset as Mayank agrees to take part the competition with Nupur. Mayank and Nupur perform the dance, leaving everyone stunned.

episodesList.title: Samrat Requests Gunjan to Sing
episodesList.summary: Nupur gets delighted when Samrat informs her that she got selected for the competition.  Samrat is surprised to hear Gunjan sing. He requests Gunjan to participate in the competition.  Samrat becomes upset when Gunjan refuses to take part in the competition.

episodesList.title: Mayank Scolds Nupur
episodesList.summary: Mayank scolds Nupur for not preparing the project. Nupur decides to participate alone. Samrat convinces Gunjan to participate in the audition. Gunjan is upset as she doesn't get through the auditions. Samrat decides to request Dia to give Gunjan another chance for the auditions.

episodesList.title: Mayank Loves Nupur
episodesList.summary: Samrat requests Dia to let Gunjan sing again. Mayank tells Shilpa about his feelings for Nupur. Gunjan prepares Nupur’s notes, which makes her happy. Meanwhile, Samrat tells Nupur to convince Gunjan to give a singing audition. Will Gunjan agree to sing?

episodesList.title: Miss Aha Listens to Gunjan’s Song
episodesList.summary: Dia prepares the final list but refuses to add Gunjan’s name to it. Samrat wants Miss Aha to take Gunjan in but she refuses. Later, Miss Aha listens to a recording of Gunjan's song and is bowled over. Mayank and Nupur practice dance for the competition.

episodesList.title: Gunjan Is Upset With Nupur
episodesList.summary: Nupur wants to tell the truth to Mayank about the project. Meanwhile, Benji does not understand why Samrat wants Gunjan to sing. Gunjan is annoyed with Nupur but later, they sort out their differences. Nupur feels sad as she misses Morena. Will Mayank comfort her?

episodesList.title: Samrat in Gunjan's Room
episodesList.summary: Mayank's mother taunts him about his date with Nupur. Uday helps Samrat, to climb up to Gunjan's room. Gunjan screams as she sees Samrat in the room. Dia and Nupur issist Uday to break open Gunjan's door. Later, Dia notices the ladder and suspects someone in her room. She searches Gunjan's room.

episodesList.title: Valentine's Day Special
episodesList.summary: Dia is suspicious when she learns that someone visited Gunjan’s room. However, Uday handles the matter. Samrat and Gunjan celebrate their Valentine's day with each other and when he asks her to sing,she hesitates. Mayank and Nupur discuss about the project over the phone. Later, Dia questions Uday about Samrat's presence outside their house and he lies to her.

episodesList.title: Mayank Appreciates Nupur
episodesList.summary: Gunjan prepares Nupur's project. Mayank appreciates Nupur for her efforts and informs her that Shilpa wants to meet her. Samrat succeeds in convincing Gunjan to sing. Later, Mayank and Gunjan meet at the library and later he sees Nupur's project file.

episodesList.title: Samrat and Nupur Team Up
episodesList.summary: Mayank asks Gunjan about Nupur's project file. Meanwhile, Samrat tries to learn Gunjan's fear to sing. Later, Mayank taunts Nupur about the project file. Samrat invites Gunjan for the Diwali party and puja. Later, Samrat and Nupur team up to convince Gunjan and Mayank to attend the party.

episodesList.title: Nupur Meets Mayank's Mother
episodesList.summary: Nupur and Gunjan decorate their house on the occasion of diwali. They call their father on Diwali and wish him. Later, Nupur goes to Mayank’s house to celebrate Diwali and Gunjan visits Samrat’s house to perform the Diwali rituals.

episodesList.title: Gunjan Prepares for Diwali
episodesList.summary: Samrat wants Gunjan to prepare for the Diwali party and asks her to make rangoli. She convinces him to wear traditional clothes. Meanwhile, Mayank’s mother passes a remark at Nupur that upsets her.  Samrat dresses up in a traditional attire and surprises everyone at the party.

episodesList.title: Nupur Convinces Mayank
episodesList.summary: Dia is shocked to see Gunjan at Samrat's party. Samrat reminds Dia about their bet over Gunjan. Nupur convinces Mayank to accompany her to Samrat's party. She gets jealous the girls at the party stare at Mayank. Dia insists Gunjan to sing at the Diwali party.

episodesList.title: Gunjan Agrees to Sing
episodesList.summary: Gunjan fails to overcome her fear. However, everyone dances at the party. Later, Nupur and Gunjan share their happiness with each other. Uday manages Dia about Samrat's surprise. Gunjan starts feeling for Samrat. Mayank's mother is impressed with Nupur. Gunjan agrees to sing in the competition.

episodesList.title: Mayank Doubts Nupur
episodesList.summary: Mayank realises that Nupur’s personality does not match her project report and begins to doubt whether she wrote it. Nupur, on the other hand, is worried about Mayank’s reaction when he comes to know that it was Gunjan who wrote the report.

episodesList.title: Samrat Buys a Tent!
episodesList.summary: Mayank questions Nupur and she tells him the report was Gunjan's work. This turns Mayank very angry and he scolds her for lying to him and starts avoiding her. Meanwhile, Samrat buys a tent for Gunjan. What will Gunjan do with the tent?

episodesList.title: Nupur Is Upset
episodesList.summary: Mayank is upset with Nupur and scolds her. Dia is very happy that Samrat is planning a surprise for her. However, she learns later that Samrat has no such plans. This makes her furious and she vows to teach a lesson to Samrat and Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Dia Scolds Uday
episodesList.summary: Dia is angry at Uday for making her look like a fool. Meanwhile, Nupur is worried that Mayank is not talking to her. Samrat encourages her saying Mayank is planning a surprise for her. Later, Samrat gets his turn to perform in the contest. Who will win?

episodesList.title: Annie Locks Gunjan in the Room
episodesList.summary: Mayank and Nupur perform together at the talent parade, where Gunjan agrees to sing. But before she can do so, Annie locks her inside a room. When Gunjan’s performance is announced, Samrat realises that she has not come on stage. Will Gunjan escape from the room?

episodesList.title: Gunjan Is Missing
episodesList.summary: Samrat announces Gunjan’s performance, but worries  when she fails to appear on stage. Unknown to him, she is stuck in a storeroom. Will she be able to escape the storeroom and reach the stage on time?

episodesList.title: Mayank Finds Nupur's Letter
episodesList.summary: Everyone appreciates Gunjan's performance. Nupur tries to make up with Mayank, but he calls her a liar. Gunjan thanks Samrat for boosting her confidence. Later, she tells Nupur that she suspects Annie. Dia congratulates the sisters. Mayank finds Nupur's letter.

episodesList.title: Gunjan Learns About Samrat's Bet
episodesList.summary: Uday overhears Annie and Dia's conversation. Everyone at college congratulate Nupur at college for her performance. The principal announces the exam schedule. Gunjan overhears Samrat and Benji's conversation about the bet over Gunjan. Samrat tries to justify himself.

episodesList.title: Gunjan Prepares Notes for Samrat
episodesList.summary: Nupur and Samrat discuss about the exam tension. Samrat goes to the library for Gunjan. Nupur asks Gunjan if anything is wrong. Later, when Mayank passes notes to Nupur, she refuses them, leading to an argument. Meanwhile, Gunjan is annoyed with Samrat for not studying. She gives him notes.

episodesList.title: Nupur and Mayank Argue
episodesList.summary: CJ advises Mayank to talk to Nupur directly. Later, Nupur refuses to take Mayank's notes for exam preparation. She challenges to score higher marks than Mayank. They both end up in a heated argument. Later, Samrat tries to tell Gunjan the truth about the bet with Dia.

episodesList.title: Nupur's Challenge for Mayank
episodesList.summary: Nupur prays to god to help her with the challenge. Mayank tells his mother about Nupur's challenge. Nupur get caught for sleeping in the class. The professor punishes Nupur to write a chapter 100 times. Samrat's friend tease him for studying. Later, Gunjan promises to help Samrat study.

episodesList.title: Uday Gifts a Recorder to Nupur
episodesList.summary: Dia asks Gunjan to help her with the exams. Later, she provokes her to not help Samrat. Uday gifts Nupur a voice recorder, which would help her prepare for exams. Samrat and Dia attend a party, where she mocks him in front of his friends. The next day, Samrat tries to apologize to Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Samrat's Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Shukla sir taunts Nupur in the class for not paying attention. Mayank taunts Nupur. Samrat worries about his image. Nupur notices everyone preparing chits for the exam. However, she recalls Mayank's words. Benji tries to fool Uday. Gunjan finds a solution for Samrat's problem.

episodesList.title: Mayank Taunts Nupur
episodesList.summary: When Nupur overhears Mayank talking to the librarian about a book, she issues the same book for herself. Gunjan helps Nupur in studying. Later, Samrat reaches the coffee shop late and Gunjan is upset. Mayank taunts Nupur in front of CJ.

episodesList.title: Nupur Surprises Mayank
episodesList.summary: Gunjan is upset with Samrat for not revising the notes she prepared for him. Nupur annoys Mayank by issuing the same books as him from the library. Uday requests 2 students to provide him with the question papers. Nupur surprises Mayank when answers the questions in the class.

episodesList.title: Samrat Tricks Dia
episodesList.summary: Samrat studies on his date as Benji keeps disturbing Dia. Dia finds the notes when Samrat drops her home. She gets angry and calls Uday and Annie to the cafe as Samrat and Gunjan planned to meet there. Gunjan is shocked to see Samrat arrive early and clarifies his doubts. They are shocked to see Dia

episodesList.title: Mayank Against Nupur
episodesList.summary: Nupur is selected for the Inter-college competition. However, Mayank feels that she is not the right choice. Nupur strikes a deal with him. Samrat lies to everyone about a basketball competition in order to skip his examinations. Nupur overhears Samrat and Uday's plan about tricking the principal.

episodesList.title: Mayank Is Disturbed
episodesList.summary: Gunjan tells Samrat that the principal is aware of his lies. Uday buys the question papers from his friends. The principal learns that Samrat has lied to him and instructs him to take the test. Meanwhile, Nupur worries about the exam preparations. Mayank is disturbed with Nupur's thoughts.

episodesList.title: Exam Preparation
episodesList.summary: Gunjan is ready to help Samrat in the terminal exams. Samrat assures her that he will manage in his exams. Dia gets tensed while preparing for exams. Nupur anyhow manages to prepare for her exams. Samrat finally decides to write his exams by cheating.

episodesList.title: Samrat Stands Up for Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Samrat prepares chits for exams. Gunjan boosts confidence to Nupur. Later, Dia taunts Gunjan for worrying about Samrat. During the examination, Benji passes a chit to Samrat, but Gunjan is caught by the professor. However, Samrat stands up for her and blames himself.

episodesList.title: Gunjan Defends Samrat
episodesList.summary: Samrat throws a paper to Gunjan warning her about the invigilator, who thinks Gunjan is cheating and sends her to the principal. Samrat follows her and admits it was he who passed the paper. Gunjan defends Samrat and the principal gives another chance to him.

episodesList.title: Dia Is Jealous of Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Dia gets jealous of Gunjan's friendship with Samrat. Gunjan requests Nupur to let her visit Samrat's house to help him prepare for the exams. Later, Nupur fumes at Mayank for taking her notes. Later, Mayank's mother praises Nupur for challenging Mayank.

episodesList.title: Dia Mocks Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Samrat tells Benji that he decided to reveal the truth to Gunjan about the chits. Dia overhears the conversation and mocks Gunjan . She tells Gunjan about Samrat's bet with her regarding the competition. Nupur and Mayank bump into each other. Later, Samrat is upset as Gunjan cries.

episodesList.title: Nupur Taunts Mayank
episodesList.summary: After the exam, Nupur tells Mayank that she will top the college. Professor asks Nupur for a help at the staff room and she learns that she got 91 in hindi exam. Gunjan ignores Samrat. Samrat gets depressed but later requests her to help him with exams.

episodesList.title: Dia Asks Samrat for a Date
episodesList.summary: Diya is angry when Gunjan agrees to teach Samrat for exams. Samrat questions Gunjan about the problem. Nupur and Gunjan prepare for their last exam. Samrat asks Gunjan on a date after the exams. Nupur is happy as the exams have finished. Samrat gets annoyed when Dia asks him to take her out.

episodesList.title: Gunjan Shocks Samrat
episodesList.summary: Samrat gets upset when Gunjan refuses to go on a date with him. Nupur and Samrat were called to the Prof Dheodhar's office. Gunjan reminds Samrat about his bet with Dia, leaving him shocked. Prof Dheodhar informs Nupur and Samrat about being selected for the inter-college competition.

episodesList.title: Mayank Consoles Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Mayank consoles Gunjan for being upset. Nupur questions Gunjan about why she is upset. Dia informs Samrat that she told Gunjan about the bet. She pretends to console him as a good friend. CJ refuses to be Mayank's partner for the competition. Later, Nupur scolds Samrat for troubling Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Benji Helps Samrat
episodesList.summary: Benji helps Samrat in his plans to impress Gunjan. Nupur learns about Samrat's bet and is furious. Dia invites Mayank to her New Year's party. Mayank decides to attend the party to taunt Nupur. Dia tells Gunjan that Samrat is invited for the party. Nupur consoles Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Dia's Boyfriend, Guru
episodesList.summary: At the party, Uday tries to impress the girls. Dia mocks Samrat. Mayank and Nupur argue about wearing the same color dress for the party. Dia's boyfriend, Guru surprises everyone at the party. Benji keeps an eye on Gunjan. Meanwhile, Samrat arrives at the party.

episodesList.title: Samrat Sings at the Party
episodesList.summary: Benji informs all the news to Samrat over the phone. Guru becomes a laughing stock as he falls off while dancing. Dia is embarrassed. Gunjan gets upset when Benji talks about Samrat. Ishika requests Nupur to introduce Mayank to her and she agrees . Gunjan leaves the party as Samrat sings.

episodesList.title: Mayank's New Partner, Ishika
episodesList.summary: Samrat gets upset when Gunjan calls him Selfish. Nupur tells Ishika to talk about Economics, to impress Mayank. Ishika agrees to be his debate partner for the competition. She asks Mayank to meet her at a spa as per Nupur's plan. Uday tries to impress a girl, but fails. Samrat asks Benji for help.

episodesList.title: Samrat's Plan to Apologize
episodesList.summary: Benji turns the lights off at the party for Samrat to apologize to Gunjan. However, Samrat apologizes to Nupur in the dark. As the clock ticks to 12, everyone wishes happy new year to each other. Meanwhile, Uday kisses Benji in the dark. Nupur tries to convince Gunjan about Samrat.

episodesList.title: Nupur Consoles Samrat
episodesList.summary: Gunjan doesn't listen to Nupur's advise about Samrat. Benji feels disgusted for Uday's kiss. Gunjan and Samrat are lost in each others thoughts. Gunjan requests Samrat to stay away from her. Later, Nupur tries to console Samrat at college. Samrat apologizes to Gunjan at the college canteen.

episodesList.title: Nupur to Unite Samrat, Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Mayank wants to convince Ishika and Dia wants to make Samrat jealous. Meanwhile, Nupur promises Samrat to reconcile the differences between Gunjan and Samrat. Later, Nupur finds Mayank in the ladies' parlour. What will she do?

episodesList.title: Nupur and Mayank Fight
episodesList.summary: When Mayank goes to the ladies parlour by mistake, his mother sees him there. Nupur and Mayank start fighting in front of everyone. Later, Nupur tells Gunjan that she should forgive Samrat. Will Gunjan reconcile her differences with Samrat?

episodesList.title: Mayank Accuses Nupur
episodesList.summary: Benji asks Samrat about the reason for his happiness. CJ informs Mayank that the college results are leaked. The college students congratulate Gunjan Prof Dheodhar tells Mayank and Nupur to represent excel college for the academic meet. Mayank accuses Nupur for embarrassing him.

episodesList.title: Mayank and Nupur Prepare to Leave
episodesList.summary: Uday shares his dream about CJ with Benji and Samrat. Mayank promises to make the trip memorable for Nupur and Samrat assures her he will take care of Gunjan. Later, Prof Shukla and the principal inform Gunjan that she has been selected for the RJ hunt. Samrat wants to speak to Gunjan. Will Gunjan talk to him?

episodesList.title: Chironju Irritates Nupur- Mayank
episodesList.summary: Nupur bumps into Chironji and he irritates her. Mayank taunts Nupur in the bus. They travel together to Ahmedabad. Gunjan get nervous when she sees other participants at the RJ hunt auditions. She meets Purab there. Later, Chironji exchanges places with Nupur and irritates Mayank in the bus.

episodesList.title: Nupur's Misses Her Bus
episodesList.summary: Mayank scares Nupur in the bus. Later, Nupur and Chironji irritate Mayank. The bus halts for lunch, and Nupur gets engrossed in reading a magazine at the shop. Samrat tries to convince Gunjan to forgive him. She left behind, as the bus leaves. However, Mayank gets off the bus too.

episodesList.title: Samrat and Purab Meet
episodesList.summary: Gunjan worries about the RJ hunt competition and misses Nupur. Mayank and Nupur walk through the jungle. Diya discusses about organizing a Valentine ball for the college students. Dia pretends to be a good friend with Samrat. Samrat learns from Purab about competing against Gunjan. Nupur finds Mayank.

episodesList.title: Mayank Collects the Wood
episodesList.summary: Gunjan prepares herself for the RJ hunt competition. Samrat makes Benji change his voice to call Gunjan. They try to boost her confidence. Mayank gets fed up with Nupur in the jungle. CJ ridicules Uday when he tries talking to her. Mayank collects wood for campfire and argues with Nupur.

episodesList.title: Uday Asks CJ for the Ball
episodesList.summary: Mayank uses Nupur's magazine to lit fire to the food , leaving her angry. Uday asks CJ to accompany him to the Valentines ball in front of everyone. Mayank finds a papaya and shares it with Nupur. Gunjan talks to the basketball given by Samrat. Mayank and Nupur fight for water bottle.

episodesList.title: Dia Announces a Twist
episodesList.summary: Mayank and Nupur are struck in the jungle. Purab and Samrat discuss about Rj hunt auditions. Mayank tries to get even with Nupur and disturbs her sleep. Dia announces a twist for the valentines ball. Benji promises to help Uday. Nupur and Mayank find a road out of the jungle. Nupur taunts Mayank.

episodesList.title: Purab Boosts Gunjan's Confidence
episodesList.summary: Mayank gets negative vibes about the lodge. Aparajita makes Gunjan nervous but Purab boosts her confidence. Samrat appreciates Dia for her efforts. Later, Nupur understands the Lodge's true nature. Benji informs Samrat that Gunjan read the card sent by him. Mayank and Nupur share a moment.

episodesList.title: RJ Hunt Auditions Begin
episodesList.summary: The Rj hunt auditions begin. Aparijita and Purab give their individual speeches. Nupur scolds the Lodge owner for not waking them up on time. She and Mayank try to ask people for lift on the highway. Later, Purab assures Gunjan to give her best. Samrat looks at Gunjan giving her speech.

episodesList.title: Gunjan Wins First Place
episodesList.summary: Nupur and Mayank take shelter at a village. Gunjan wins the first round of the audition. The principal announces about the 2nd round of Live radio show. Uday takes CJ on a date. Aparajita taunts Gunjan. However, Purab snubs her and supports Gunjan. Nupur and Mayank argue over an alcohol bottle.

episodesList.title: Nupur Gets Drunk
episodesList.summary: Samrat gifts a phone to Gunjan. Uday impresses Cj at the dinner date. Samrat makes Benji call Gunjan to ask her to accept the phone. Gunjan refuses to accept the gift until he meets her as wants to know the admirer. Nupur gets drunk and dances in the restaurant.

episodesList.title: Nupur Asks Mayank to Marry Her
episodesList.summary: Nupur and Mayank take shelter in a hut. Gunjan recalls the moments spent wit Samrat and talks to the basketball. Dia orders everyone to decorate the college. Nupur misunderstands the situation and asks Mayank to marry her. Principal asks Dia to select a song for Nupur to dance.

episodesList.title: Samrat to Teach Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Mayank and Nupur are stuck in the hut and end up fighting. Meanwhile, the principal tells Gunjan that she has to perform a dance on Valentine's Day. Samrat teaches her and asks for her forgiveness. Will Gunjan forgive him?

episodesList.title: Samrat Teaches Dance to Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Samrat teaches dance to Gunjan and assures to be her dance teacher. Meanwhile, Nupur and Mayank fake their relationship to get a lift from a stranger. Samrat reminds Gunjan about her promise made to the principal.

episodesList.title: Samrat Dances With Dia
episodesList.summary: Samrat tries to boost up self confidence for Gunjan. Uday gifts a bouquet to Benji, leaving him shocked. Dia feels jealous to see Samrat and Gunjan together. She mocks Gunjan for her dance. Samrat dances with Dia to show it to Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Gunjan to Meet Her Secret Admirer
episodesList.summary: Gunjan wishes to meet her secret admirer. Meanwhile, Chunky locks Nupur and Mayur in his house to spend the valentines night. Benji calls Gunjan and she requests him to meet her. Nupur and Mayank fight with each other at Chunky's house. Uday is upset as he doesnt have a partner for the dance.

episodesList.title: Samrat Gives a Rose to Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Dia doesn't let any girl wish Samrat on Valentines day. Nupur and Mayank fight while preparing food. Gunjan accepts Samrat's rose. Mayank is flattered by Nupur's beauty and they both decide to stay as good friends. Gunjan waits for her secret admirer at the ball.

episodesList.title: Gunjan Waits for the Admirer
episodesList.summary: Nupur disturbs Mayank. Mayank's thoughts are filled with Nupur and he worries for developing feelings for her. Uday waits for CJ for the dance, While Gunjan eagerly waits for her secret admirer. A random girl knocks Chunky's house door and requests for help as a mob chases her.

episodesList.title: Nupur Acts as Mayank's Wife
episodesList.summary: Mayank and Nupur want to send the mob away. They tell the mob that they are husband and wife. The mob believes them and goes away. Purab introduces Vidushi to Gunjan. Meanwhile, Diya plans a game on Valentine’s day. She wishes Samrat to be her partner. Who will Samrat choose as his partner?

episodesList.title: Samrat Wants Gunjan to Win
episodesList.summary: Mayank and Nupur share intense feelings for each other. Priyanka tells them that they are the best couple. Later, there is a challenge to see who can eat the most number of chillies. Samrat wants Gunjan to win so he tries to eat more chillies than Nupur. Will Gunjan and Samrat win the game?

episodesList.title: Gunjan Suspects Purab
episodesList.summary: Mayank and Nupur tell each other about the kind of partner they want. Vidhushi tells Gunjan that Samrat is her good friend and that is why he ate so many chillies for her. Later, Gunjan thinks that Purab is her special friend, but she is wrong. Who is her special friend?

episodesList.title: Gunjan Feels Happy
episodesList.summary: Gunjan feels happy to see Samrat’s care for her. But Samrat is upset that he cannot express his feelings to Gunjan. Meanwhile, Mayank tells Nupur that they should not miss the next day’s bus. Later, Benji cannot find Samrat and Gunjan in the party. Where are they?

episodesList.title: Gunjan Apologises to Samrat
episodesList.summary: Samrat and Gunjan become the best couple on Valentine’s Day. Meanwhile, CJ tells Uday that she treats him only as a friend. Samrat buys a bike and takes Gunjan on a ride. This turns Dia jealous. Later, Gunjan apologises to Samrat. What will Samrat tell her?

episodesList.title: Gunjan Appreciates Samrat
episodesList.summary: Samrat and Gunjan clear their misunderstandings. Samrat tells Gunjan that he treats her as a very special friend. Gunjan appreciates Samrat for making this Valentine's day special for her. Meanwhile, Mayank and Nupur recall their fights. Will Mayank accept the fact that he loves Nupur?

episodesList.title: Nupur and Mayank Go to Ahmedabad
episodesList.summary: Diya taunts Gunjan for her incapability to compete with her in any competition. Nupur is happy on patching up with Samrat. Meanwhile, Purab briefs Gunjan for the contest. Mayank and Nupur meet Chunky Mishra and get upset. Chunky offers to drop them to Ahmedabad. Will they go with him?

episodesList.title: Samrat, Gunjan's Movie Date
episodesList.summary: Gunjan decides to participate in the Radio jockey show and starts preparing for it. She goes with Samrat for a movie and talks about the show. Nupur and Mayank reach Ahmedabad. Nupur tells Mayank to buy some clothes for her. However, they are late for the competition. Will they be able to win?

episodesList.title: Gunjan Is Surprised to See Samrat
episodesList.summary: Gunjan is surprised to see Samrat on the show. He gives her CDs of old film songs and helps her to make the show a hit. Meanwhile, Nupur cannot interpret the action taken by Mayank in the competition. They lose the round. Will they be able to win the competition?

episodesList.title: Gunjan Dreams About Samrat
episodesList.summary: Mayank ignores Nupur so that he does not fall in love with her. Nupur finds Mayank’s behaviour strange and wonders why he is behaving like this. Meanwhile, Gunjan has a dream about Samrat. Later, Nupur gives Chiruji a treat that makes Mayank jealous. What is the treat for?

episodesList.title: Aparajita Makes Fun of Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Gunjan tells Nupur about her show. Diya and Uday give their best wishes to Gunjan. Samrat also encourages her for the show. But Aparajita makes fun of Gunjan’s costume. Later, Chiruji plans to impress Nupur and laughs at Mayank, angering him. Will Mayank take revenge on Chiruji?

episodesList.title: Mayank Protects Nupur From Goons
episodesList.summary: Nupur is angry at Mayank for being rude with Chiruji. Later, Mayank saves Nupur from some goons, who misbehave with her. Nupur is injured and Mayank takes her to the hospital. Meanwhile, Gunjan’s show is about to start but she cannot find her CDs. Where are they?

episodesList.title: Mayank Falls for Nupur
episodesList.summary: Nupur asks Mayank why he is worried. Mayank feels love for Nupur. Gunjan is tense about her show as she does not have her CDs. She decides to call Samrat and tells him about it. She asks for his help. Samrat promises to help her. What will Samrat do?

episodesList.title: Samrat Tells Gunjan to Sing
episodesList.summary: Samrat tells Gunjan to sing on her radio show. Nupur and Mayank appear for the quiz competition. Mayank answers all the questions and they go to the next level. Nupur is very happy about the theme of the round. What is the round about? Will they win?

episodesList.title: Nupur and Mayank Win
episodesList.summary: Samrat plans to ruin Aparajita’s show. Uday calls on her show and teases her. Mayank and Nupur give an excellent performance in the competition and win it. Later, Nupur meets a fortune teller, who tells her the name of her love. What name does the fortune teller take?

episodesList.title: Nupur Dreams About Her Love Life
episodesList.summary: Samrat ruins Aparajita’s show by calling her. She is nervous and disconnects the call. However, Gunjan finds out that it was Samrat who called Aparajita. She thanks him for helping her out. Meanwhile, Nupur dreams about her love life. Whom does she see in her dream?

episodesList.title: Nupur Shares With Mayank
episodesList.summary: Nupur tells Mayank about her dream house. They get into an argument and Mayank tells her not to talk such nonsense. Meanwhile, Gunjan is declared the winner of the radio show. Samrat wants to celebrate Holi. Gunjan finds out about the rules of Holi from Diya. What are the rules?

episodesList.title: Mayank and Nupur Argue Again
episodesList.summary: Nupur and Mayank argue. Samrat informs Gunjan about Holi celebrations. Later, Nupur and Gunjan are happy to see each other. Nupur finds out about Gunjan’s radio show. Mayank sees Nupur’s letter and learns the truth about her project. What is the truth?

plotHtml: The story begins at Excel College, introducing basketball champion Samrat Shergill (Mohit Sehgal), college diva Dia Bhushan (Navina Bole), their friends Benji Swami (Abhishek Sharma) and Uday Bhushan (Jaskaran Gandhi), studious sisters Nupur Bhushan (Rati Pandey) and Gunjan Bhushan (Sanaya Irani), and academically inclined Mayank Sharma (Arjun Bijlani). Nupur is fashion-conscious and carefree, while Gunjan is introverted, responsible, and focused on her studies. Initially, the sisters face competition from their cousin Dia, who is jealous of them, but they eventually become close. Nupur and Mayank frequently argue, but over time they fall in love and get married. Gunjan and Samrat develop a friendship that leads to romance, and later on get engaged. Mayank and Nupur later decide to move to the United States. On their way to the airport with Gunjan and Samrat, the group is involved in a serious accident.

title: Mahima Shani Dev Ki
summary: Mahima Shani Dev Ki (transl. The glory of lord Shani) is an Indian Hindi-language Hindu mythological television series that was premiered on 26 July 2008 on Imagine TV.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text:
In India the series was originally broadcast on Imagine TV. The show was re-aired on Dangal. During its rerun in COVID-19 lockdown in India in Week 27 it became the 4th most watched Indian TV show.
The show was also dubbed in Kannada language as Shani Ninna Mahime, and aired on Dum TV Kannada. While the entire episodes of the show is also available on Dangal Play app. It was also Dubbed In Bengali Language as Jai Jai Shani Dev and aired on Enterr10 Bangla.

title: Mohe Rang De
summary: Mohe Rang De (transl. Color or paint me) is an Indian television series which aired on Colors TV on 21 July 2008 until 6 March 2009 and was produced by Sphere Origins.
plot:
This soap opera is set around the early times where traditions were old fashioned. It tells the story of two individuals with different ideologies, Rajveer and Kranti. A period drama set in British Raj Punjab with the backdrop of 1942 during the Quit India Movement, the show witnesses the upheaval of a country, trying to achieve its freedom. The two meet and their lives take a new course.
Rajveer, the son of a trader was born with a silver spoon in his mouth who flourished because of his contacts with the British. He studied in England for almost 15 years and has returned to India to practise law. Kranti is a survivor who lost her family when she was just six months and has survived a massacre. Outside the house, she is a fiery, spirited, young woman, with firm beliefs that she is outspoken about, but a quiet, dutiful niece in her uncle’s house. After returning to India, Rajveer works for the British government but he has no idea that he was being used and brainwashed by the British against his own country. When he gets to know about the truth he decides to revolt. He changes his whole life to be with this woman whom he comes to love and Kranti finally finds her family.

title: MTV Splitsvilla
summary: MTV Splitsvilla is an Indian television dating reality show that airs on MTV India and is digitally available on JioHotstar. The sixteenth season is presented by Sunny Leone, Karan Kundrra, Uorfi Javed and Nia Sharma.

articleSections.title: Summary
articleSections.text: The show revolves around young men and women trying to secure a place in Splitsvilla, a villa where they are detached from the real world. Participants compete in tasks to remain in the competition and mingle with their fellow contestants to find love.

episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: The new season of Splitsvilla 13 started with a new format. Rannvijay Singh and Sunny Leone introduce two arrows (one gold and another silver) with two different meanings. They also unveil all the contestants to each other. Based on the first impression already some infatuation created among the participants.

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Three boys (Kevin Almasifar, Nikhil Malik, Vyomesh Koul) of gold villa got an amazing opportunity go on date with the girls they got the golden arrow from. After the date boys had to choose one girl to come to the golden villa who will automatically become safe in the next dome session. Vyomesh Koul's choice started a lot of trouble among the contestants of the villa.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: The first official task of splitsville season thirteen was on the horizon. Two guys from the silver villa who received the most silver arrow got the chance to challenge the boys of the golden villa. They had to pair up with a girl to compete in the challenge. After the challenge comes the first-ever dome session where their also two sides of the oracle: the gold side and silverside.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: The first silver connection challenge is introduced where a musical chair type situation is created. In this special kind of musical chair, task boys had to act like a chair and girls had to get on them when the music stops. Every round the eliminated girl will challenge two boys for survival in the game. Surprisingly the round was won by Vyomesh Koul and Azuma Fallah. Later a commotion started in the villa because everyone wanted to switch connections.

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: The winner of yesterday's challenge got a chance to challenge two other people. Task had to perform in trio and four teams selected their desired team consisting of one boy and two girls in each team. There were some fun activities to perform in the task. The task was won by the amazing performance by Kat Kristian's team.

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: In this episode winners of the last task get to choose a person to go before the oracle with. As Rannvijay explained two girls are going home the voting became interesting. Eventually, after a few dramas and twists, Azuma Fallah and Shweta Nair got dumped. On the next day, Nikhil Chinappa brought two new contestants to join in the competition.

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: Nikhil Chinappa officially introduced the two new wild villa contest winners to join the splitsville and secretly gave them tasks to perform with other contestants. Sapna Malik won the secret task challenge and got a chance to steal a place in the gold villa.

episodesList.title: Episode 9
episodesList.summary: Kat Kristian and Kevin Almasifar start a new day after officially became the ideal match. And in the next sliver connection challenge girls from the silver villa had to paint the boys. In the task, Aditi Rajput and Nikita Bhamidipati performed well and won the task.

episodesList.title: Episode 16
episodesList.summary: New days starts with a new task. This task opened a lot of different cans of worms. Girls had to choose from different interesting and somewhat demeaning apps to tag each other with. And boys had to validate those apps by giving stars under those apps. Bhoomika Vashisht got the most apps but all apps were not validated and Kat Kristian had no apps under her name. What will be advantages or disadvantages of these apps will be revealed in the next episode.

episodesList.title: The ultimate quest for love begins
episodesList.summary: Sunny Leone and Arjun Bijlani herald Splitsvilla S14 with some unexpected games of love and seduction. Furthermore, the boys and girls stay on two different islands without knowing each other in this game of love. Enjoy the grand premier, on Voot!

episodesList.title: And the name-calling begins!
episodesList.summary: Joshua Chhabra speaks to all the girls and forms a connection with Kashish Ratnani. However, Akashlina Chandra doesn't like Joshua's behaviour with the other girls and an argument takes place between her and Kashish. Can Joshua handle the situation?

episodesList.title: The Grand Premiere
episodesList.summary: A new season of Splitsvilla is here, with new connections, new stories, and of course - dher saara dramaaa, or is it EX-tra drama? Watch the first episode and get hooked!

episodesList.title: ExSqueeze Me Please
episodesList.summary: Splitsvillains dhundne aaye hai pyaar, but what happens when their Exes do a War? A bunch of old flames have reignited, and this can only be Ex-plosion ke pehle ka sannaata. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Breaking News
episodesList.summary: Our Mischief Maker promised the Exes front row seats to all the drama in Splitsvilla, and well, this episode we see the Exes receive a special screening of some fiery comments by their ex-partners who are spicing it up in Splitsvilla. Watch this episode for the trauma and drama!

episodesList.title: Tohfa ya Tabaahi
episodesList.summary: We bring you the episode of firsts. First challenge of the season and first dome! Ab challenge hai toh twists bhi honge, and who better than our very own Mischief Maker to twist the lives of Splitsvillains. After stirring things up in Ex-Isle, she makes a grand entrance in Splitsvilla. Not just that, her Mischief Box also makes its debut here! A box that decides the fates of Splitsvillains and is as unpredictable as the Mischief Maker! Watch to find out Mischief Box tohfa lekar aaya ya tabaahi!

episodesList.title: Potty Li'l Secrets
episodesList.summary: Splitsvilla X5 ki pehli dumping se hua double dhamaaka jab dumped Splitsvillain Ishita pohonchi Ex-Isle aur mili apni ex se! Waqt hai ek aur naughty challenge ka jahan Splitsvillains karte hain rush to flush their dirty li'l secrets before their squeezes get to know, lekin not all succeed. Kuch raaz honge faash aur kuch flush! Watch this episode to uncover more drama.

episodesList.title: Bachao Bachao
episodesList.summary: A new day brings a new roller coaster of a challenge, aur challenges se toh humara ideal match bhi deal kar raha hai, and we suspect trouble in paradise! Some feelings get hurt, and we see Rushali breaking down. Jahaan ek jagah tension, wahan dusri jagah start of a new connection, lekin new connection ko squeeze in karte huye, old connection ho gaya squeeze out! Tension ki baat ho aur Mischief Box ki yaad na aaye? Humara Mischief Box is back in Ex-Isle and this time with the biggest news our exes have been waiting to hear! Watch this episode to catch up on all the tension, drama, and crazy!

episodesList.title: Exes Ka Explosion
episodesList.summary: It's time to bring the EX and the SQUEEZE face to face, so get ready for Mischief Maker ki sabse badi mischief! The past has finally caught up with our Splitsvillains aur unhein ab sirf Rabba hee bachaa sakta hai. Watch out for the toofan when exes walk into Splitsvilla and all the unresolved tension, buried feelings, and anger come together to create chaos like you have never seen before!

episodesList.title: The Courtroom Drama
episodesList.summary: Messy breakups and past relationships leave a trail of unanswered questions. Lekin ussi past ko revisit karke blame-game khelna is much more messier! What happens when a bunch of exes sit aamne-saamne aur humari Mischief Maker Uorfi kar rahi ho ilzaamon ki baarish, will they be able to absolve themselves, or be found guilty? Watch this episode to know more!

episodesList.title: Teen Tigaada Kaam Bigaada
episodesList.summary: After the courtroom drama, emotions hain volatile, aur isi liye lagegi aaj aag when our Splitsvillains perform a challenge with their ex and their squeeze! Ek taraf hai past ki talwaar, toh dusri taraf naya pyar, kya hoga jab yeh combo aayega saath? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Shik Shak Shock
episodesList.summary: Iss dome mein aayenge shocking twists kyunki puraane dushman banaa rahe hain alliance aur yeh definitely hai 'shik shak shock' moment! Humare missing Splitsvillains are back too, aur kaafi equations hone wale hain upar neeche. The winds at Splitsvilla are changing so dekhte hai yeh nayi hawayein kya toofan lekar aati hain!

episodesList.title: Pyaar ka SenseNaama
episodesList.summary: Touch, taste, smell, sound - harr sense ko hoga jagaana jab baat ho apne squeeze ki... Aaj Splitsvillains ki aankhon pe blindfold hai toh kya hua but baaki senses are on the job to find their squeeze!

episodesList.title: The Love Den
episodesList.summary: Love is in the air and our squeezes are all set to spend some quality time with each other on their dates. Garmi badhne waali hai, as this season, for the very first time, we have the Love Den carved out for our Lovebirds, and our ideal match is all set to explore the space or rather explore each other? Love ke saath, lovebirds are also in the air, yes, get ready for some chonch action as our Splitsvillains will be flying in the air with beaks tied to their faces. Watch this episode for an explosion of love, laughter, and fun!

episodesList.title: Mischief Masterstroke
episodesList.summary: Yeh dome lekar aaya hai kaafi saare twists, ek unexpected budding connection, aur Mischief Maker ka masterstroke! Bonds are breaking like biscuits, and it's heartbreak season for lovers, and bros alike! Heartbreak toh chalta rahega, lekin Mischief nahi rukni chahiye, and our Mischief Maker has hit the dome with a twist so dreadful, ki Oracle ke saamne jaana seems scary!

episodesList.title: Romance aur Bromance
episodesList.summary: Mischief Maker bani queen of wardrobe malfunction is baar, aur 'chaddi-buddies' ko quite literally daal diya ek hi chaddi mein! Bromance ki lagi vaat, jab baat aayi immunity choose karne ki, aur iss chakkar mein kahi bros na bann jaaye foes! Watch this episode for some chaddi fun!

episodesList.title: Khudaayi Aur Judaai
episodesList.summary: Aaj ke challenge mein hogi lambi khudaayi aur uske baad ideal match Harsh aur Rushali ki dardnaak judaai! Mischief Maker has knocked on the door, and the cost of answering ho sakti hai Harshali ke unbreakable connection ki bali! Ek taraf challenge mein kitaab mein aaye message ne machayi khalbali, toh dusri taraf Mischief Box mein aaye message ne rulaa diya Harsh aur Rushali ko. A 'wild' fear is looming over our ideal match and looks like there's trouble in paradise. Tune in to find out Harsh ke liye Love Den mein surprise wait kar raha hai ya shock!

episodesList.title: Bonds, Backstab, Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Mischief Maker ke tohfe ne ek baar phir machaayi hai tabaahi, aur Harsh ka hosh udd gaya hai! Kya hoga jab ideal match ke beech aayega ek puraana connection? Mischief Maker ka tohfa toh dome mein bhi aaya hai, aur iss baar Mischief box ka twist aapke bhi hosh uda dega! Dosti, connection, aur bonds, sab lagenge daav pe and it's going to be a betrayal fest! Watch this episode to catch the drama!

episodesList.title: Entertainment Entertainment Entertainment
episodesList.summary: Entertainment ki shaam Splitsvillains ke naam! Aaj ki raat Splitsvillains laaye hain stage tod performances aur hum unke liye do special surprises - Bolly beauty URVASHI RAUTELA aur last season ki superhit jodi 'SAKSTIN' 🫶 Watch this blockbuster episode for power-packed dance face-offs, dil bhar ke romance, aur drama hee drama!

episodesList.title: Doobte Connections
episodesList.summary: It's a sunny day for a pool dip, and what better than a challenge to kick things off! Humare lit couples will compete in a pool challenge and things are about to get crazy! A lot of fights and drama await you, lekin drama sirf pool ke andar nahi, villa ke andar bhi ! Shubhi ki entry ne boys ke dil mein machaa di hai dhoom, aur saare boys lagg gaye hain line mein to impress her, will this squeeze-out the existing connections? Grab some popcorn and catch the drama!

episodesList.title: Ek Aur EX
episodesList.summary: Yeh dome hoga unpredictable, aur connections, friendships, bonds honge test! Talwar toh sabhi Splitsvillains pe latak rahi hai, as this dome brings along a very unexpected and shocker elimination! Kahin kisi ke jaane ka gham, toh kahin ek dhamakedaar EX ki dhaansu entry! An unexpected wildcard triggers past wounds crashing the floodgates of emotions open!

episodesList.title: Rabba Bachaye
episodesList.summary: Our Mischief Maker - Uorfi is back with new masalas to spice up the villa! Presenting MM ke spicy secret challenges that create havoc and turn the villa upside down! Aur yeh toh sirf trailer hai, puri picture toh abhi baaki hai mere dost! Mischief Maker has something much bigger, and explosive planned for the night. Socho sirf teasers ne itna damage kar diya hai toh puri film kya tabahi machaati hai! Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: Love O'Clock
episodesList.summary: It's time to test the connections of our Splitsvillains after the Mischief Maker has dropped a bomb in the villa! Love-Den ke spicy snippets mein dikhe Harsh-Shubhi cozying up and looks like Harshali ka connection hai phirse khatre mein. Iss drama ke baad it's finally Love O'Clock and we bring you a challenge filled with romance, cute moments, aur dher saara fun as our couples go on a long ride and complete their love bucket lists, lekin saath hai ek sabotager to make things spicy! So hop on board and get ready as yeh ghadi hai pyaar ki!

episodesList.title: Power ya Pyaar
episodesList.summary: Iss dome mein Splitsvillains ko karni hogi ek ultimate choice - Power Ya Pyaar! It's a test of their bonds aur power ke liye humare Splitsvillains ko karna hoga decide - to stick to existing connections, ya dil todd ke, connection chodd ke banaye new connections! Aur dil toh tootenge boss as heartbreak season is on. Kya purane connections bhula ke naye connections form honge? Stay tuned and watch this episode to know!

episodesList.title: Spill the Tea
episodesList.summary: Gossip kisko nahi pasand aur hamari Mischief Maker ko toh kuch zyada hee. Splitsvillains aaj Mischief Maker ke liye laaye hain villa ki dher saari masaaledaar gossip aur uske badle mein Mischief Maker laayi hain Splitsvillains ke liye teekhi karaari chai, lekin yeh chai Splitsvillains naa sirf ek dusre ko pilayenge but issey ek dusre ko nehlaayenge bhi. Mischief Maker aaye aur kahaani mein twist na laaye aisa kaise ho sakta hai. Join us on this spicy chai date and get a taste of all the garma garam gossip!

episodesList.title: Toofani Confrontations
episodesList.summary: Mischief Maker ki spicy tea abhi tak nahi hui hai khatam, lekin kuch connections, bonds, aur relationships toh jarur khatam hote nazar aa rahe hain. The spilled tea has created havoc in the lives of Splitsvillains and all hell breaks loose in the villa! Toofani confrontations ho rahe hain and some shocking revelations sabke pairon tale ki zameen khiska degi! Stay tuned for the toofan.

episodesList.title: Qaid mein hai Bulbul
episodesList.summary: Aaj hum challenge mein laaye hain old school romance ki vibe. Humaari cute, pretty ladkiyaan hongi qaid ek cage mein, aur ladkon ko karni hogi mehnat unhein rescue karne ke liye. Iss challenge mein hai drama, dance, brawn, and brains bhi, aur performance mein toh ek Splitsvillain ne kill kar diya hai. Challenge hoga toh ladaaiyaan bhi hongi, aur poora villa batt chuka hai and everyone is conspiring for the next dome, does this mean unexpected twists or rather shocks? Stay tuned to watch!

episodesList.title: Chidiya Udd
episodesList.summary: We bring you a dome that surpasses all levels of unpredictable!  Yeh dome aapke hosh-o-hawaas uda dega! Poore villa ki planning se ek chidiya hai khatre mein, lekin Mischief Maker ne iss baar chodi nahi hai koi kasar, aur iss dome ke twists aur shocks Abbas-Mustan ko bhi sharminda kar denge! Stay tuned to watch one of the most shocking dome episodes of all times!

episodesList.title: Khareedari padi Bhaari
episodesList.summary: The unexpected dumping of Siwet has created a rift between best friends Akriti-Anicka, aur villa mein ab hai explosive mahaul! Is this the end of Akriti-Anicka's friendship? Kahin end toh kahin new connections ki shuruaat, and we see some unusual but interesting connections form for this season's market challenge! Humare Splitsvillains are on the streets of a busy market to entertain the locals and to perform the challenge, stay tuned to be entertained and have fun!

episodesList.title: Ringmaster, Sher aur Teddy Bear
episodesList.summary: Splitsvilla ek circus hai, aur yahan hain all types of praanis. Kahin sher ki dahaad, toh kahin ek billi joh kare sab pe vaar. The power decides if you are a mere performer or a ringmaster commanding the circus! Ek galat step, and the dynamics change and the power shifts! Bohot contenders hain to claim the ringmaster throne, yet only one can be successful! Aur iss baar circus ko aur interesting banane, we have a teddy in the mix. Stay tuned to enjoy this circus free of cost!

episodesList.title: Note pe Note!
episodesList.summary: Yeh dome hai surprises aur shockers ka mixture, and stakes are really high! Iss baar Mischief Box has not one, but two notes for us, toh dil ki dhadkanein abhi double speed se badhengi, aur kya tabaahi machaayega yeh second note, woh toh waqt hee batayega. Tabaahi toh Splitsvillains ne bhi machaayi hai. Ek taraf sher ki dahaad ko mil raha hai muh-todd jawab, toh dusri taraf Anicka ka naya andaaz aapko lagega lajawab! Aur sabse mazze ki baat, Splitsvillains aaye toh thhe to form new connections, lekin Oracle has something EXtra planned for them! Is this the start of something new? Stay tuned to watch

episodesList.title: Dares, Darlings, aur Downfall
episodesList.summary: Aaj hai battle between the ideal matches so darlings karenge perform mazedaar dares for their teams. Lekin asli daring toh dikhayi hai Ringmaster ne banaake dushmanon ko dost. Aur inn dares aur darlings ke beech ho raha hai downfall hamare Sher ka. Lekin uski darling urf Sherni has got his back, and usne kiya pyar ka izhaar khulle-aam! So popcorn leke baith jaayein for all the romance, action and drama that's on its way!

episodesList.title: Picture Abhi Baaki Hai...
episodesList.summary: Itni mehnat, challenges, aur games ke baad, it's time for our Splitsvillains to go on a vacation with their BAEs! Some time to unwind and relive their past memories, lekin kahaani yahan khatam nahi hoti kyuki picture abhi baaki hai mere dost! Challenge mein hai twist, that has everyone confused and shocked! Splitsvilla abhi pohoch gaya hai uss stage pe, jahaan unpredictable cheezein kar rahi hain sabko hairaan, and one of our couples is on the verge of falling apart. Aisi kya baat hui, joh sunke Kashish had a massive outburst and Addy is the last person she chooses to trust? Stay tuned to catch the full drama!

episodesList.title: Swagat Nahin Karoge Humara...
episodesList.summary: Hawaiian thodi badal rahi hai, and there's revenge in the wind! Someone walks into Splitsvilla aur hue kaafi khulaase. While all are shocked and confused at this new information, Jash is questioning his connection with Akriti and looks like there's going to be trouble in paradise! Stay tuned for a toofani dome session.

episodesList.title: Goal Maal
episodesList.summary: Aaj blue hai paani paani aur raat bhi hai suhaani for a pool challenge, and our Splitsvillains are all set for it. Karne honge goals to win, and it's going to be a lot of fun! Goals maarte maarte hoga Splitsvillains ke saath goal-maal, jissey udd jayenge unke hosh! Kyunki Splitsvilla pohoch chuka hai ek serious turn pe, where every move, every challenge, and every goal counts! Ek taraf ek lucky couple ko milega chance to go to the Love Den, wahin dusri taraf surprise elimination after the challenge kar dega sabko shock! Stay tuned as it's time for some Goal-maal!

episodesList.title: Champions Vs Challengers
episodesList.summary: It's time for our spicy couple - Addy-Kashish to visit the Love Den, aur taapmaan badhne wala hai badi tezi se! Vaise taapmaan toh challenge mein bhi badhega, as we bring to you the ultimate war between our champions - the Ideal Matches, and challengers! Daav pe hai power aur power haasil karne ke liye, kuch power dynamics bhi ho rahe hain change! So stay tuned and wait for the war!

episodesList.title: Match Fixing
episodesList.summary: Splitsvilla mein now it's time for some defining decisions aur connections bhi hain kaafi naazuk mod pe! The game of love has reached a 'do or die' stage and kuch important choices are to be made. Connections ke saath power bhi hai zaroori, lekin iss pyaar aur power ki ladaai mein kaun jayega kis paar. Stay tuned to find out Splitsvillains ki choices unhein game mein kahan leke jaati hain. Some matches are made in heaven and the ones which are not are made in Splitsvilla. Stay tuned to find out ab kya nayi match fixing hone wali hai in the Splits universe.

episodesList.title: Pyaar Jahan, Jannat Wahan!
episodesList.summary: Splitsvilla mein aayi ek zabardast jodi - Faizu & Jannat, jinki chemistry aur connection ke fan toh hum sab hee hain! Lekin inki entry se Splitsvillains ke dil mein baji darr ki ghanti. Kyun ki stakes are super high as the race to the Finale is getting intense. Iss race ke chakkar mein pyaar ne nahin lee hai backseat, cause we have our first ever Splitsvilla marriage proposal, toh rab ka toh pata nahin, lekin Jannat ne bana di jodi!  Aaiyye dekhte hain pyaar aur jodi kiski zyada chamkegi? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: Ticket to Finale
episodesList.summary: Splitsvilla ab aa gaya hai endgame pe, and the stakes are super high! Ab last stage hai toh dhamaka bhi bada hee hoga, so we bring you the 'TICKET TO FINALE' challenge! Splitsvillains karenge compete to win a direct spot in the FINALE! Yeh challenge nahin aasan, bas itna samajh lijiye, ek maze ka dariya hai, aur blindfold hoke jaana hai. So grab your popcorn and find out kaun sa couple jayega straight to the Grand Finale of Splitsvilla X5, will it be an Ideal Match, Power Match, ya Love Match!

episodesList.title: Kaatil Kaun
episodesList.summary: Last dome of the season, toh dome ki last mischief bhi hogi, aur kaafi dhamakedaar hogi, kyun ki Mischief Maker khud aayi hai to wreak havoc in the dome! Splitsvilla ke itihaas mein pehli baar, dome mein khela jaayega ek exciting, scary, aur kaatil game - Kaatil Kaun? Iss game mein, eliminations ke saath kuch connections aur bonds ka bhi hoga qatl, as our Splitsvillains have to make some difficult choices to save some connections, and sacrifice some! So stay tuned for this dhamakedaar and mischievous episode.

episodesList.title: Janta Jury
episodesList.summary: Get exclusive access to the most controversial and highly anticipated Janta Jury Fan Live event, featuring raw and live coverage. Watch our most talked-about contestants face the heat from India’s top fan pages and media houses in a courtroom-style showdown. The Janta Jury witnessed a full-house fan fest with contestants sharing their experiences, insights, and juicy gossip, leading to epic face-offs.

episodesList.title: Muqabla Semi-Finale Ka
episodesList.summary: Splitsvilla aa gaya hai Semi-Finale stage pe, aur couples ko milega ek last chance to compete and enter the Finale! Baazi itni badi hai, toh muqable mein bhi hogi kaante ki takkar, jahan bhai will go against bhai, aur purane dushmanon ko milega mauka badla lene ka! Semi-Finale ka muqabla, aur Mischief Maker na aaye, aisa toh ho nahin sakta, and this time she has a special gift for the Splitsvillains, and that is another Mischief Maker, Munawar Faruqui! Ek Mischief Maker padti hai itni bhaari, ab Munawar aur kya dhamaka karega, yeh toh waqt aane pe hee pata chalega. So stay tuned for the muqabla.

episodesList.title: The Grand Finale
episodesList.summary: A Twisted and Grand Season Finale! 3 Finalists…an emotional journey…some serious sacrifices…and an epic season finale! Iss baar ka safar nahin tha aasan, pyaar dhoondte dhoondte hua exes se saamna. Aur iss finale stage mein bhi difficult choices aa gayi hain saamne, where not one but two Mischief Makers - Uorfi and Munawar, present the Splitsvillains with the BIGGEST MISCHIEF OF THIS SEASON! So, grab your popcorn and let's watch if pyaar withstands the choices or succumbs to the Mischief!

title: Mata Ki Chowki
summary: Mata ki Chowki is an Indian television series produced by Swastik Pictures, which aired on Sahara One from 9 June 2008 to 7 October 2011. The series produced 845 episodes.
plot:
Mata ki Chowki follows the story of a girl known as Vaishnavi, a great devotee of the Goddess Vaishno Devi, and details events in her life concerning her faith.
Vaishnavi is an orphan child who later finds herself adopted by Shradhha & Vidyasagar. Throughout her life, Vaishnavi's devotion towards Mata Vaishno Devi is seen in the miracles that occur in her favour and the struggles she encounters. Season 2 revolves around Vaishnavi's daughter, Sakshi. The third season covers the life of Sakshi's daughters, Nisha and Asha.

title: Mogalirekulu
summary:
Mogalirekulu was an Indian Telugu-language drama television series which originally premiered on 18 February 2008 on Gemini TV and ran until 24 May 2013. It was directed by Manjula Naidu, who co-wrote alongside Bindu Naidu. It is one of the longest-running Telugu series. The show starred Sagar, Sheela, Likhitha Kamini, Indraneel and Medha in the lead roles.
Mogalirekulu focuses on vengeance. Season 1 focuses on Dharma, the eldest of five orphans, looks after the younger ones, Satya, Daya, Santhi and Keerthana, who also want to avenge their parents' death. The story has many twists, drama and touches upon social responsibilities, too. Season 2 focuses on their children Mahidhar Naidu/Munna, Devi, Durga, Pallavi, Eshwar and Sindhu.
plot:
The story begins with three boys Dharma, Satya and Daya and their little sister, Shanti. Four of them are the victims of a family feud where their parents and grandmother are murdered by their step grandmother and uncles. They are joined by their neighbor's child Keerthana, who is a victim of a mother's innocent passion for music. They decide to leave for Hyderabad but the things take twists and turns resulting the three brothers and Keerthana was being in Hyderabad and their sister Santi, after separating from her brothers, living with her uncle and step-grandmother.
ACP RK Naidu (who is later the DGP, Mumbai) is a strict, dynamic and responsible IPS officer who marries Shanti after saving her from clutches of her uncle and grandmother. Dharma meets Selva Swamy who indulges in illegal activities which brings the enmity between RK and Selva.
After knowing that Dharma is Santi's brother and many misunderstandings RK come to conclusion that Dharma being an honest friend and sensitive person is just helping his friend Selva in his activities and start adoring him. RK successfully puts the culprits of santi's parents behind the bars as promised to Dharma. A love triangle start confusion among Dharma, Keerthana and Selva (created by Selva's mother where she blackmailed Keerthana to marry Selva for saving Dharma) results in dire enmity of Selva for Dharma and RK where he plans a bomb blast to kill them and the results being death of Daya and Rk and Santi losing their son Mahidhar Naidu.
The serial is into second generation then having Munna, the son of RK Naidu as the hero, who has been orphaned due to the bomb blast who is brought up in a criminal background by a don Sikandar Bhai. Munna falls in love with Devi who is the niece of Selva. Selva feels attached to her as she resemble Selva's wife Meenakshi. Hence he decides to have her marry his elder son Eshwar. Due to some clashes Munna and Eshwar argue and fight. But Munna and Devi become friends and her marriage with Eshwar is called off when she reveals her true feelings for munna on the day before wedding, bothering her parents, Eshwar and his grandmother. Munna and Devi marry. Munna plots to attack DGP RK as a part of his criminal life but decides not to because of his good nature and later learns that RK is his father. Munna unable to face his father, hides his identity and changes his name to 'Mahendhra' and starts a health service called AHS to serve rural people and comes back to RK after protecting RK from a bomb blast. While he is away, Devi goes to stay with RK's family by hiding her identity saying that she needs protection until her husband Munna comes back. Meanwhile, RK learns that Munna aka Mahidhar is indeed their son Mahi through Selva Swamy. In Meanwhile, Pallavi and Durga love each other despite their parents' rivalry. RK's family accepts Devi as their daughter-in-law and Devi conceives. The story ends with the families of RK and Selva uniting when Selva's sons marry Dharma and Satya's daughters and they learn that Dharma is alive.

title: Main Teri Parchhain Hoon
summary: Main Teri Parchhain Hoon is an Indian soap opera produced by Rajshri Productions. It aired on NDTV Imagine between 21 January 2008 and 12 February 2009. The series was rebroadcast on Dangal TV beginning on 8 March 2021.
plot:
Aanchal lives with her aunt and uncle, and dreams of becoming a fashion designer. Jaya is a devoted wife and mother who loves her husband, Siddharth, and their three children, Ayush, Juhi, and Sachin. Jaya visits her maternal home in Mumbai, promising to return soon. She and Aanchal meet at the bus station, and she gives Aanchal her ticket so Aanchal can make an interview on time. Jaya's bus falls off a cliff; she dies, and her family is heartbroken.
Aanchal gets a job as a fashion designer, but feels guilty when she hears about Jaya's death. Siddharth wants to keep Jaya's death from his children, but Ayush finds out and hides the news from his siblings to protect them.
Siddharth goes into seclusion. Juhi and Sachin miss their mother, and decide to go to Mumbai and see her; Ayush joins them. On the bus, the conductor orders the children off because they do not have tickets. Aanchal, who is on the bus, tells him that she is the children's mother. The bus stops; Aanchal feeds the children, and gets to know them. When she asks about their mother, Ayush says that she is in Mumbai. Aanchal tells them to return home because their father will be worried, and she brings them back. Siddharth is looking for the children, but Aanchal meets the other family members. Siddharth's father tells her that the children do not yet know that their mother is dead.
He is looking for a tutor for the children, and Aanchal volunteers; the children reluctantly agree. Juhi and Sachin learn that their mother is dead, but Siddharth calms them. Aanchal becomes closer to the children as she tutors them. They begin to like her, especially Sachin. Siddharth and Aanchal meet, and Aanchal introduces herself as the children's tutor. Siddharth's stepmother and sister-in-law, Chanchal, envy Aanchal's bond with the family, and she and Lalita conspire against her. Ayush begins to resent Aanchal because he thinks she is replacing his mother. Sachin grows closer to Aanchal. Siddharth and Aanchal also grow close after he offers to help her with her fashion designs. Siddharth's father and Dheeraj want Siddharth and Aanchal to marry, but when they tell Siddharth he says that no one can replace Jaya. Aanchal overhears him, and does not want to replace Jaya. Siddharth and Sachin continue to grow closer to Aanchal. Ayush and Juhi dislike her more after Jaya's mother dies. Chanchal blames Aanchal for her aunt's death.
Siddharth proposes to Aanchal because he wants her to be a mother to his children. Aanchal, Haryaman, Dheeraj, and Sachin are happy, but Lalita, Chanchal, Ayush, and Juhi are angry. Aanchal abandons her dream of being a fashion designer to become a wife and mother. This frustrates Sudeep, who has always loved Aanchal. After their marriage, Aanchal and Siddharth slowly fall in love. Lalita and Chanchal throw Aanchal out of the house, but Siddharth and Sachin leave with her; Ayush and Juhi refuse to join them, and Siddharth cuts ties with them. Aanchal is disappointed to learn that she is pregnant, since the children have still not accepted her. She plans an abortion; Siddharth is opposed, and they decide to keep the baby. Sachin is crippled in an accident under Aanchal's care. Lalita and Chanchan taunt her, but Siddharth and Aanchal do their best to help Sachin. Aanchal finally gives birth to a son, whom she names Jai; she leaves him with her aunt and uncle so she can get the children to accept her. Aanchal and Siddharth focus on Sachin's progress, and Aanchal turns down a job as a fashion designer. Juhi sees Jaya in a dream, and she tells her to accept Aanchal. Lalita and Chanchan finally realize that Aanchal sacrificed for their family, and Ayush. Ayush appears with Jai at a festival and gives him to Aanchal, calling her "mum". Aanchal sees Jaya in the sky as she waves goodbye, and the whole family is finally reunited.

title: Magal
summary: Magal is a 2007 Indian Tamil-language morning soap opera that aired Monday through Friday on Sun TV from 8 October 2007 to 14 October 2011 for 1015 episodes. It was highly praised in TRP ratings of Tamil serials. This show starred Meenakumari, Chandra Lakshman, Sulakshana, Kamalesh, Varalakshmi and Rishi. It was produced by Akash Khurana of Nimbus Television and directed by Francis Bapu. It also aired in Sri Lanka on the Tamil channel Vasantham TV.
plot:
This story revolves around a young woman named Kaveri (Meenakumari) and her family. She had finished college and went to work in a nursing home as a nurse. Her impoverished family includes her parents, three sisters and a brother. Her brother and father were indolent. She helped run the family. One big sister Padma (Yokini) worked in the shop, while sisters Priya (Kaviya) and Revathy (Dhanalakshmi) studied in college.
Kaveri loved and married Karthick (Rishikesh). But Eashwari (Varalakshmi), daughter of Naggapan (Ramy Reddy), also loved Karthick and took revenge on both Karthick and Kaveri. Radhidevi breaks the family into more problems. Kaveri faces the issues and starts a business with her husband.
This series took various types of stories in episodes between (500- till the end) with more important characters. Later, Shakthi (Chandra Lakshman) who was a strong woman, helps Kaveri take revenge on Easwari. In the last episode, Karthick killed Eashwari's father and went to jail. After that, Ravi (Karthick's brother and Shakthi's husband) is killed by Eashwari; then Shakthi took the gun and shot and killed Eashwari. Shakthi went to jail and showed in the last episode, after eight years, they both came out from prison and their children's born and their ages of 10 years and they returned to their work.
This series shows that women are very strong Magal (Daughter). It had been praised high in TRP ratings of Tamil serial and received high praise from viewers.

title: Main Aisi Kyunn Hoon
summary: Main Aisi Kyunn Hoon (transl. Why I'm like this) is a Hindi television serial that was shown on Sahara One channel worldwide starting from 8 October 2007 to 22 August 2008. It is based on the story of a middle-class girl Sanjana Patil, a strong-headed girl with modern outlook on life despite being born to a traditional family. It was shown on weekdays at 8:30pm.
plot:
Sanjana Patil, who has imagination and a great sense of humor. She is modern in her thoughts despite being born in a middle-class joint family. Like any ordinary Indian family, Sanjana's family also pressure her to get married since she is nearing her 30s. But Sanjana has been in love with her childhood sweetheart Siddharth who is in the US, pursuing his further studies and is waiting to marry him.
Like any other love story, this story also has twist when Sanjana discovers that the man she loves (Siddharth) has been married to her boss Anuradha. Now, she is completely shattered and unable to face the reality. She wants to know to a great extent that why Siddharth broke his promise and married someone else and how she will face the man who she is in love with, who is now married to someone else.
The story takes off when caught between her modern feelings and traditional values, Sanjana refuses to move on and chooses to live in her past.

title: Megala
summary: Megala is a 2007-2010 Indian Tamil-language soap opera that aired on Sun TV from 4 June 2007 to 25 April 2008 Monday through Friday at 19:30 (IST) and from 28 April 2008 to 23 April 2010 at 18:00 (IST). It ran for 729 episodes. It had been receiving the highest ratings of Tamil serials and received high praising from viewers. The show starred Gayathiri, Deepan Chakravarthy Yugendran, Vadivukkarasi, Kuyili, Shreekumar, Rajkanth and Bhavana Samanthula. The show was produced by Metti Oli serial fame Cine Times Entertainment Siddhiq and directed by Vikramathithan. It replaced Anjali.  It was also aired in Sri Lanka Tamil Channel on Shakthi TV.
plot:
The story of a couple, Kalaiyarasu and Thilaga, who have five children. Kalai's sister Shanmuga Vadivu alias Vadivu lives with him and Kalai is totally devoted to Vadivu and does all that she says. Vadivu (Vadivukkarasi) tries to separate the couple as she does not like Thilaga. Mehala born to this couple and Vadivu hates that, convincing Kalai to disown her from the family. Hence Mehala (Gayathiri) is brought up in her grandparents home and Thilaga often visits to the home with her other kids. Mehala is very fond of her other siblings.
One day, due to a quarrel between Thilaga and Vadivu, Mehala hits vadivu and she got fainted. By seeing this, Mehala thought she died and ran away from home. She runs to various places and continue with her studies with the help of her friends. When Mehala was on the run, she saw an old man trying to commit suicide and she saves him from committing that. Mehala works as an assistant to a lawyer upon completing her education. Meanwhile, she tries to search for her family back.
